desc.en: Pre-construction. Bacab takes its name from the four deities within Mayan mythology, who hold up the sky and represent the last four days of the year, the four divine winds, and the four cardinal points. As such, Bacab embodies the idea of an eternal journey, a search for new experiences and connections. And in Tulum, where the lush jungle meets the Caribbean Sea, there's no shortage of new experiences to be had. But Bacab isn't just about the location. The project boasts an impressive array of amenities and features, making it a true oasis within the town. Security is a top priority, with CCTV in common areas and access control for added peace of mind. The project also includes a wastewater treatment system and an intelligent irrigation system in common areas, ensuring that Bacab is both eco-friendly and sustainable. The apartments themselves are Turn Key delivered, fully furnished and equipped with the latest amenities. Carpentry is done with parota-type wood, and the kitchens feature quartz bars and electric stoves. Each unit comes with a frigobar or refrigerator, depending on the unit type, as well as LED-type lights and curtains. With Bacab, you'll have everything you need to make yourself at home. Of course, Bacab isn't just about the apartments. The project includes a range of amenities that are designed to help residents relax, recharge, and enjoy the Tulum lifestyle. A pool, wellness corner, gym, lobby, bikes, sundeck, rooftop hammocks, parking, and laundry room are all available for residents to use at their leisure. And with La Veleta just outside your door, you'll have access to a vibrant community of bars, cafes, fashion shops, and restaurants from all over the world. 📁 Brochure: Bacab Final.pdf 🛠 Developer: Bacab Capital 📅 Delivery Date: July 2023 📍Location: La Veleta, Tulum ⛲️ Amenities: ‍ CCTV in common areas. Access control. Wastewater treatment. Intelligent irrigation system in common areas. Air conditioners Apartments are Turn Key delivered, fully furnished and equipped Pool Wellness Area Gym Lobby Sundeck Rooftop Hammocks Parking Laundry Room ‍ ‍ 📏Size sqm: 77m2 ‍📐Size sqft: 800sqft 💵Total Price: - $202,000 USD ⏳Payment Plan: Ask for payment plans and discount options to your broker. 💸 Financing: Most of our clients prefer to raise funds in their home country and pay in cash. ‍

Nestled within the enchanting embrace of the lush Mayan jungle, you'll wake up to breathtaking sunrises, bathed in the invigorating embrace of the sun's radiant energy right within the sanctuary of your own apartment. At Hideaways, our condominiums boast expansive terraces, with some even offering the luxury of private gardens and rooftops complete with personal pools. Situated just a stone's throw away from the idyllic shores of Boca Paila and the vibrant Tulum Beach Hotel Zone, Hideaways Tulum enjoys an enviable location that places you within easy reach of an array of enticing tourist attractions. What truly sets Hideaways apart is our unwavering commitment to sustainability and the well-being of our precious environment. We prioritize harnessing solar energy, using cutting-edge water treatment methods to ensure responsible usage, efficiently managing organic waste with biodigesters, and collecting rainwater to contribute to conservation efforts. Additionally, our dedication to reforesting the local area promotes biodiversity and preserves the natural beauty of Tulum. By prioritizing regional materials and suppliers, we foster both direct and indirect employment opportunities within the community, further solidifying our commitment to sustainable living. But that's not all; Hideaways offers a seamless hotel experience with services that cater to your every need. With our full hotel operation by Wyndham, you can expect: Maintenance Excellence: Impeccable upkeep of all common areas, ensuring a pristine and inviting environment for residents and guests alike. Roomservice: Indulge in the convenience of room service, bringing culinary delights right to your doorstep. Concierge Services: Our dedicated concierge team is at your disposal, ready to assist with any requests or reservations, ensuring your stay is effortless and memorable. Moreover, as owners, you'll have the opportunity to be part of the hotel operation service, following the condo-hotel scheme. This scheme is operated and supported by one of the most prominent and trusted hotel chains worldwide, Wyndham. It adds an extra layer of prestige and service quality to your Hideaways experience, elevating it to a level of luxury and convenience that is truly unparalleled. At Hideaways Tulum, we blend the beauty of nature, sustainability, and world-class hospitality to offer you a unique and holistic living experience in the heart of the Mayan jungle. Finished property. Property for sale in the beautiful and vibrant town of Tulum, inspired by the philosophy of rest, authenticity, and tribal culture. The property is located within Luum Zama, a gated community in the prestigious area of Aldea Zama, offering an attractive and sustainable lifestyle for those seeking peace and tranquility. Located in Aldea Zama a vast land area of 80,485.72 m2, Zambo Tulum comprises buildings for both multi-family use and single-family housing. The unique and distinctive feature of this property is its design philosophy, which conceptualizes the elements that have transformed Tulum into an amalgam of different cultures. The building is designed to gradually take shape, adding and removing volumes, resulting in a soft, rustic, and almost spontaneous appearance. The project is supported by references that have a natural spirit, with simple and economical materials used to achieve a different, attractive, and sensual design. The honesty and simplicity of Yucatecan and African architecture are reflected in the warm tones, natural textures, and the relationship between the interior and exterior spaces. Zambo Tulum is an ideal investment opportunity for those seeking a unique and sustainable lifestyle in Tulum. With its excellent location, the property offers a peaceful and serene environment, providing a much-needed break from the hustle and bustle of city life. The property is designed to provide a sense of community, with a private condominium regime, making it an ideal choice for families, couples, and individuals seeking a comfortable and secure living space. Overall, Zambo Tulum is a beautiful and innovative property that captures the essence of Tulum's diverse and vibrant culture. With its unique design philosophy and sustainable living options, it is an excellent investment opportunity for those seeking a peaceful and authentic lifestyle in one of the most beautiful and dynamic locations in the world. 📁 Brochure: Zambo Tulum 🛠 Developer: Grupo R4 📅 Delivery Date: Complete 📍Location: Aldea Zama, Tulum ⛲️ Amenities: Club house Pool Restaurant Bike Path Running track Amphitheater Yoga palapa Temazcal Watchtower 📏Size sqm: 167m2 📐Size sqft: 1,796sqft 💵Total Price: - $425,000 USD ⏳Payment Plan: Ask for payment plans and discount options to your broker.

Pre-construction. Meet our new masterpiece in Tulum: where classical tradition meets Mesoamerican heritage. This stunning villa, located in Tulum’s most exclusive area, represents a harmonious fusion of traditional Classical architecture and rich Mesoamerican design. Every aspect of this home has been thoughtfully crafted to enhance human performance through nature-inspired elements, creating a perfect blend of tradition and aesthetics. The villa is not only visually striking but also scientifically advanced, incorporating several cutting-edge features designed to optimize comfort and sustainability: Solar Chimney: This innovative system enhances natural ventilation by capturing heat and promoting upward airflow, reducing the need for air conditioning while maintaining a cool and pleasant interior. Expansive Stairwell: The spacious stairwell not only serves as a striking architectural feature but also plays a key role in improving ventilation, and drawing cool air upward to maintain optimal airflow throughout the villa. Optimized Airflow Design: The layout of the villa promotes a constant flow of fresh air throughout the living spaces, ensuring a cool and refreshing atmosphere even in the warm Tulum climate. High Ceilings: The villa’s impressive ceiling height adds to its grandeur, creating a sense of openness and reducing echoes. This architectural feature further supports the design principle of providing expansive, airy spaces that foster comfort and well-being. Noise Reduction Strategies: Using sound-dampening materials and a smart architectural layout, the villa minimizes external noise, creating a peaceful and serene environment inside. Natural Light Management: The villa is designed to harness natural light effectively while controlling sun exposure. This not only reduces energy consumption but also keeps the interior naturally illuminated and comfortable. Sustainable Materials: The construction materials were carefully chosen to respect the local environment, using eco-friendly and locally sourced resources to minimize the ecological footprint. Integration with Nature: Thoughtfully designed outdoor and indoor spaces allow nature to be an integral part of the villa. With greenery incorporated throughout the façade and open areas that invite nature indoors, the villa creates a seamless connection to its natural surroundings, promoting a deeper sense of calm and harmony. The design methodology emphasizes well-being, advanced living, and a strong bond with the surrounding natural world, making this villa a true sanctuary for those seeking luxury and a new concept for human performance. desc.en: Pre-construction. Nestled amidst the lush emerald jungle, just a stone's throw away from the heart of Tulum Town and a short 10-minute drive from the mesmerizing Tulum beach, lies a unique real estate development that redefines luxury living - Zamaya Fitness Resort and Residences. Strategically positioned on the western side of Tulum, Zamaya offers the most direct access to the city's new International Airport (just 10 minutes away) and the chic Centro Tulum Shopping Plaza (a mere 2 minutes away). This prime location not only provides unparalleled convenience but also serves as a gateway to the best of Tulum's attractions. At Zamaya, sustainability is not just a buzzword; it's a way of life. With a deep commitment to environmental preservation, the development embraces the use of local materials and incorporates regional design features, creating a harmonious blend of modernity and tradition. Leading the charge in this eco-conscious endeavor is the visionary Mexican architect, Jesus Acosta, from the renowned Jaque Studio, known for their award-winning designs. Each Zamaya Villa is a testament to impeccable design and functionality. Step into a world of boundless elegance as you enter the spacious open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area, seamlessly connected to a sprawling outdoor terrace, verdant garden, and inviting private pool. Prepare to embrace the essence of indoor/outdoor living, where every moment is a celebration of nature and tranquility. The ground floor plays host to a breathtaking double-height master bedroom, complete with an en-suite bathroom boasting an indulgent indoor/outdoor shower. Ascend to the first floor, and you'll find two more generously proportioned bedrooms, each offering a sanctuary of relaxation and escape. Privacy is a cornerstone of the Zamaya experience. The thoughtful layout ensures that no villa has direct views into another, granting a sense of seclusion amidst the captivating views of the surrounding jungle and flourishing nature. It's a retreat where you can truly unwind and reconnect with your inner self. Founded in Tulum in 2017, Jaque Studio has made a name for itself by crafting spaces that exude comfort and inspire awe. Their philosophy revolves around creating unique environments and experiences for the inhabitants, achieved through pure forms, innovative aesthetics, and the use of natural materials that seamlessly blend with the local surroundings. Noteworthy recognition has been showered upon Jaque Studio, both domestically and internationally, with prestigious awards such as the Cemex and Noldi Schreck Architectural Awards, the Creatures Design Award, and the esteemed Dezeen Award in the best hospitality design category. Whether you seek a serene escape or an active, wellness-focused lifestyle, Zamaya Fitness Resort and Residences cater to your every desire. It's an opportunity to embrace a life of sophistication, immersed in the charm of Tulum's vibrant culture and breathtaking landscapes. Come, be a part of this one-of-a-kind project - where the boundaries of luxury living are redefined, and the harmony between man and nature is celebrated like never before. Zamaya awaits your presence in paradise. ‍ ‍🛠 Developer: Collab. Jaque Studios and Zamaya 📅 Delivery Date: December 2024 📍Location: Region 11, Tulum ⛲️ Amenities: ‍ - Total integration with Zamaya Fitness Resort - 24/7 controlled security access. - Dedicated fiber optic line for high-speed and reliable internet. - Pet friendly. - Optional solar panel installation to connect directly to the grid. - Dedicated car parking space for each villa - Co-working space - Spa - Training area - Gym - Restaurant - Pools ‍ 📏Size sqm: 260.20m2 ‍📐Size sqft: 2,800sqft 💵Total Price: - $379,000 USD ⏳Payment Plan: Ask for payment plans and discount options to your broker. 💸 Financing: Most of our clients prefer to raise funds in their home country and pay in cash. ‍ ‍

desc.en: Pre-construction. Welcome to Villa Mamba, a sculptural luxury villa for sale in Tulum that offers an architectural statement unlike anything else in the region. Located within Consciente, the wellness led community in Nuevo Tulum that values a sustainable lifestyle, where gold can be green, and community is the prize at the end of the journey. Designed by Zepto with interiors by C&C Design, Villa Mamba is a study in dramatic geometry set against the Tulum jungle. The villa's defining feature is its elevated rooftop lap pool, which cascades as a glass walled waterfall over the open plan living and master bedroom below, framing the great room in a curtain of moving water. Floor-to-ceiling glazing dissolves the boundary between interior and surrounding jungle, while sculpted concrete volumes and emerald green textured walls create a play of architectural mass against organic landscape. One of the most striking features of this villa is the way water flows through every elevation. From the cascade waterfall above the master to the ground floor lap pool that wraps the living room, to the fire pit terrace that frames the main pool deck, water is the connecting element across every space. The villa is built across two architectural levels with generous overhanging volumes, creating sheltered outdoor rooms that extend the living footprint into the jungle canopy. As part of the design of the villa, you will have access to the rooftop pool, the main pool with sun deck, an outdoor fire pit lounge, a private gym room, a covered carport, integrated jungle landscaping, and architectural lighting throughout. This villa is the ideal place to disconnect from the stress of daily life and reconnect with nature, your loved ones, and yourself. Don't miss the opportunity to commission this unique and luxurious villa, with construction permits already approved and ready to break ground. Discover Tulum with us and let yourself be immersed in a new concept of luxurious living. Contact us today to learn more about Villa Mamba and start living your dream life. 📁 Brochure: Villa Mamba 🛠 Developer: HIS MX Properties 🏛 Architect: Zepto 🎨 Interiors: C&C Design 📅 Delivery Date: 14 months from construction start 📍 Location: Consciente, Nuevo Tulum ⛲️ Amenities: Elevated rooftop lap pool with waterfall feature Main swimming pool with sun deck Outdoor fire pit lounge Private gym Covered carport Floor-to-ceiling glazing throughout Integrated jungle landscape design Architectural concrete construction Beach club access (Community Conscious) Cenote club access (Conscious community) 24/7 security Gated community ‍ 📏 Lot size: 1,607.29 m² (17,300 sqft) 📏 Built area (interior): 233 m² (2,508 sqft) 📏 Built area (covered terrace): 210 m² (2,261 sqft) 📏 Pool area: 147 m² (1,582 sqft) 📏 Total developed area: ~590 m² (6,350 sqft) 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 🛁 Bathrooms: 💵 Total Price: $2.4 Million USD ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask for payment plans and discount. 💸 Financing: Most of our clients prefer to raise funds in their home country and pay in cash. 📑 Legal: Trust (title held in trust, standard for foreign buyers in the restricted zone) 🏗 Status: Pre-construction, building permits approved

Casa Tankah 8 Bedroom Villa A short walk from the Caribbean shoreline, Casa Tankah offers something increasingly rare in the Riviera Maya: a turnkey income property with real room to grow. This second-row residence pairs direct beach access with a layout built for flexibility, working equally well as a private family compound or a revenue-generating boutique operation. Surrounded by mature tropical landscaping, the setting feels private and established while sitting within one of Tulum's most sought-after coastal corridors. A Property Built for Flexibility Casa Tankah sits on approximately 1,000 m² of land with 700 m² of built area, arranged around a central garden anchored by a full-size swimming pool and a shaded palapa. The main structure divides into three independent residences, each with its own character and entrance. The ground-floor two-bedroom apartment opens directly to the garden through large sliding doors, with both bedrooms en suite and an open kitchen and living area. Above it, a second two-bedroom residence follows a similar plan but adds elevated living, with a private terrace, plunge pool, and partial ocean views. The third residence spans two levels and holds three bedrooms. The ground floor is set up for daily living with an open kitchen, living area, and a bedroom with full and half bathrooms. Upstairs, two further bedrooms are en suite, one positioned to capture ocean views. Each residence connects to the shared garden and pool. A Separate Casita A standalone one-bedroom casita adds a fourth living space, complete with kitchenette, full bathroom, and its own private pool. The casita works as an owner's retreat, a premium short-term rental, or staff accommodation, giving the property a further layer of versatility. Proven Income, Clear Upside Only a portion of the property has been actively rented in recent years, generating roughly $75,000 USD annually. With the full property brought into operation, and with land still available for additional construction, there is clear room to scale rental income or reposition the property as a boutique hospitality offering. For a buyer looking at a proven rental market, the combination of established cash flow and expansion potential makes the case on its own. 📁 Property: Casa Tankah 8 Bedroom Villa 📅 Status: Income-producing, available now 📍 Location: Tankah Bay, Tulum, Quintana Roo, 77772 🏖 Position: Second row, direct beach access ⛲️ Features: Four independent living spaces (three in main building, one casita) Full-size central swimming pool and shaded palapa Private plunge pool (second residence) Private pool (small house) Mature tropical landscaping Multiple ocean-view positions Room for additional construction 🛏 Bedrooms: 8 🛁 Bathrooms: 8 📏 Size sqm: 700 m² built / 1,000 m² lot 📐 Size sqft: 7,534 sqft built / 10,763 sqft lot 💰 Annual Rental Income: Approx. 💵 Total Price: $1,550,000 USD ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options. ‍

Finished property. Kaahal - Luxury Mexican Villa (Consciente, Nuevo Tulum) Kaahal is a 483.37 m² luxury villa within the Consciente development in Nuevo Tulum, designed around a single idea: interaction with nature. Built to a 23% construction footprint, the home leaves the surrounding jungle largely intact, generating a connection between the resident and the environment rather than clearing it away. Spread across three levels in light and gray tones, avant-garde concrete, wood detailing, and Mayan stone, it reads as a contemporary sanctuary minutes from Tulum's beach and cenote clubs. Arrival and Social Areas Entry is on foot through a double-height access lit by a skylight, with a 52 cm water mirror marking the threshold into the house and sliding doors leading through to the interior. The social area is open-plan, holding living room, dining, and kitchen under a 2.70 m ceiling, with the kitchen served by a second entrance for staff and deliveries. Outdoor Living The outdoor area centers on a 29 m², 1.40 m-deep pool with an adjacent terrace and a fire pit. The south-facing wall was purpose-built as a projection surface for open-air screenings, giving the space a flexible entertainment function on top of its everyday use. Bedrooms and Master Suite The bedroom level holds two east-side bedrooms, each with closet, private bathroom, and a shared terrace, plus a west bedroom with walk-in closet and double-sink bathroom, all at 2.70 m ceiling height. A multipurpose room on the west side can be configured to the owner's needs. On the top level, the master suite occupies its own floor with a private terrace, a jacuzzi overlooking the jungle, walk-in closet, private bathroom, and minibar. The house also includes a half bathroom, a laundry area behind the kitchen, two parking spaces, and a dedicated space for solar panel installation. Built for the Region Construction uses traditional regional materials and systems: masonry footings, reinforced concrete columns and beams, and confined hollow-block walls. Finishes run to Eurovent aluminum sliding doors with tempered glass, Tzalam and Parota carpentry, wood-look porcelain floors, black quarry stair cladding, and Mayan stone feature walls. The villa runs on well-fed potable water through a softening and filtration system, with rainwater capture and a septic system, and the kitchen comes equipped with grill, refrigerator, dishwasher, ice maker, wine cellar, and oven. An Investment Case Beyond private use, Kaahal is positioned as a turnkey rental asset. The development is run as a managed rental programme, with butler and concierge services and a presence across Airbnb, Booking.com, Hotels.com, and Vrbo. 📅 Year: 2024📍 Location: Consciente, Nuevo Tulum, Quintana Roo🚗 Access: Cenote Club 1 min · Beach Club 5 min · Hotel Zone 5 min · Lagoon Club 20 min · Airport 30 min🌿 Design: 23% construction footprint, jungle-integrated, three levels ⛲️ Features: 29 m² pool (1.40 m deep) with terrace and fire pit Master suite with private terrace, jacuzzi, walk-in closet, minibar Projection wall for open-air screenings Double-height skylit entry with water mirror Multipurpose / flexible room Private spa, gym, yoga area, indoor farm (development amenities) Cenote, lagoon, and beach club access 24/7 security Solar panel provision Well water with softening and filtration, rainwater capture 2 parking spaces 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 + multipurpose room (master suite + 2 bedrooms) 🛁 Bathrooms: 3 full + 1 half 📏 Size sqm: 483.37 m² construction 📐 Size sqft: 5,203 sqft construction 💵 Total Price: 📈 Rental Projections (per development): Daily rate: $830–$2,250 (seasonal) ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options. ‍

Villa Akumal - 7 Bedroom Beachfront Villa, Akumal Set directly on the Caribbean in Akumal Sur, with 50 feet of private beachfront, Villa Akumal is a three-level luxury villa built for large groups and gatherings. Seven en-suite bedrooms sleep up to 20–22 guests, while the open living and dining areas face the sea and the villa's signature feature: an indoor-outdoor pool that flows from the living room straight onto a sun-washed terrace. A Layout Built for Groups The villa spans three floors. The main entrance, living room, kitchen, dining, pool, and garden sit on the second floor, alongside one bedroom with two queen beds. The third floor holds three bedrooms, including the master with a king bed and sea views, a second king room with sea views, and a room with two queen beds facing the jungle and ocean. The ground floor holds three further bedrooms. Every bedroom has a private bathroom, plus a guest bathroom on the second floor. In total the villa offers four king beds and six queen beds across ten sleeping spaces. The Indoor-Outdoor Pool The standout feature is a pool that begins inside the living area and continues out beneath a picture window onto the terrace, giving the open living space its distinctive character and an unbroken connection to the outdoors. Air conditioning runs throughout the bedrooms, while the living room stays open to the pool and sea air. Setting and Services The beachfront is a natural mix of sand and rock, with rock formations creating natural swimming pools at the water's edge and a sandy swimmable stretch a short walk away. Daily cleaning is included. A professional private chef and a car with driver are available for additional fees, and the villa is well suited to events such as weddings, photo and video shoots, and private functions. The villa holds six rooms in total, one of which works as a service bedroom or studio, served by four full bathrooms. Palms, hammocks, and a private stretch of beach complete an ultra-private tropical setting, with a swimmable reef just offshore. A Prime, Private Setting Set within a private tropical environment in Tankah Bay, the villa offers total privacy with prime positioning on the Caribbean. It carries clear hospitality and family-compound potential, an established beachfront residence in a location that rarely comes available — now priced to move. 📍 Location: Tankah Bay, Tulum, Quintana Roo (beachfront) 🌊 Beachfront: 25 m of Caribbean frontage · 50 m depth ⛲️ Features: Private beachfront residence with direct beach access Private pool Full kitchen Sala & TV lounge Furnished terraces and beachfront lounge areas Outdoor asador (grill area) Indoor-outdoor living concept Private parking Ultra-private tropical setting 🛏 Bedrooms: 6 total (one usable as service room/studio) 🚿 Bathrooms: 4 full 📏 Lot: 1,000 m² (~10,764 sqft) · Construction: ~320 m² (~3,444 sqft) 💰 Total Price: $1,900,000 USD ‍

Finished property. 4 Bedroom Jungle Villa in Villas Balam, Holistika In the heart of Tulum's sought-after Holistika area, this villa sits inside Villas Balam, a gated complex with 24-hour security set right in the jungle beside Holistika and within easy reach of La Veleta. Spread across three levels, the home blends contemporary architecture with natural materials for a warm, inviting feel that works equally well for full-time living or a high-performing vacation rental. Jungle paths start at the doorstep, while restaurants, beach clubs, and Tulum's wider lifestyle sit just minutes away. A Layout Built for Indoor-Outdoor Living Four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms are distributed across the three floors, with open-concept living and dining areas that flow directly into the outdoor space to maximize natural light and the indoor-outdoor living Tulum is known for. One bedroom is configured with two single beds, making the layout flexible for families or groups. Parota wood sofas and a matching table anchor the living spaces in natural texture. Private Pool and Rooftop Outside, a private swimming pool and lush garden create a secluded oasis for relaxing or entertaining in total privacy. Up top, a rooftop terrace with a shaded chill-out area takes in the surrounding canopy, with a wet bar setup including a sink and refrigerator for easy entertaining above the trees. A Wellness-Oriented Setting Holistika is one of Tulum's most desirable residential areas, a peaceful, wellness-oriented environment wrapped in jungle yet close to everything that defines the town. 📍 Location: Villas Balam, Holistika, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🏡 Setting: Gated community, 24-hour security, jungle-side ⛲️ Features: Private swimming pool Rooftop terrace with shaded chill-out area Wet bar with sink and refrigerator Lush private garden Open-concept living and dining Parota wood furnishings Three-level layout Private parking High-speed WiFi Gated complex with 24-hour security Jungle paths at the doorstep 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 (one with two single beds) 🛁 Bathrooms: 4.5 📏 Construction: 260 m² (~2,799 sqft) · Lot: 320 m² (~3,444 sqft)💵 Total Price: $550,000 ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options. ‍

desc.en: Finished property. 4 Bedroom Jungle Villa for sale in Selvazama, Tulum | Casa Cinq Set inside Mondo, a gated enclave of just eleven custom homes within the Selvazama master community, Casa Cinq is a fully furnished, move-in-ready villa wrapped in dense jungle a short drive from Tulum's beaches, cenotes and restaurants. Designed by an award-winning architect and finished across three levels plus a rooftop, it's built for both deep privacy and easy entertaining. Jungle privacy, engineered ‍Lush vegetation forms a natural barrier around the lot, giving the home unusual solitude for a community setting. A private entrance with 24/7 security opens to a courtyard with water and fire features set among century-old trees. The architecture steps up through the canopy, with floor-to-ceiling Serie 70 aluminum framing and 10mm toughened glass pulling the jungle into every room. Two pools and rooftop living ‍The villa carries two pools — one at garden level off the main terrace, and a rooftop pool with a flush deck and chill-out area framed by treetops. Outdoor patios, built-in fire pits, hammocks and a soaking tub off the primary suite extend the living space outward at every level. Finished and furnished to a high spec ‍Interiors run on a warm natural palette: Tzalam wood, Fiorito travertine, Chukum paste finishes and San Gabriel granite, with a state-of-the-art kitchen, indirect false-ceiling lighting, walk-in closets and matte black fixtures throughout. GigNet fiber, concierge services, private chef and in-house spa are available on request. 📍 Location: Mondo, Selvazama, Tulum, Quintana Roo (gated; ~10 min to central Tulum; ~10-min walk to Jaguar National Park) ⛲️ Features: Two pools (garden-level + rooftop with flush deck) Rooftop terrace with chill-out / lounge area Private courtyard with water + fire features Private gated entrance, 24/7 security Floor-to-ceiling glass, jungle-facing showers Built-in fire pits, hammocks, soaking tub off primary State-of-the-art kitchen, walk-in closets GigNet fiber; concierge, private chef, spa on request Fully furnished, move-in ready 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 🛁 Bathrooms: 4.5 📏 Size: 260 m² interior / 555 m² total (2,799 sqft interior / 5,974 sqft total) [marketing figures per brochure p.41; architect's area schedule totals differ — confirm advertised number] · Lot (Lote 5): 348.34 m² (3,750 sqft) 💵 Total Price: $1,800,000 USD 🔒 Community: Mondo — 11 custom homes, gated, 24/7 security, inside Selvazama 📅 Status: Delivered — fully furnished, built and move-in ready ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options.

Pre-construction. 7 Bedroom architect-designed villa for sale in Mirador Tulum | Casa Sky| Under Construction Casa Sky rises four levels above the Tulum jungle in the Mirador Tulum community, a wellness-led villa designed by V Taller around a simple idea: lift living toward the treetops. The architecture splits the house into two stone-and-concrete volumes separated by water, drawing the landscape inward at every level until the climb resolves on a rooftop of cold plunge, jacuzzi, sauna, and steam, open to the canopy. Built across ground floor, two bedroom levels, and a full wellness rooftop, the house pairs Mayan-rooted materials with a vertical, light-filled plan. The architecture V Taller's design works in concrete, chukum, stone, and wood, with hand-laid stone walls grounding the lower floors and warmer plaster and timber rising through the upper levels. Two volumes are bridged by water, and floor-to-ceiling glazing keeps every room open to the surrounding jungle. The result reads as part ruin, part sanctuary, a house that feels carved into its setting rather than placed on it. Bedrooms and suites The villa is organised as seven bedrooms across the upper floors, including three separate master suites, an unusually generous configuration for a house of this footprint. Bedrooms open to private window-seats and tree-level views, and the principal suite extends to a sunken stone bath set into the canopy. The wellness rooftop The rooftop is the summit of the concept: a cold plunge and hot jacuzzi set against open jungle, a sauna and steam room, a wellness pavilion, and a terrace built for stillness above the trees. Below, the ground floor centres on a pool with a waterfall feature flowing toward the boundary wall, framed by an open kitchen-living core that folds out to the landscape. Location Mirador Tulum sits among notable neighbours and offers a setting balanced between jungle seclusion and access. The community places the villa within reach of Tulum's beach, the archaeological zone, and the area's newest cultural and infrastructure developments. 📍 Location: Mirador Tulum, Tulum, Quintana Roo ⛲️ Features: Rooftop cold plunge and hot jacuzzi Rooftop sauna, steam room, and wellness pavilion Ground-floor pool with waterfall feature Two stone-and-concrete volumes separated by water Three master suites Floor-to-ceiling glazing and indoor-outdoor living throughout Concrete, chukum, stone, and wood material palette Architecture by V Taller🛏 Bedrooms: 7 (including three master suites)🛁 Bathrooms: 8📏 Size: 4,088 sqft / 380 m² (379.79 m² per architect schedule) 💵 Total Price: $1,700,000 USD ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options. 📅 Status: Under construction, estimated completion January 2027. Delivered furnished. ‍ ‍

desc.en: Pre-construction. 6 Bedroom villa for sale in Mirador Tulum | Casa Aqualuna | Under Construction ‍ The architecture Hand laid stone façades, deep arches, and timber screens give the villa the weight of something that has always belonged to the jungle, while floor-to-ceiling glazing keeps the interiors open to greenery on every side. The plan stacks living and kitchen on the entry level around a central pond, bedrooms across the middle floor, and a primary suite, spa, sauna, steam, and gym on the upper level, before resolving on a rooftop built for gathering. The rooftop The rooftop is the centrepiece: boasting the largest Pool In Tulum with integrated spa and plunge, spillway edges, a covered bar, and a sunken lounge set around a fire feature, all framed by pergola greenery and open jungle views. Wellness and living Beyond the rooftop, the house is organised around slowing down: a dedicated gym and yoga space, sauna, steam, spa and plunge on the upper floor, a media room, an open kitchen-dining-living core that folds out to the backyard, and a primary suite with a sculptural stone bathroom. Mirador Tulum's setting adds a cultural layer, with the Maya ruins, the new Jaguar Park and Maya Train station, the Faena District, and Tulum 101 all close neighbours. 📍 Location: Mirador Tulum, Tulum, Quintana Roo ⛲️ Features: Rooftop pool with spa, plunge, and spillway edges Rooftop bar and sunken fire-pit lounge Gym and yoga level with sauna, steam, and spa Ground-floor reflecting pond and indoor-outdoor living Media room Hand-laid stone architecture by AIA-recognised Hudgins Design Group Caretaker's/staff room ~10-minute walk to the beach 🛏 Bedrooms: 6 🛁 Bathrooms: 7 Size: 4,084 sqft / 380 m² Total Price: $1,500,000 USD ‍ ⏳ Payment Plan: Ask your broker about available payment and financing options ‍

Finished property. Casa Arka is one of Tulum's most distinguished estates. A private sanctuary tucked into the jungle just five minutes from the beach, built for those who refuse to choose between nature and luxury. Secured within a gated community under 24/7 surveillance, the home is a masterwork of architecture, pairing rustic, earthy materials with modern elegance to create something both grounded in its surroundings and unmistakably rare. Across 9,332 square feet, every space is composed to dissolve the line between indoor and outdoor living. A Layout Built for Connection and Privacy With 9 bedrooms and 11 bathrooms, Casa Arka is made to host on a grand scale without anyone surrendering their own retreat. Rooms are arranged for intimacy and quiet, finished throughout in natural stone and warm woods that carry the home's earthy-yet-luxurious character. Sleep underneath the stars or slumber in the royal pool chambers — Casa Arka offers more than one way to rest in the heart of the jungle. A Rooftop Oasis The rooftop is the home's crowning feature: a fully furnished Zen garden anchored by an infinity pool, with a firepit offering uninterrupted 360-degree views over the canopy. It is a space made equally for slow mornings and evenings beneath the open sky. Resort Living, Privately Held Beyond the rooftop, the amenities rival those of any five-star resort — two pools, a private heated jacuzzi for sixteen, a fire lounge, cabana lounges, a theatre and cinema room, an exquisite bar, and the home's famous waterfall with indoor rainfall. Thoughtful infrastructure keeps it effortless: central air conditioning, Starlink WiFi, a backup power generator, an outdoor dining room, and four parking spaces. Daily life inside Casa Arka is closer to a private resort than a residence. Singular by the Jungle Casa Arka is offered to a discerning few. Properties of this scale and singularity rarely come to market in Tulum, and even more rarely fully realized. Private viewings are available by appointment. 📍 Location: Region 15, Calle 39, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Five minutes from the beach, gated community ⛲️ Features: Two swimming pools Rooftop infinity pool in a fully furnished Zen garden Private heated jacuzzi (16 persons) Rooftop firepit with 360° views Theatre / cinema room Fire lounge and cabana lounges Exquisite bar Famous waterfall and indoor rainfall Outdoor dining room Central AC, Starlink WiFi, backup generator 4 parking spaces Fully furnished Gated community & 24/7 security 🛏 Bedrooms: 9 🛁 Bathrooms: 11 📏 Size: 867 m² (~9,332 sqft) 💵 Total Price: $4,800,000 USD ‍

Parcela 155 | 2.62-Acre Residential Lot Near Tulum's Hotel Zone Parcela 155 is a rare, large-format residential lot of 10,620.44 m² (approximately 2.62 acres) positioned within one of Tulum's most strategically located private enclaves, just 600 meters from the beach and five minutes from the town of Tulum. Set at the front of the new hotel road and directly across from Tulum's next shopping area, this is one of the closest sizable land holdings to the Hotel Zone — a section of coastline that draws the bulk of the region's tourism through its famous beach clubs, restaurants, and nightlife. This is land with genuine optionality. At 2.62 acres, Parcela 155 is large enough to support a flagship private estate, a boutique multi-villa development, or a high-appreciation land hold in a corridor where comparable beach-proximate inventory is scarce and tightly held. The lot is residential-only, electricity and fiber optic ready, and surrounded by a wave of established and emerging luxury communities — Beecheii, Losantos, NIDO, Ramia, Consciente, The Awen, and Ahimsa — many of which have sold out within 18 to 24 months of launch. Tulum's fundamentals continue to strengthen around this location. The new Tulum International Airport (an estimated 5.5 million passengers per year) and the Maya Train, with its Tulum station, have transformed regional access, while property values in the wider area have climbed substantially since 2020. With the surrounding parcels (81 and 82) already sold, Parcela 155 represents one of the last opportunities of its size in the immediate vicinity. 📍 Location: Soy Tulum, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: 600m from the beach, front of the new hotel road, 5 minutes from Tulum town ⛲️ Key Features: 10,620.44 m² (≈2.62 acres) — rare large-format lot 600 meters from the beach Front of the new hotel road Electricity and fiber optic ready 5 minutes from the town of Tulum Residential only Directly across from the upcoming shopping area Minutes from Tulum's Hotel Zone, beach clubs, and nightlife Close to Tulum Airport and the Maya Train station 📏 Lot Size sqm: 10,620.44 m² 📐 Lot Size: ≈2.62 acres ‍ ‍

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Coco is a modern four-bedroom villa set in the heart of Aldea Zamá, one of Tulum's most desirable and walkable neighborhoods — just steps from the area's vibrant commercial strip of shops, restaurants, and cafés. Designed around open spaces and natural light, the home strikes a balance between contemporary architecture, comfort, and privacy, capturing the tropical essence of Tulum with the polish of a high-end residence. Designed for Indoor-Outdoor Living Across 350 m² of construction on a 460 m² lot, Villa Coco centers on a modern open-concept kitchen and living area that flows out to a private swimming pool and an outdoor terrace built for dining and entertaining. Premium finishes, natural materials, and lush tropical landscaping carry a warm, design-forward aesthetic throughout, while secure parking adds everyday ease. Four Private Suites The villa offers four spacious bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a guest powder room for 4.5 bathrooms in total — a layout suited equally to hosting family and friends or maximizing rental appeal. A Prime Aldea Zamá Investment It works as a full-time residence, a vacation home, or a turnkey investment property — a rare combination of design, lifestyle, and value in Tulum's most sought-after area. 📍 Location: Aldea Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Walking distance to the Aldea Zamá commercial area ⛲️ Features: Private swimming pool Outdoor terrace for dining and entertaining Modern open-concept kitchen and living area Premium finishes and natural materials Lush tropical landscaping Secure parking 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 (each en-suite) 🛁 Bathrooms: 4.5 📏 Lot Size: 460 m² 🏠 Construction: 350 m² 💵 Price: Reduced: $1,050,000 USD ‍

Pre-construction. Casa Santo Tomás is an expansive six-bedroom residence in Región 8, one of Tulum's fastest-growing and most coveted areas. Conceived around a single sprawling floor plan with room to grow, the home blends warm desert-modern architecture with refined materials and seamless indoor-outdoor living — a design-forward sanctuary built for both grand entertaining and everyday privacy. Designed for Single-Level Living, Built to Grow Set across 750 m² (8,073 sq ft) of construction on a single level, Casa Santo Tomás is designed so only 30% of its generous lot is built upon — preserving open space, light, and tranquility. The layout offers the option to expand onto a second level for additional bedrooms, a gym, a games room, an office, and a rooftop terrace, giving owners a rare blank canvas to tailor the home to their lifestyle. Six Private Suites The residence offers six spacious bedrooms, each with its own private bathroom, plus a guest powder room for 6.5 bathrooms in total — a layout suited equally to hosting extended family and friends or maximizing rental appeal. Everyday Ease and Effortless Entertaining Casa Santo Tomás is engineered for comfortable living and memorable gatherings, with a three-car garage for cars or motorcycles, a service room, and a dedicated storage bodega. An outdoor dining area anchored by a grill, plancha, and ice machine extends the living space into the open air, framed by the warm, design-forward aesthetic that carries throughout. Customize Your Sanctuary A suite of optional upgrades lets owners elevate the property to a full private resort: a pickleball court, mini golf, an indoor golf simulator, an outdoor sauna, and a home cinema are all available at additional cost. A Rare Región 8 Opportunity Offered at a reduced preconstruction price, Casa Santo Tomás sits in one of Tulum's highest-potential corridors — ideal as a full-time residence, a vacation home, or a turnkey investment property. It's a rare combination of scale, design, and value in a rapidly appreciating area. 📍 Location: Región 8, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌵 Position: One of Tulum's fastest-growing residential corridors ⛲️ Features: Single-level layout with option to expand to a second level + rooftop Three-car garage (cars/motorcycles) Service room and storage bodega Outdoor dining area with grill, plancha, and ice machine Premium finishes and natural materials Only 30% lot coverage for maximum open space and privacy ✨ Optional Upgrades (additional cost): Pickleball court · Mini golf · Golf simulator · Outdoor sauna · Cinema 🛏 Bedrooms: 6 (each en-suite) 🛁 Bathrooms: 6.5 📏 Lot Size: From 1,500 m² (16,146 sq ft) 🏠 Construction: 750 m² (8,073 sq ft) 💵 Price: From $31.5M MXN (~$1,800,000 USD) — reduced preconstruction price 🗓 Delivery: 18 months ‍

Finished property. SLS Marina Beach Residence 204 is a refined three-bedroom home inside one of Puerto Cancún's most exclusive oceanfront towers — a 20-story architectural landmark in the gated enclave of Novo Cancún. Designed by Grow Arquitectos in collaboration with the renowned international firm Meyer Davis, the tower houses 104 residences with access to world-class services and Caribbean views. Unit 204 captures that vision in a fully equipped, move-in-ready home — ideal for full-time living or as a high-value vacation property. Designed for Seaside Living Across 192.73 m² (2,074 sq ft), Residence 204 offers an open-plan living and dining area framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and an expansive terrace with ocean and marina views. The interiors carry elegant contemporary design, high-end finishes, and premium materials throughout, with the polish expected of an SLS address. Contemporary kitchens are appointed with premium European cabinetry, imported stone countertops, and stainless steel appliances, while the spacious bathrooms feature glass-enclosed showers and designer fixtures. Three Private Bedrooms The residence offers three spacious bedrooms and five bathrooms in total, plus a dedicated service room with its own private bathroom — a layout suited equally to hosting family and guests or maximizing rental appeal. A World-Class Address Set within a 24-hour gated community, residents enjoy exclusive access to a private beach club with its own restaurants and a marina with 175 slips. Puerto Cancún also offers an 18-hole Tom Weiskopf golf course, more than 50,000 m² of shopping with over 100 shops and boutiques, a variety of restaurants, a 16-theater cinema, and 24-hour entertainment. On-site amenities include an infinity-edge pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, spa and wellness facilities, concierge and hotel-style service, and round-the-clock security. SLS Membership Privileges Ownership unlocks a world of sbe membership benefits, including VIP membership to sbe's worldwide network of hotels and restaurants, preferred seating at sbe restaurants, complimentary anniversary nights at sbe properties, and discounts on rooms, dining, and spa services. 📍 Location: Marina Puerto Cancún, Novo Cancún, Cancún, Quintana Roo 🌊 Position: Oceanfront, inside a 24-hour gated community ⛲️ Features: Open-plan living and dining with floor-to-ceiling windows Expansive terrace with ocean and marina views European kitchen with imported stone and stainless steel appliances Service room with private bathroom Fully furnished and equipped Direct beach club access, infinity pool, spa, fitness center, concierge 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 🛁 Bathrooms: 5 + service bathroom 📏 Total Area: 192.73 m² (2,074 sq ft) 🏢 Building: 20 stories · 104 residences · designed by Grow Arquitectos & Meyer Davis 💵 Price: $24,000,000 MXN (~$1,368,000 USD) ‍

Finished property. Nare House is a hidden sanctuary in the heart of Tulum's lush La Veleta neighborhood — a refined three-bedroom residence that blends modern architecture with tropical tranquility. Thoughtfully designed for elevated indoor-outdoor living, the home wraps around a private plunge pool framed by greenery, just moments from the Holistika wellness retreat, new direct beach access, and Tulum's international airport. Designed for Indoor-Outdoor Living Across 243 m² (2,616 sq ft) of interior space on a 314 m² (3,380 sq ft) lot, Nare House centers on an expansive open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area that flows effortlessly onto a covered patio and outdoor lounge. Soaring double-height stone walls, warm-toned plaster, handcrafted accents, and natural textures carry an earthy, design-forward elegance throughout, while floor-to-ceiling glass dissolves the line between interior comfort and the surrounding jungle. Three Private Suites Across Two Levels The ground-floor primary suite is a tranquil retreat with a double-vanity ensuite and direct access to the pool and garden. Upstairs, two beautifully appointed guest suites each include a private bathroom — a south-facing room with a double bed and a north-facing room with a queen — opening onto an airy void above the main level. A discreet powder room and dedicated laundry add everyday ease, for 2.5 bathrooms in total. Rooftop, Pool & Patio A sun-soaked rooftop terrace invites quiet mornings and sunset gatherings, while the infinity-edge plunge pool and shaded outdoor lounge anchor the home's social heart — ideal for entertaining or unwinding in privacy. A Prime La Veleta Investment Set in one of Tulum's most vibrant and evolving neighborhoods, steps from Holistika and a newly built direct road to the beach and Hotel Zone (6.3 km), Nare House works equally as a full-time residence, vacation home, or turnkey rental investment. 📍 Location: Calle 4 Lote 9, Holistika / La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Steps from Holistika; 6.3 km direct access to the beach, 39.9 km to Tulum airport ⛲️ Features: Infinity-edge private plunge pool Covered patio and outdoor lounge Open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area sun-soaked rooftop terrace Double-height stone feature walls and natural finishes Dedicated laundry 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 (each en-suite) 🛁 Bathrooms: 2.5 📏 Lot Size: 314 m² (3,380 sq ft) 🏠 Interior: 243 m² (2,616 sq ft) 💵 Price: $625,000 USD ‍

Finished property. Casa Apolo is a newly completed, move-in-ready residence tucked into the lush jungle of the gated Beecheii community in Tulum. Defined by clean concrete lines, warm microcement finishes, and walls of black-framed glass that dissolve into the surrounding canopy, this single-level home is a study in calm, contemporary design — built for seamless indoor-outdoor living in one of Tulum's most nature-forward, low-density developments. Designed for Indoor-Outdoor Living The heart of the home is a soaring double-height great room where the kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together beneath polished concrete ceilings and open directly onto the terrace through full-height sliding glass. A dramatic glass-corner gallery frames the jungle and pool from nearly every angle, flooding the interior with natural light. Outside, a private plunge pool and covered terrace sit against a hand-laid Mayan stone boundary wall, wrapped in native trees for total privacy. Three Private Suites & Spa-Style Baths Laid out across a single level, Casa Apolo offers three spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms in total. Bedrooms open to the greenery through floor-to-ceiling glass, while the bathrooms carry a refined, minimalist aesthetic — backlit mirrors, microcement vanities, black stone vessel sinks, and built-in soaking tubs positioned to look out into the jungle. Move-In Ready in Beecheii Unlike most of Tulum's preconstruction offerings, Casa Apolo is finished and ready to occupy. Set on a generous 471.86 m² (5,079 sq ft) lot within the established, low-density Beecheii development, it's ideally suited as a full-time residence, vacation home, or turnkey rental investment. 📍 Location: Beecheii, Tulum, Quintana Roo (Lote 84) 🌳 Position: Gated, low-density jungle community with native landscaping and stone privacy walls ⛲️ Features: Private plunge pool Covered outdoor terrace Single-level, open-concept living, kitchen & dining Double-height ceilings with floor-to-ceiling black-framed glass Microcement finishes and polished concrete Mayan stone boundary walls Built-in soaking tubs with jungle views Private garden 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 🛁 Bathrooms: 3.5 📏 Lot Size: 471.86 m² (5,079 sq ft) 🏠 Construction: 221 m² (2,379 sq ft) 🏠 Status: Built and move-in ready 💵 Price: $12,000,000 MXN (~$684,000 USD) ‍

Finished property. 📍 La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico Set on coveted Calle 7 Sur — one of La Veleta's most sought-after streets — this expansive three-bedroom residence inside the boutique Bohemian development brings together a prime address, contemporary design, and an unmistakably Tulum way of living. The neighborhood that surrounds it is the heartbeat of the town's wellness culture: renowned yoga studios, spas, holistic centers, and a standout culinary scene are all within walking distance, while direct access to Avenida Kukulkán puts the beaches and Hotel Zone just 10 to 15 minutes away. Bohemian is an intimate community of only 28 residences, conceived for those who want privacy, space, and a refined tropical lifestyle without sacrificing connectivity. Inside, an open-concept living and dining area flows out to dual panoramic terraces framed by lush jungle canopy, while a fully equipped kitchen with a central island anchors the social space. Bright, Open, and Built for LivingThe home is bathed in natural light throughout, with a spacious and functional layout that lives larger than its footprint. The primary suite opens to its own private terrace — a quiet perch above the treetops — and a second social terrace connects directly to the living area for effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. Premium finishes, warm tropical woods, and curated artisanal details give every room a sense of place. Rooftop Pool & LoungeResidents enjoy a shared rooftop amenity with a pool, sun loungers, shaded pergola seating, and open jungle and lagoon-side views — a true sanctuary for unwinding under the Caribbean sky. Finished property. MZA 18, Lotes 3-4-5 | 1,389 m² Triple-Lot Assembly in La Veleta, Tulum MZA 18 is a rare assembly of three contiguous titled lots, Lotes 3, 4 and 5 combining into a single 1,389 m² parcel in La Veleta, one of Tulum's most sought-after and fastest-appreciating neighborhoods. Just off Calle 7, the bohemian dining-and-nightlife spine of the district, the lot pairs walkable, in-demand location with a build-ready footprint rarely available at this scale. The parcel sits among finished luxury product surrounded by completed villas, boutique residences, and condo-hotels confirming both the area's trajectory and the lot's build-ready context. With titled, deedable land and the flexibility of a triple-lot footprint, MZA 18 offers exceptional optionality in a corridor where inventory of this size is scarce and tightly held. La Veleta has become Tulum's creative heart, a low rise, jungle laced neighborhood prized for its walkability, design-forward builds, and concentration of celebrated restaurants and bars. The lot is steps from the Calle 7 corridor (Il Bacaro, La Pizzine, Veleta Market, Mistico Garden) and minutes from Aldea Zamá's amenities and the Tulum town center, with the beach and Hotel Zone a short drive east. Tulum's fundamentals continue to compound around this location. The new Tulum International Airport (an estimated 5.5 million passengers per year) and the Maya Train have transformed regional access, while property values across La Veleta have climbed substantially since 2020. With land of this size tightly held in one of the area's most established residential pockets, MZA 18 is a low-risk entry into a corridor with proven, durable demand. 📍 Location: La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Steps off Calle 7, La Veleta's dining and nightlife corridor; minutes from Aldea Zamá and Tulum town ⛲️ Key Features: 1,389 m² (≈14,951 sq ft) — triple-lot assembly (Lotes 3, 4 & 5) Titled and deedable, ready for construction Flexible canvas: single estate, multi-villa build, or rental project Walkable to Calle 7 restaurants, bars, and Veleta Market Ringed by finished luxury villas, residences, and condo-hotels Minutes from Aldea Zamá, Tulum town, and the beach road 📏 Lot Size sqm: 1,389 m² 📐 Lot Size: ≈14,951 sq ft 💵 Price: $150,000 USD ‍ ‍

Finished property. Walk to everything in Aldea Zamá. PRANA sits within a short stroll of the district's main avenue, its restaurants, cafés, and commercial spaces, the most established and most walkable master-planned neighborhood in Tulum, where the paving, services, and rental demand were all dialed in years ago. This is the part of town buyers reach for when they want a home that holds value rather than a bet on a corridor that hasn't been built yet. A move-in-ready unit, fully furnished. Unit 305 is turnkey: furnished, equipped, and ready to generate from day one. The open-plan living, dining, and kitchen flows out to the building's signature feature, a sinuous lagoon-style pool wrapped in palms and native planting, with a shaded palapa lounge. Inside, the finishes lean warm and tactile: stone accent walls, timber cabinetry, granite counters, and a calm, neutral palette that photographs beautifully for short-term rental listings. The rooftop is the story. Unit 305 is a top-level layout crowned by a private 50.7 m² / 546 sq ft solarium, a rooftop terrace with its own plunge pool and lounge deck, the kind of private outdoor space that commands premium nightly rates and rarely sits empty on a booking calendar. Add a private parking space and you have a unit built for the vacation-rental market or a low-maintenance second home. The investment case. Aldea Zamá remains Tulum's benchmark address, the same district where projects like Aldea Premium and the early sold-out phases of Zamá set the pace for the whole town. With Tulum International Airport now open and the Maya Train threading the Riviera Maya together, the fundamentals under this location keep getting stronger while the neighborhood itself is already finished and proven. A furnished, rental-ready penthouse with a private rooftop pool, at this price, in this district, is a rare combination. 📍 Location: PRANA, Aldea Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🏡 Type: Condo apartment, top-floor unit with private solarium 🛏️ Bedrooms: 2 🛁 Bathrooms: 2 ‍ 🌿 Features: ‍ · private rooftop solarium with plunge pool · lagoon-style community pool · open-plan living/dining/kitchen · granite & timber finishes · walk to Aldea Zamá main avenue ‍ 🅿️ Parking: Private space included (12.5 m² / 135 sq ft) 📐 Total area: 175.2 m² / 1,886 sq ft┗ Apartment 105.23 m² · Balconies 6.75 m² · Solarium 50.72 m² · Parking 12.5 m² 💰 Price: $180,000 USD Acquisition by foreign buyers is held through a bank trust (fideicomiso), standard for property within Mexico's restricted coastal zone. ‍

Land. Náay Tulum | Titled Residential Lots in Región 10, Tulum Land you can build on now, with title in hand. Náay Tulum is a 45-lot urban development on a 17,962 m² parcel in Región 10, one of Tulum's fastest-appreciating and most accessible growth corridors, minutes from Tulum Centro, La Veleta, and a new commercial center rising on the doorstep. This is one of the rare offerings in Tulum that pairs entry-level land pricing with immediate titling (escrituración inmediata) and permits fully in order, so buyers move from purchase to construction without the legal limbo that stalls so many lots in the region. H4 zoning, the highest density allowed in Tulum. Every lot carries H4 land use, the most generous density classification in the municipality, which is what makes these parcels work equally well for a single-family home, a small condominal building, or a commercial-residential mix on the avenue-facing lots. For an investor, that flexibility is the difference between a lot that holds one house and a lot that can carry a rental-generating development. Infrastructure already in the ground. Fase 1 is delivered with underground electrical, water and drainage, and public lighting already installed, no waiting on services, no surprise assessments. The master plan dedicates 48% of the land to green areas and 22% to andadores and bike paths, a low-density, tree-lined layout that reads more like a park than a subdivision and protects long-term value. The investment case. With Tulum International Airport open and the Maya Train connecting the Riviera Maya, Región 10 sits squarely in the path of the town's outward growth, the same pattern that turned earlier inland districts like La Veleta and Aldea Zamá from raw land into Tulum's most sought-after addresses. Fase 3 has already sold out entirely. Fase 1 and Fase 2 lots remain, priced from $4,999/m², payable in cash (90% on delivery, 10% at closing) or over 18 months interest-free. 📍 Location: Náay Tulum, Mza 776 Lote 4, Región 10, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🏗️ Type: Titled residential lots (unifamiliar, condominal & commercial-residential) 🗺️ Development: 45 lots + 2 macrolots across 3 phases on 17,962 m² / 193,340 sq ft 🌳 Common areas: 48% green space · 22% andadores & bike paths ⚡ Infrastructure: Underground electrical · water & drainage · public lighting (Fase 1 complete) 📜 Zoning: H4 (highest density in Tulum) · immediate title · permits in order ‍ Available lots: 🟢 Fase 1 — from $4,999MXN / m² (15 lots, infrastructure complete, fronting Cotulum)┗ from 198.81 m² / 2,140 sq ft · $993,851 MXN (~$56,800 USD)┗ up to 222.75 m² / 2,398 sq ft · $1,113,527 MXN (~$63,600 USD) 🟢 Fase 2 — from $5,342 MXN / m² (16 lots, fronting the main andador)┗ smaller lots from 209.64 m² / 2,257 sq ft · $1,119,897 MXN (~$64,000 USD)┗ premium lots up to 801.07 m² / 8,623 sq ft · $4,578,916 MXN (~$261,700 USD) 🔴 Fase 3 — SOLD OUT 💰 Entry price: $993,851 MXN (~$56,800 USD) · Lote 30, Fase 1(USD figures at ~17.50 MXN/USD; verify at time of sale) ‍

Spanning 150 square meters across 103 square meters of interior space and a generous 47 square meter terrace, the home is engineered for the way Tulum actually lives, indoors flowing seamlessly to outdoors, privacy balanced against openness. The lock-off configuration is the quiet genius of this property. Both bedrooms function as independent, self contained units, allowing an owner to occupy one suite while renting the other, list both on the nightly market, or host family and guests without compromising privacy. Life here is built around the terrace. A private jacuzzi anchors the outdoor space, framed by the kind of canopy that made Aldea Zama the benchmark for low density luxury in Tulum. Inside, a dedicated TV room, two full bathrooms, and turnkey furnishings mean the residence is ready to generate returns or welcome its owner from day one. Nothing to source, nothing to stage, simply arrive. Aldea Zama remains the anchor of Tulum's investment thesis. Walkable, master planned, and minutes from both the beach corridor and the town center, it is the neighborhood that set the standard others now chase. With the Tulum International Airport now operational and the Maya Train linking the region's marquee destinations, the fundamentals underpinning value here have never been more concrete. This is a position in the community that proved the model. 📍 Location: Aldea Zama, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🏠 Copal Residence, Lock-Off Configuration 🛏️ 2 Bedrooms 🛁 2 Bathrooms 📺 1 TV Room 🛋️ Fully Furnished ♨️ Private Terrace with Jacuzzi 📐 Lot Size: 150 m² / 1,615 sq ft (103 m² / 1,109 sq ft interior + 47 m² / 506 sq ft terrace) 💰 Price: $279,000 USD ‍

Finished property. Casa Don Rey is one of Tulum's most distinguished estates. A private sanctuary tucked into the jungle just eight minutes from the beach, built for those who refuse to choose between nature and luxury. Secured within a gated community under 24/7 surveillance, the home is a masterwork of craftsmanship, pairing bohemian inspiration with eco-chic elegance and natural materials to create something both grounded in its surroundings and unmistakably rare. Across 11,000 square feet, every space is composed to dissolve the line between indoor and outdoor living, steeping you in the culture of Tulum and pulling you back the moment you leave. A Proven Performer Casa Don Rey is among the highest-grossing and most-booked villas in Tulum. Beyond a private residence, it has established itself as a sought-after venue for weddings, corporate retreats, brand activations, photo and film shoots, wellness gatherings, milestone celebrations and private events of every kind. Prospective buyers are encouraged to request the full performance history and verify figures independently. A Layout Built for Connection and Privacy With 11 bedrooms and 14 bathrooms, Casa Don Rey is made to host on a grand scale without anyone surrendering their own retreat. Rooms are arranged for intimacy and quiet, finished throughout in natural materials and warm woods that carry the home's earthy-yet-luxurious character. Casa Don Rey offers more than one way to rest in the heart of the canopy. A Rooftop Oasis The rooftop is among the home's crowning features: a firepit offering uninterrupted 360-degree views over the jungle, made equally for slow mornings and evenings beneath the open sky. Resort Living, Privately Held Beyond the rooftop, the amenities rival those of any five-star resort — two pools, two sunken outdoor living rooms, a private heated jacuzzi for sixteen, a stadium-seating movie theatre, cabana lounge, two full bars, and the home's famous waterfall. The scale and variety of these spaces make the estate as capable of hosting a two-hundred-guest celebration as an intimate family stay. Thoughtful infrastructure keeps it effortless: a heated jungle pool controlled by smart app, central air conditioning, fiber optic WiFi, a backup power generator, staff quarters, a prep kitchen, an outdoor grill and dining room, and three parking spaces. Beneath it all sit the details that make the estate unforgettable: an iconic underwater Buddha statue, a temperature-controlled wine cellar, and an underground chandelier room that feels pulled from a dream. Daily life inside Casa Don Rey is closer to a private resort than a residence. Singular by the Jungle Casa Don Rey is offered to a discerning few. Properties of this scale and singularity rarely come to market in Tulum, and even more rarely fully realized. Private viewings are available by appointment. 📍 Location: Aldea Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo🌴 Position: Eight minutes from the beach, gated community ⛲️ Features: Two swimming pools Two sunken outdoor living rooms Heated jungle pool (smart app controlled) Private heated jacuzzi (16 persons) Rooftop firepit with 360° views Stadium-seating movie theatre Cabana lounge and two full bars Iconic underwater Buddha statue Temperature-controlled wine cellar Staff Quarters with Laundty & Bedroom Underground chandelier room Famous waterfall Outdoor grill and dining room Central AC, fiber optic WiFi, backup generator Staff quarters and prep kitchen 3 parking spaces Fully furnished Gated community & 24/7 security Proven event venue: weddings, corporate retreats, brand activations, film and photo shoots, wellness gatherings and celebrations 🛏 Bedrooms: 11 🛁 Bathrooms: 14 📏 Size: 1,022 m² (~11,000 sqft) 🏗️ Year Built: 2021 💵 Total Price: $3,800,000 USD ‍

desc.en: Finished property. El Gastón is one of Tulum's most theatrical estates. A bold, Roman-inspired sanctuary set within an exclusive gated community just minutes from the beach, conceived for unforgettable stays, private gatherings and high-end events. The home marries dramatic architecture with immersive entertainment spaces and full-service hospitality, a property that performs as readily as it relaxes. Across 9,870 square feet, every space is composed to blur the line between residence and private venue. Built to Host El Gastón is engineered for entertaining at a level few homes can match. With its speakeasy stage, cinema, cenote pool and performance areas, the estate is a proven setting for bachelor and bachelorette parties, milestone birthdays, weddings and receptions, corporate retreats and offsites, brand activations, film and photo shoots, DJ nights and live performances, wellness and yoga gatherings, and private celebrations of every scale. It is as ready for a headline event as it is for a quiet week in the jungle. A Layout Built for Spectacle and Retreat With 7 en-suite bedrooms and 9 bathrooms, El Gastón hosts on a grand scale while giving every guest their own private world. At its heart sits a signature round-bed suite with private hot-tub jacuzzi, and below, an underground aquarium-style suite wrapped in water and light. Hidden passages connect the home's chambers, rewarding the curious and turning a simple stay into an experience. Entertainment Without Equal Few homes anywhere offer this range. A Roman bath jacuzzi crowned by a waterfall, a chandelier lounge, and dedicated poker and pool lounges. Thoughtful infrastructure keeps it all effortless: central air conditioning, fiber optic WiFi, a backup power generator, and 24/7 security within the gated community. The experience includes a private chef, personal butler, concierge, daily cleaning and evening security, a seamless, elevated stay from start to finish. Singular by the Jungle El Gastón is offered to a discerning few. Properties of this scale and imagination rarely come to market in Tulum, and even more rarely fully realized. A fully furnished three-bedroom home set on an independent corner lot within Florafauna, a community of 79 single-family homes built around a central park in Tulum's Tumben Ka neighborhood, designed for those who want comfort, privacy and turnkey ease without compromise. Warm wood finishes, polished concrete textures and lush tropical greenery run throughout, creating a home that feels both grounded in its surroundings and quietly refined. Across 2,615 square feet of indoor space, every room is composed to open toward the garden and dissolve the line between indoor and outdoor living. A Layout Built for Living and Entertaining With 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, Casa Iguana balances comfortable private quarters with expansive shared spaces. The interiors open onto a lush landscaped garden and an elongated private swimming pool, while integrated storage throughout keeps daily life uncluttered. It is a home made equally for slow mornings and easy entertaining. A Rooftop Retreat The rooftop terrace is among the home's defining features: a large roofdeck crowned by a pergola with lounge furniture, an ideal setting for entertaining or quiet evenings above the jungle canopy. Turnkey by Design Casa Iguana is delivered fully furnished and ready to enjoy from day one. Thoughtful infrastructure keeps it effortless: fiber optic internet, underground electricity, full water and sewer services, a complete appliance package including refrigerator, stove, oven, washer and dryer, and 22 installed solar panels for energy efficiency. There are no HOA fees, and residents enjoy complimentary membership benefits at Cinco Beach Club. A Refined Tulum Lifestyle Casa Iguana offers a lifestyle centered on privacy, walkability and community. Tucked into a quiet pocket of jungle within Tumben Ka, it sits a short walk or bike ride from Tulum's favorite restaurants, shops, the beach and the town center, placing the best of Tulum within easy reach while preserving the calm of an established neighborhood. desc.en: Finished property. Tuluminous Beach is unit B208 at Amira, a residential building set into the jungle on the Tulum beach road. The sand is a walk from the door and the ruins sit eight minutes north, above the water. Between them lies the stretch of coast that made this town famous, reachable on foot rather than by car. The beach zone was built for hotels, restaurants and beach clubs. Residential addresses within walking distance of the sand are rare, and they surface on the market rarely. This is one of them. The Apartment Two bedrooms across a single level, finished with a deliberate hand. Coffered ceilings trace recessed gold lines above polished marble floors. A wall of glass slides open onto a private terrace where a suspended egg chair hangs beside a plunge tub, jungle canopy at eye level. The living room runs open to the kitchen and dining area, holding light from morning through late afternoon. Cabinetry in warm timber and pale stone, a breakfast bar under pendant lights, and a full run of counter space. The dining table is the room's anchor, a slab of live edge timber poured with epoxy resin in the exact turquoise of the reef a few hundred meters away, commissioned and shipped from Ukraine. Both bedrooms are quiet, cool and generous, dressed in soft blues against gray plaster, with hand knotted macramé hung above the beds and en suite bathrooms in stone. Air conditioning throughout, ceiling fans in every room. It is sold exactly as it stands. Furniture, kitchen, linens. You arrive with a suitcase. Amira Amira is a low rise development of two buildings connected at roof level by a glass bridge. Each building carries its own rooftop infinity pool, one running the full length of the roof in timber decking and open sky, taking in the Mexican Caribbean on one side and unbroken jungle on the other. Below, the grounds are threaded with a jungle walk and an artificial river running between the two structures. The architecture is chukum and dark timber against limestone, sunk into the canopy rather than set on top of it. Rental History B208 was the first apartment in the building to be finished, the first furnished, the first rented, and the first listed on Airbnb. Its debut year on the platform placed it among the strongest performing rentals in Tulum, and Airbnb featured it in their own organic email campaigns. That listing, with its reviews and its ranking, comes with the apartment. Its first twelve months returned $50,500 USD gross and $40,700 USD net, backed by a month by month statement made available to qualified buyers. The current owner will continue managing the unit at a ten percent fee, well under the regional norm, across both the Airbnb listing and a dedicated direct booking site. Buyers should verify all financial figures independently. 📍 Location: Amira, Tulum Beach Zone, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Walkable to Tulum Beach, eight minutes to the Tulum ruins Features Walking distance to Tulum Beach Two rooftop infinity pools joined by a glass bridge Mexican Caribbean and jungle views from the roof Private terrace with plunge tub and suspended egg chair Coffered ceilings, marble floors, floor to ceiling glass Open plan living, dining and kitchen Two en suite bedrooms with air conditioning Commissioned epoxy resin dining table, imported Fully furnished and turnkey Jungle walk and artificial river through the grounds Established Airbnb listing conveys with the sale Direct booking website included Owner managed at 10% fee 🛏 Bedrooms: 2 🛁 Bathrooms: 2 💵 Price: $440,000 USD ‍

desc.en: Finished property. Casa Calma sits inside La Privada, a gated enclave in Aldea Zama where the pace slows the moment the gate closes behind you. Two levels, three bedrooms, and a pool set into the ground floor, built for people who want Tulum's most walkable address without giving up the quiet. Access is controlled and security runs around the clock. Across 270 square meters, the home is composed with restraint: black framing, concrete screens, warm materials, nothing louder than it needs to be. A Layout Built for Living With 3 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms across two levels, Casa Calma is scaled for a family or a couple who host. A separate service room with its own bathroom keeps the household running without intruding on the living spaces. The ground floor opens onto the pool, and the terrace extends the interior outward under steel and wood pergolas. Specified, Not Retrofitted The upgrade package was built into the home from the start. Black aluminum canceleria frames every opening. Concrete celosia screens filter the afternoon light rather than block it. Black granite runs across the kitchen bars, and the electrical fixtures and grifería carry the same finish throughout. Solar panels handle the load quietly in the background. Amenities Across the Street and Behind the Gate La Privada holds a clubhouse, a pool, and a padel court within the gates. Outside them, restaurants, a fresh market, and convenience stores sit directly across the road. The home also carries an included Ahau Hotels vacation club membership, extending the address well beyond Aldea Zama. Quietly Positioned Aldea Zama is Tulum's master-planned residential district, walkable, serviced, and connected to both the beach road and the town center. La Privada is one of the quieter addresses inside it, and homes at this specification rarely surface here.
