desc.en: Finished property. Bahía Soliman is the bay people find late. It sits north of Tulum behind a reef that flattens the water into something closer to a lagoon than open Caribbean, and the shoreline has stayed low and residential while everything south of it filled in. There are no clubs here and no beach road traffic. There is a bay, a reef, and a short run of houses set back under the palms. NEEA is eight apartments on that beach. The project was designed to sit inside its surroundings rather than announce itself, and the architecture reads as concrete, wood and shade rather than glass and spectacle. Architectural and interior design are by Sebastien Robert. The Residence Unit D-1 01 occupies the first level with three bedrooms across 138.40 m² / 1,489.73 sq ft of interior space, extended by a private roof terrace of 30.40 m² / 327.22 sq ft. Total surface is 168.44 m² / 1,813.07 sq ft. It is delivered completely furnished and ready to occupy. Nothing to specify, nothing to source, nothing to wait for. The material palette runs consistently through the interiors: gray concrete on walls and floors, aged effect walnut, light toned wood on doors and joinery, black concrete on the furniture and in the wall recesses, black marble on the bar countertop. Indirect LED lighting in warm white sits behind the recesses and along the floor line. The living room opens through full height glazing to the water. The Building Eight apartments in total, two, three and four bedroom layouts, all delivered furnished. The ground floor holds the lobby, the beach club, the beach pool and a common area with bar counter, kitchen, dining room and lounge. The roof carries an infinity pool, a bar, a gym, a sauna, a firepit and a catamaran net under a wooden log pergola. Position Tulum Ruins: 12 minutes by car Bahía Príncipe Golf: 17 minutes by car Aldea Zamá: 18 minutes by car Tulum Airport: 48 minutes by car Ownership and Terms The property sits within the federal restricted coastal zone. Foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso (bank trust), the structure that conveys full rights of use, lease, improvement and sale. Our team coordinates the trust setup alongside your counsel. Payment terms per the developer: a reservation of USD $200,000, 90% due on signing of the purchase agreement and physical possession, and the remaining 10% on signing of the deed. Delivery is immediate. 📍 Location: NEEA, Bahía Soliman, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Beachfront on a reef protected bay, first level with private roof terrace ⛲️ Features: Delivered completely furnished and ready to move in Private roof terrace of 30.40 m² / 327.22 sq ft Full height glazing to the water in the living room Concrete, aged effect walnut and light toned wood throughout Indirect warm white LED lighting in recesses and floor line Beach club and beach pool at ground level Rooftop infinity pool, bar, gym, sauna, firepit and catamaran net Eight apartment building on one of Tulum's most private bays Architecture and interiors by Sebastien Robert Immediate delivery 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 📏 Interior: 138.40 m² / 1,489.73 sq ft 📐 Roof terrace: 30.40 m² / 327.22 sq ft 📐 Total: 168.44 m² / 1,813.07 sq ft 💵 Total Price: USD $940,000

Finished property. House Yaxche was built around the trees rather than in place of them. Set on Lot 12 of Casa Verde, a gated community in Region 15, the residence occupies 571 m² / 6,146 sq ft of jungle floor and unfolds across 380 m² / 4,090 sq ft of construction arranged in two volumes that face each other across a courtyard. Trunks rise through the terraces and pass through the slabs. Light arrives already filtered. The house is delivered fully furnished, down to the tzalam beds, the parota millwork and the art on the walls. Arrival Past the community gate, a permeable drive receives two vehicles beneath standing canopy. The lot is bounded by a concrete and stone wall closed at the top with treated railway sleepers, the same detail carried across the front access wall, and washed concrete stepping stones lead in through the planting. A travertine stair climbs the outer face of the front volume to the upper studio. The entry sequence is deliberately slow. You pass through vegetation before you reach any door. The Courtyard The plan folds around a pool finished in green jade below the water line and edged in stone, with loungers set on travertine at the rim. A covered pavilion runs along one flank: recessed shelving, a Weber gas grill, a wood grill, quartz counters and a concrete island long enough for eight stools. Ceiling fans turn under the slab. Every principal room in the house opens onto this space. The Main House Veracruz travertine runs underfoot in long brushed matte lengths, the same stone laid outside so the floor reads continuous through the sliding glass. The living volume holds a full kitchen in parota with a live edge dining table for ten and a bookshelf wall carrying the television. A guest bathroom and laundry sit off the entry. Upstairs, two bedrooms face the canopy. The master takes a tzalam headboard, a parota closet, a steam bathroom and a private balcony. The second bedroom carries two queen beds and opens to its own terrace above the pool. Two Independent Studios Each studio measures 56 m² / 603 sq ft and functions on its own. One sits at ground level with a kitchen, a full bathroom and a dressing room, opening directly onto the pool deck. The other occupies the upper floor of the front volume, reached by its own exterior stair, with a kitchen, a bathroom, a closet and a balcony level with the treetops. Both are furnished with king beds, hardwood headboards, marble topped credenzas and blackout linen. Either can be closed off entirely from the main house, which lets the property read as one residence or as three. Materials and Finishes Structure is 18 cm block with beam and polystyrene slabs, solid where the bathrooms sit. Interior ceilings carry a chukum style plaster finish. Windows are Spanish Series 10000 in matte black, glazed with laminated panes over a PVB interlayer and fitted with mosquito screens. Cooling is Lennox inverter minisplit. The kitchen is parota with Blum hardware, polished ivory quartz counters and Teka throughout: double stainless sink, five burner cooktop, 80 cm oven and integrated hood. Bathrooms carry cast concrete counters in a polished ivory quartz finish, parota vanities, Helvex Vertika fittings, tempered glass shower doors and lit mirrors. Doors and closets are parota with matte black hardware. Railings are matte black ironwork. Hot water runs off a Rheem storage heater. Built to Run Quietly Solar panels on the roof feed a bidirectional meter. The pool is heated and served by its own equipment room with pumps, filters, skimmers and bottom drain. There is a storage room, an outdoor laundry area, a solarium on the upper deck and a planted pergola walkway crossing above the courtyard. What It Is Region 15 is Tulum's quiet residential grid, minutes from the town center and the Coba corridor, without the density that has arrived elsewhere. Casa Verde holds the lot inside a gate, which matters for a house that will sit empty between stays. House Yaxche is complete, furnished and ready to occupy. For a buyer who wants a primary residence with two rental keys attached, or a family compound that can absorb guests without anyone sharing a wall, the configuration is unusually direct. Private viewings by appointment. Ownership Note The property sits within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers hold title through a bank trust known as a fideicomiso or through a Mexican corporation. Both routes are standard and routinely handled at closing. 📍 Location: Casa Verde gated community, Lot 12, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Interior jungle lot, minutes from Tulum town center ⛲️ Features: Gated community Main house plus two fully independent studios of 56 m² / 603 sq ft each Heated pool finished in green jade with travertine deck Covered outdoor kitchen with Weber gas grill, wood grill and quartz counters Mature trees retained and built through the structure Solar panels with bidirectional meter Veracruz travertine floors inside and out Laminated glass windows in matte black frames with mosquito screens Lennox inverter minisplit air conditioning Teka kitchen with parota cabinetry and Blum hardware Steam bathroom in the master Planted pergola walkway and upper solarium Balconies and terraces off every bedroom Delivered fully furnished including artwork Storage room, outdoor laundry area and parking for two vehicles 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 🛁 Bathrooms: 3 full plus 1 half 📏 Size: 380 m² / 4,090 sq ft construction on 571 m² / 6,146 sq ft of land 💵 Total Price: $1,050,000 USD

Land. Five lots remain in Manzana 55, a twenty four lot block off Avenida Fundadores de Tulum on the western reach of La Veleta, where the built grid thins and the jungle takes back over. The subdivision work is finished. The interior road is cut, graded and kerbed, the lot lines are surveyed and staked, and the canopy is still standing on either side of the carriageway. A completed home already sits at the head of the road, which tells a buyer what the street will look like rather than asking them to imagine it. What Is Available Lots 011, 012, 013 and 014 sit as a cluster around the entrance to the interior road, two facing two across the carriageway. Lot 007 sits apart from them, toward the Calle 9 Poniente end of the block. Every lot carries 22 m of frontage. Manzana 55, Lot 007: 346.757 m² / 3,733 sq ft Manzana 55, Lot 011: 366.667 m² / 3,947 sq ft Manzana 55, Lot 012: 346.757 m² / 3,733 sq ft Manzana 55, Lot 013: 346.757 m² / 3,733 sq ft Manzana 55, Lot 014: 366.667 m² / 3,947 sq ft The Shape of the Land These are regular rectangles, wide across the front and shallow front to back, which is the proportion that suits the Tulum courtyard house. Twenty two metres of frontage lets a plan open sideways to a pool and a garden rather than pushing back into a corridor. The lots are flat, set with standing hardwood and palm, and the block is small enough that the road serves it alone rather than carrying traffic through. Where It Sits Manzana 55 is bounded by Calle 7 Poniente and Calle 9 Poniente, with Calle 18 Sur to the west and Avenida Fundadores de Tulum along the eastern edge. Fundadores is the artery that carries this side of La Veleta toward the town center and out to the Coba junction, so the lots sit on a through route without fronting it. Tulum's beaches are a short drive east. Ownership Note The land sits within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers hold title through a bank trust known as a fideicomiso or through a Mexican corporation. Buyers should verify permitted density, setbacks, service connections and any subdivision obligations with the municipality before committing. 📍 Location: Manzana 55, off Avenida Fundadores de Tulum between Calle 7 and Calle 9 Poniente, La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Interior lots on a private road inside a twenty four lot block ⛲️ Features: Five lots available in Manzana 55, each sold separately 22 m of street frontage on every lot Interior road built, graded and kerbed Lot lines surveyed and staked Mature jungle canopy standing on the parcels Flat terrain with no visible grade change Block fronts Avenida Fundadores de Tulum One home already completed at the head of the road Twenty four lots in the block in total 📏 Lot sizes: 346.757 m² / 3,733 sq ft to 366.667 m² / 3,947 sq ft 💵 Price: 1,500,000 MXN per lot, approximately $87,000 USD

Finished property. A two-bedroom lock-off residence at Palais Tulum, delivered fully furnished and equipped, a few steps from Avenida Cobá between the Aloft hotel and Hunab. Eighty-seven square meters of interior space open onto a large private terrace, with marble flooring running throughout and a layout that can be closed into two independent halves. The Lock-Off Layout The lock-off configuration is what distinguishes this unit from a standard two-bedroom. The floor plan is designed to close into two self-contained halves, each with its own entrance, so the residence works either as a single two-bedroom home or as two separately occupied spaces. It is a common choice for owners who want to use part of the property while letting the rest, or who want guest quarters that stay genuinely private. Floor plans are available on request. Kitchen and Finishes The kitchen is fully integrated and comes equipped: a granite bar, extractor hood, microwave, refrigerator and a washer-dryer. Finishes are specified as luxury grade throughout, with marble floors as the anchor. Because the unit is sold furnished and equipped, there is no fit-out period between closing and occupancy. Two Full Bathrooms Both bathrooms are full baths rather than a bath and a powder room, which is what makes the lock-off division practical: each half of the residence retains a complete bathroom when the connecting door is closed. Building Amenities Palais Tulum is organised around a large lobby with a security desk. Residents have two swimming pools, a gym, landscaped gardens and an artificial cenote on site. The Setting Avenida Cobá is Tulum's main artery, running from the town centre east toward the beach road, and the building sits a short walk from it in the Aldea Zamá corridor. Supermarkets, restaurants and the commercial strip along the avenue are close at hand, and the beach is a few minutes by car. Private viewings are available by appointment. 📍 Location: Palais Tulum, Avenida Cobá, Aldea Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Steps from Avenida Cobá, between Aloft and Hunab ⛲️ Features: 2-bedroom lock-off configuration Delivered fully furnished and equipped 2 full bathrooms Large private terrace Marble flooring throughout Fully integrated kitchen with granite bar Extractor hood Microwave Refrigerator Washer-dryer Luxury-grade finishes 🛏 Bedrooms: 2 (lock-off) 🛁 Bathrooms: 2 full 📐 Interior: 87 m² (~936 sqft), plus large private terrace 💵 Price: $229,000 USD (approx. $3,950,000 MXN)

Finished property. Villa Angelina is a five-suite private residence set on 450 square meters of land a short drive west of Tulum's town centre, where a contemporary white-rendered volume opens onto a round pool, a lawn and a mature palm garden. Three hundred square meters of interior space are arranged over two storeys, and the house is sold fully furnished and equipped. Five Suites The villa holds five bedroom suites and four and a half bathrooms. Rooms are finished in a restrained palette of white walls, pale stone floors and tzalam-toned timber, with several opening directly onto the garden or a terrace through full-height glazing. Smart TVs are installed in the living room and in every bedroom. Bathrooms range from a marble-lined suite with a freestanding basin to a walk-in shower finished in patterned cement tile. The Pool and Garden The pool is the centre of the plan. A circular basin sits in a lawn edged by a broad sand-toned deck, with loungers, a dining terrace and a spa and yoga area under the palms. The garden is mature rather than newly planted, and the ground floor living space opens to it almost entirely, so the distinction between inside and outside largely disappears during the day. Living and Kitchen The main living room is a double-height space with a curved sofa oriented toward the pool. The kitchen is fully equipped and finished in dark stone with timber cabinetry and a breakfast bar. A separate dining area sits between the two, beneath a sculptural pendant, with the staircase to the upper floor alongside. Fully Private, No Condominium Regime Villa Angelina is a standalone private villa rather than a unit within a development. There is no condominium regime and no HOA fee, which means no shared-amenity charges and no association rules governing use of the property. The Setting The villa sits minutes from Tulum's town centre and its restaurants and shops, with the Caribbean beaches a short drive east. The immediate surroundings are residential and quiet, screened by mature planting on all sides. The property has been operated as a vacation rental and documented rental performance records are available to qualified buyers on request. Private viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Minutes from the town centre, short drive to the beaches ⛲️ Features: 5 bedroom suites 4.5 bathrooms Private circular swimming pool Mature tropical garden Spa and yoga area Outdoor lounge and dining terrace Double-height living room Fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar Sold fully furnished and equipped Smart TVs in living room and all bedrooms Washer and dryer High-speed Wi-Fi Secure, fully private plot 🛏 Bedrooms: 5 suites 🛁 Bathrooms: 4.5 📐 Interior: 300 m² (~3,229 sqft) 📏 Land: 450 m² (~4,844 sqft) 🏡 HOA: None — fully private villa, no condominium regime 💵 Price: $595,000 USD

features.feature: No condominium regime no HOA fees

desc.en: Finished property. An architecturally led residence on the Caribbean in Tankah Bay, arranged over three levels and holding 252.33 square meters across three bedrooms and four bathrooms. Private terraces run through every floor and the roof is given over to a pool with 360-degree panoramas across the sea in one direction and the mangroves in the other. The house is designed to sit within the Mayan jungle rather than against it, in natural materials and a restrained palette. The Rooftop The roof terrace is the defining level. A pool is set into the deck with the Caribbean directly beyond it, alongside a hanging chair, sun loungers and a shaded seating area under a timber and thatch structure. A full outdoor kitchen and bar runs along one side with a dining table beneath the palapa, and the open aspect means the view carries right around: open water on one side, mangrove and jungle canopy on the other. Three Levels of Living Living space sits behind full-height glazing facing the water, with pale stucco walls, timber ceiling beams and stone floors. The kitchen is fully fitted with a dark stone splashback and timber cabinetry. Three bedrooms open onto their own terraces through sliding glass, each with air conditioning and a ceiling fan, and bathrooms are finished in the same warm stucco with walk-in showers. The residence is presented furnished, and the vertical arrangement over three floors gives each level a distinct degree of privacy. Beach Level At ground level the building opens onto a pool deck laid in hardwood, with a palapa bar, hammocks and loungers set just back from the water line. The beach is directly in front, with no road between the building and the sand. Tankah Bay Tankah Bay sits roughly midway between Tulum and Akumal, a quiet stretch of coast where mangrove runs behind the beachfront strip and the road in carries little through traffic. Density stays low and development is spread thin along the shore, which is much of the reason the bay has kept the character it has while the coast either side of it has filled in. Private viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Tankah Bay, Quintana Roo 🌊 Position: Oceanfront, direct beach access ⛲️ Features: 3 bedrooms 4 bathrooms Three levels with private terraces throughout Rooftop pool with 360° sea and mangrove panoramas Rooftop outdoor kitchen, bar and covered dining Palapa-shaded rooftop lounge Sea-facing living space with full-height glazing Fitted kitchen with stone splashback Bedrooms opening to private terraces Natural materials and refined finishes Air conditioning and ceiling fans Presented furnished Beachfront pool deck and palapa bar 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 🛁 Bathrooms: 4 🏠 Levels: 3 📐 Size: 252.33 m² (~2,716 sqft) 💵 Price: $1,500,000 USD

Finished property. Villa Shalimar is a private estate of three matching villas set on 2.2 acres of jungle garden at Xpu Ha, midway along the coast between Playa del Carmen and Tulum. The three buildings share a single plot and a pool that runs the length of it, and the property is offered as a whole rather than as separate units. Across the estate there are six bedrooms and eight and a half bathrooms, with sleeping capacity for twelve. Three Villas, Six Bedrooms Each villa is laid out identically. The ground floor is open plan, with living, dining and kitchen running together and opening to the pool terrace through wide sliding doors. Kitchens are fitted with granite-topped islands, full ovens and hobs, and refrigerators with ice dispensers. Upstairs, the principal bedroom has a queen bed and a private bathroom with a double rain shower in stone. The second bedroom sits on the ground floor with a king bed, convertible to twins, and its own bathroom with a corner shower and a soaking tub. Air conditioning runs throughout, with ceiling fans in the bedrooms, and floors are laid in large-format stone tile. The Pool The pool does not sit in one block. It steps through the grounds on several levels, held by dry-stone retaining walls, with a waterfall spilling between the upper and lower basins and a timber bridge crossing at the midpoint. Shallow shelves run along the edges for loungers at water level, and one arm reaches under the palapa and surfaces there as a swim-up bar with stools set into the water. From the villas' upper terraces the whole run of it reads as a single body of water threading between the buildings. The Palapa The palapa is a fourth structure rather than a shade canopy. Under a full thatched roof carried on rough timber posts sit a bar counter with stools, two dining tables including one that seats ten, an outdoor kitchen with a gas cooktop and open shelving against rough stone walls, hammocks slung between the posts, and two and a half bathrooms of its own. It opens on every side to the lawn and the pool. The Plot The land runs to 2.2 acres, roughly 8,900 square meters, planted densely with mature trees, coconut palms and tropical foliage, with lawn between the villas and the water. The planting does the work of separating the three villas from one another and screening the estate from its boundaries, which is what allows a property holding twelve people to still read as private. Xpu Ha Xpu Ha lies on the coast road between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, known for one of the wider and calmer beaches along this stretch. The estate sits inland of the sand, about a five-minute drive rather than a walk, with Kantenah Bay and Xpu Ha beach under a kilometer away and a small supermarket within two. Playa del Carmen is roughly 30 km north and Tulum roughly 35 km south. Cancún International Airport is around 80 km, Cozumel around 48 km. The estate currently operates as a vacation rental. Private viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Xpu Ha, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Five minutes inland from Xpu Ha beach and Kantenah Bay ⛲️ Features: Three matching private villas on one plot 6 bedrooms, 8.5 bathrooms Sleeps up to 12 2.2 acres (approx. 8,900 m²) of planted grounds Multi-level pool with waterfall, bridge and swim-up bar Thatched palapa with outdoor kitchen, bar and dining for ten Open-plan ground floors opening to the pool Granite-topped kitchen islands, full ovens and hobs En-suite bathrooms to every bedroom Double rain showers upstairs, soaking tubs downstairs Air conditioning throughout Free on-site parking 🛏 Bedrooms: 6 (2 per villa) 🛁 Bathrooms: 8.5 📏 Land: 2.2 acres (approx. 8,900 m²) 👥 Sleeps: 12 💵 Price: $950,000 USD

features.feature: Swim up bar with submerged stools

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Xibalba is a private estate of two matching villas on over two acres of jungle land in Kantenah, on the stretch of coast between Puerto Aventuras and Xpu Ha. Six bedrooms are split three to each villa, with four bathrooms and sleeping capacity for sixteen. The estate is offered whole rather than as separate units, and its distinguishing feature is a cenote within the grounds. The Cenote The cenote sits apart from the pool, an open sinkhole in the limestone reached by a timber stair that descends between the rock walls. Ferns and bromeliads have taken hold across the exposed stone, and the opening is edged with dry-stone walling and planting rather than built over. Private cenotes rarely come to market in this corridor and cannot be replicated, which is the strongest argument this estate makes. The Pool Separately, a large freeform pool wraps the centre of the plot in two connected basins, divided by a planted rock island with a waterfall spilling between them. The edges are laid in rough limestone rather than tile, so the water reads closer to a natural pool than a rectangle of blue. Sun loungers, a sand-toned deck and mature palms surround it. The Palapa Bar A thatched palapa off the pool holds a full bar built in rustic timber, seating eight at the counter with a wall-mounted television behind and hanging swing seats along the open side. Outdoor dining and a barbecue sit under the same roof, opening straight onto the water. Two Villas, Six Bedrooms The villas are identical in layout and furnishing, finished in a warm traditional palette with stucco walls, terracotta floors and dark timber joinery. Each holds an open living space with a large sofa and a wall-mounted television, an eight-person dining table, an eat-in kitchen bar, and a fully equipped kitchen with a stainless refrigerator, oven and hob. Full-height glazed doors open onto terraces strung with hammocks under thatched shade umbrellas, and air conditioning runs throughout. Each villa carries three bedrooms. The top-floor principal suite has a king bed, a lounge chair and an en-suite bathroom with a large shower and twin basins. Two further bedrooms sit on the ground floor: one with two queen beds, a sofa bed and direct patio access, the other with two double beds. Both have generous closet space and share a bathroom fitted with dual showers and twin basins. The Setting Kantenah sits in Solidaridad, roughly midway between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, with the coast a short drive east. Cenote Azul and Cenote Cristalino are both around six kilometers away, Xpu Ha beach about the same, and Akumal roughly eleven. The land around the estate is jungle, and the plot is screened by mature palms on all sides. The estate currently operates as a vacation rental. Private viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Kantenah, Solidaridad, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Inland jungle plot, short drive to Xpu Ha beach and the cenote route ⛲️ Features: Two matching private villas on one plot 6 bedrooms (3 per villa), 4 bathrooms Sleeps up to 16 Over 2 acres (approx. 8,100 m²) of private grounds Cenote within the grounds, with stepped access Large freeform pool with rock island and waterfall Palapa bar seating eight, with swing seats Outdoor dining and barbecue under thatch Rooftop terraces with palapas on both villas Hammock terraces off the ground floors Fully equipped kitchens with eat-in bars Eight-person dining tables in each villa En-suite principal suites with twin basins Air conditioning throughout 🛏 Bedrooms: 6 (3 per villa) 🛁 Bathrooms: 4 📏 Land: Over 2 acres (approx. 8,100 m²) 👥 Sleeps: 16

Finished property. A finished studio at MISTIQ Premium, handed over furnished and equipped, with a private garden and a jacuzzi of its own. Fifty square meters of interior space on Avenida Kukulkán in Region 15, minutes from the beach and a short walk from the restaurants and shops that have grown up along the avenue. Delivery is immediate, so there is nothing to wait for and nothing left to specify. The Residence The studio runs to 50 square meters (538 sq ft) inside, opening onto a private garden with its own jacuzzi. It arrives furnished and equipped throughout, which means it can be occupied or placed into rental from the day it changes hands. Finishes are specified to the development's premium standard, and a single full bathroom serves the residence. The kitchen is fully integrated, with a granite counter, extractor hood, microwave and refrigerator, laid out so the working space reads as part of the living area rather than a room set apart from it. In a studio that continuity is what makes fifty square meters feel generous rather than compact. The garden extends the plan outward, and the jacuzzi turns what would be a balcony in most buildings into somewhere you actually spend the evening. The Development MISTIQ Premium comprises 128 residences over four levels, arranged around a central amenity core with a run of common spaces. Residents have two swimming pools, one of them a lagoon style pool set into the gardens, a fully equipped gymnasium, landscaped grounds and a staffed reception with security. The developer operates a vacation rental programme that owners may join, though any performance figures quoted by the developer or by third party portals should be verified independently before you rely on them. Region 15 Region 15 is one of the residential districts closest to the coast, sitting between Aldea Zamá and the beach road. The development fronts Avenida Kukulkán, the commercial artery that connects the hotel zone with the town centre, which is why the restaurants and shops are a walk rather than a drive. The beach is a few minutes away by car, and the centre of Tulum is close enough that you are never committed to either the town or the coast. Ownership The property sits within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine, and your notary and bank handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle What makes this one worth seeing is not the specification, which reads much like any well built studio in Tulum, but the combination: a finished, furnished residence with private outdoor space and a jacuzzi, in a development with real amenity, on the avenue rather than at the end of a track. Studios like this rarely stay long once they are complete and furnished, because the buyer who wants one wants it now. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: Avenida Kukulkán, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: walking distance to restaurants and shops, minutes from Tulum beach ⛲️ Features: Luxury studio, delivered furnished and equipped Private garden with jacuzzi Integrated kitchen with granite counter, extractor hood, microwave and refrigerator One full bathroom Premium finishes throughout Immediate delivery Two swimming pools including a lagoon style pool Fully equipped gymnasium Reception with security Landscaped gardens 🛏 Studio 🛁 1 bathroom 📏 50 m² (538 sq ft) plus private garden 💵 $172,000 USD

Finished property. Casa Zara sits inside Pura Selva, a gated enclave of just six houses in Region 15, where the jungle still closes in around the plots and the roads stay quiet. Four bedrooms and four bathrooms across two levels and a rooftop, 322 square meters of construction on a 320 square meter plot, completed in 2024 and handed over fully furnished. The pool runs the length of the garden, and the glass folds back until the distinction between the living room and the jungle stops meaning very much. The House The ground floor is given to an open concept living and dining area that opens directly onto the private garden, the pool and the outdoor patio. The kitchen is fully equipped and built around an island with seating, set so that whoever is cooking stays part of the room rather than shut away from it. A laundry room sits off the main circulation. Large windows run the depth of the plan, which is what keeps the interior bright through the day and gives every principal room something green to look at. Four bedrooms occupy the two levels, each served by its own full bathroom. The rooms are finished in the register the house holds throughout: lime plaster walls, timber, woven pendants, jute underfoot, arched mirrors above stone basins. Several open directly to the garden or to the pool through full height sliding doors. The Rooftop Above it all is a rooftop terrace with a shaded palapa, a dining table and loungers, and a roof garden planted around the edges. From up here the canopy runs unbroken toward the coast. It is the part of the house that makes the strongest case for itself in the evening, when the heat drops and the light goes long across the jungle. Pura Selva Pura Selva is a private gated community of six exclusive houses, laid out at low density with the jungle left standing between them. The development has controlled access, internal private roads, 24 hour security and on site maintenance, and the houses are managed by an established Tulum property management company. That combination suits an owner who is not in Tulum year round, whether the house is used as a second home or placed into rental. Any return or occupancy figures quoted by the developer, the management company or third party portals should be verified independently before you rely on them. Region 15 Region 15 sits between the town centre and the beach zone, which is the practical argument for it: you are close to both without committing to either. The area is still developing and is characterised by dense jungle, low density projects and a quiet that the more built up districts have lost. Restaurants, shops and services on Avenida Kukulkán are a short drive, and the beach road is a similar distance in the other direction. Ownership and Costs The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and your notary and bank will handle it as part of closing. Property tax runs at 14,188 pesos per year. Buyers should confirm current tax, maintenance and management charges in writing before closing. Singular by the Jungle What sets Casa Zara apart is not any one feature but the completeness of it. A house built in 2024, furnished and ready, with its own pool, its own rooftop, its own garden, inside a gate shared with only five neighbours, on a plot where the jungle was kept rather than cleared. Houses in Tulum that ask nothing further of the buyer are rarer than the listings suggest. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: Pura Selva, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: gated enclave of six houses, between Tulum centre and the beach zone ⛲️ Features: Private pool with garden and outdoor patio Rooftop terrace with palapa and roof garden Open patio with grill Fully furnished, completed 2024 Open concept living and dining Fully equipped kitchen with island Laundry room Water desalinization system Two parking spaces Gated community of six houses, 24 hour security Internal private roads and on site maintenance 🛏 4 bedrooms 🛁 4 bathrooms 📏 House 322 m² (3,466 sq ft) on 320 m² (3,444 sq ft) 💵 $545,000 USD

features.feature: Open concept living and dining area

desc.en: Finished property. Maison Siscolino is a designer villa in Region 15, set back from the noise of the town and the beach strip but six minutes by car from the sand. Four en suite bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms across 245 square meters of construction on a 301 square meter plot, with two private pools: a swim up pool at garden level and a plunge pool on the roof. It is sold fully furnished, equipped and decorated, ready to occupy or to let from the day it changes hands. The House The ground floor turns on a sunken living room that runs straight out to the pool deck, with massive sliding doors that fold back until the room and the garden read as one space. The kitchen is open and fully equipped, with a bar that faces into the living and dining area rather than away from it. Beyond that sit a powder room, a laundry room and gated parking for two cars. One bedroom is on this level, a king with its own en suite, walk in closet and vanity area, positioned so it opens directly to the swim up edge of the pool. Waking up and stepping into the water without passing through the rest of the house is the kind of detail that does not show on a floor plan. Upstairs Three further bedrooms occupy the second floor. The principal has an en suite with a freestanding bathtub and a rain shower. A second king bedroom has its own en suite, and a twin room holds two queen beds with an en suite and walk in closet, which is what makes the house work for two families rather than one. Slatted timber headboards, deep colour on the walls and full height glazing onto the canopy give each room its own character instead of repeating one scheme four times. The Rooftop The roof carries a plunge pool with benches built into it, alongside a sunbathing and lounge area under a shade sail. It faces open jungle, so the outlook is canopy rather than neighbours, and it is where the house is at its best at either end of the day. There is also structural provision for a fifth bedroom up here should a buyer want to add one. Region 15 Region 15 sits between the town centre and the beach zone, dense with jungle and still low rise, which is why the villa feels tucked away despite being minutes from the restaurants and shops that draw people to Tulum in the first place. The beach is a six minute drive. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and your notary and bank will handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle Two pools in a house of this size is unusual, and the swim up bedroom is genuinely rare in Tulum at this level. Add a rooftop that looks over unbroken canopy and a furnishing package that needs nothing, and the argument makes itself whether the buyer intends to live in it or let it work. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: set back in the jungle, six minutes by car from the beach zone ⛲️ Features: Swim up pool at garden level with sunbathing area Rooftop plunge pool with integrated benches and lounge Sunken indoor outdoor living room Fully equipped open kitchen with bar Four en suite bedrooms including a ground floor swim up bedroom Principal en suite with bathtub and rain shower Powder room and laundry room Two gated parking spaces Fully furnished, equipped and decorated Rooftop prepared for a fifth bedroom Pet friendly 🛏 4 bedrooms 🛁 4.5 bathrooms 📏 House 245 m² (2,637 sq ft) on 301 m² (3,240 sq ft) 💵 $650,000 USD

Land. A titled lot of 211.23 square meters on Calle 24 Norte, in Colonia Ejidal, Playa del Carmen, zoned for mixed commercial use. Ten meters of frontage to the street and a little over twenty two meters of depth, in a consolidated part of the city where mixed use is already the pattern on surrounding blocks. Offered at 1,300,000 Mexican pesos, approximately 75,850 US dollars, which works out at around 6,155 pesos per square meter. The Lot The plot measures 211.23 square meters (2,274 sq ft) and is regular enough to build on without difficulty. The public deed records the boundaries as 13.51 meters to the northeast, 22.15 meters to the southeast, 10.00 meters to the southwest fronting Calle 24 Norte, and 22.59 meters to the northwest. That ten meter street frontage is the number that matters for anyone planning ground floor commercial space, since it sets what you can present to the street. Zoning The lot carries a mixed commercial uso de suelo, which is what gives the frontage its value. Commercial activity is permitted alongside residential, so the obvious scheme is a ground floor local facing Calle 24 Norte with apartments over it, though a single house or a purely commercial building are equally available under the designation. Buyers should confirm current permitted density, height and setbacks with the Municipio de Solidaridad before committing, since those parameters sit with the municipal plan rather than the deed and are periodically revised. Title This is not an ejido parcel awaiting regularisation. The lot carries a full property title issued in 2004, converted by public deed before Notaría 109 of Quintana Roo in September 2018, and inscribed in the Playa del Carmen office of the Public Registry of Property and Commerce under folio 13453 in March 2019. The deed records the property as free of liens and without limitation of dominion, and clear of property tax, municipal works cooperation and water service charges as at that date. That history is worth stating plainly because a great deal of land marketed in this part of Quintana Roo is still ejidal or mid regularisation, and buyers routinely discover it late. Here the chain is documented. A buyer should still commission a current certificado de libertad de gravamen and a fresh predial statement as part of due diligence, since the certificates on file speak only to the position in 2018. Colonia Ejidal Colonia Ejidal sits north and west of Playa del Carmen's tourist core, in the part of the city where people actually live and work. Calle 24 Norte runs between Diagonal 70 Norte and Diagonal 75 Norte here, a few blocks from Avenida Andrés Quintana Roo and its everyday commerce. Quinta Avenida and the beach are roughly ten minutes away, close enough to serve the visitor economy without paying tourist zone land prices. Playa del Carmen remains the largest permanent population centre on the Riviera Maya, and the residential colonias have absorbed most of that growth. A mixed commercial plot on an established street in a neighbourhood with a resident population is a different proposition from tourist zone land: the ground floor has a local customer base from day one. Ownership Playa del Carmen lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance, or through a Mexican corporation where the intended use is commercial. Your notary will advise which structure fits the plan. Viewings by appointment. Full cadastral and registry references available to qualified buyers on request. 📍 Location: Calle 24 Norte, between Diagonal 70 Norte and Diagonal 75 Norte, Colonia Ejidal, Playa del Carmen, Solidaridad, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: consolidated residential colonia, roughly ten minutes from Quinta Avenida and the beach ⛲️ Specification: Lot area 211.23 m² (2,274 sq ft) Mixed commercial uso de suelo Frontage 10.00 m to Calle 24 Norte Depth 22.15 m to 22.59 m Titled, notarised and registered under folio 13453 Recorded free of liens and encumbrances Municipal services on the street 🏗 Type: Mixed commercial land 📏 Lot: 211.23 m² (2,274 sq ft) 💵 Price: $75,850 USD, equivalent to $1,300,000 MXN 📐 Per m²: approximately $359 USD, equivalent to $6,155 MXN

property.notes: Stage: land. Zone: Playa del Carmen.

desc.en: Finished property. A three bedroom duplex penthouse on the corner of Building A at Amira District, the residential quarter within Selva Zamá that sits closer to Tulum beach than any development of its kind. Unit A-306 runs to 205.27 square meters across two levels, with living space on both and a private pool set into the upper terrace. The architecture is by DNA Barcelona, and it is unmistakable: stacked planted terraces behind vertical timber screens, the vegetation carried up the elevation rather than confined to the ground. The unit is complete and delivered unfurnished, available to view and to occupy now. Lower Level The entrance opens to a salon and dining room that runs the width of the plan, with the kitchen set at the far end alongside a laundry and utility room. The whole of this space gives onto Terrace 01, which wraps the corner and takes the outlook in two directions, which is what a corner unit buys you. Two bedrooms sit behind a hall off the living space, each with its own bathroom. Upper Level An internal stair rises to a second living room, a third bedroom and two further bathrooms. The larger of the two terraces is up here, and it holds the private pool. This is the part of the plan that separates a duplex from a large apartment: a whole floor that works as a private retreat above the entertaining level, with its own outdoor space and water. Specification Interiors are finished in travertine marble to the floors, terraces and shower areas. Counters in the kitchen and bathrooms are corian, granite or composite stone. Joinery and doors are MDF, windows and doors are PVC with double glazing, and shower screens are tempered glass. Sanitaryware is superior grade white porcelain with contemporary taps, and lighting runs to LED spots throughout. Climate control is by inverter mini splits in the bedrooms and the living and dining areas, with ceiling fans in the same rooms. The kitchen comes with a refrigerator, an oven with extractor and a microwave. Because the unit is finished, the interior palette is in place and can be seen in person rather than chosen from a sample board. The Development Amira District is arranged as four buildings, A through D, each functioning as its own small community. Beyond the unit itself, residents have interconnected rooftop pools, ground level pools set into jungle gardens, a restaurant, coffee shop and bar, gym and yoga areas, a kids club, multipurpose pavilions, hammock and fire pit areas, two lifts per building, parking and security around the clock. Outdoor spaces through the scheme were planned for solar protection, airflow and noise reduction rather than left to chance. Buyers should confirm which of these amenities are complete and serving Building A at present. Selva Zamá Selva Zamá is a large master planned development laid out with jungle retained between the parcels and its own internal road network. Amira District sits at the eastern edge, a short walk from the beach and from the hotel strip that made Tulum's name. Being able to walk to the sand rather than call a taxi is the practical difference between this address and most of what is built inland, and a masterplan of this size brings its own services and access roads rather than depending on Tulum's older colonias. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and your notary and bank will handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle Duplex penthouses with their own pool are not common at this level in Tulum, and corner units carrying two aspects are rarer still. Add an architect with a signature the building actually wears, and A-306 is easier to distinguish from the rest of the market than most three bedroom units at this price. Finished and ready, with none of the waiting that usually comes with this address. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Amira District, Fase 1, Edificio A, Selva Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: corner unit, third and fourth levels of Building A, walking distance to the beach ⛲️ Specification: Unit A-306, Building A, third and fourth levels Total constructed area 205.27 m² (2,210 sq ft), interior plus exterior 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms Duplex over two levels with internal stair Private pool on the upper terrace Two terraces, one to each level Separate living room to the upper level Travertine marble floors throughout Inverter mini split air conditioning and ceiling fans Kitchen delivered with appliances Complete and delivered unfurnished Architecture by DNA Barcelona 🛏 3 bedrooms 🛁 4 bathrooms 📏 205.27 m² (2,210 sq ft) 🏖 Private pool 💵 $695,000 USD

desc.en: Finished property. A six bedroom villa standing directly on the sand at Soliman Bay, 800 square meters of construction on a 1,000 square meter beachfront lot. The pool deck runs to the beach itself, framed by palms, with the reef line visible offshore and nothing between the house and the water. Two pools, a heated jacuzzi, a private gym, a cinema room and a rooftop over the bay. True beachfront at this scale almost never trades here. The House Six bedrooms, all king. Four are full suites with their own en suite bathrooms, and two further king rooms share a bathroom between them. Every bathroom is fitted with both a rain shower and a bathtub, and the whole house is air conditioned. The arrangement is deliberate: enough separation for two or three families to keep their own quarters, without the house feeling subdivided. Living space runs indoors and out across the full 800 square meters, with several lounges rather than one central room, so a large group disperses instead of collecting in a single space. The main living volume opens straight through to the pool terrace and the sea beyond, which is the whole argument for building on this bay. Amenities Two pools, a heated jacuzzi, a private gym and a cinema room sit within the property, which is unusual at this size and means the house holds its guests without them needing to leave. The rooftop is the centrepiece, open to the bay and the treeline, and it is where the house makes its case at sunrise and again at dusk. The beach is private and directly in front of the house. Two beach clubs with bars and restaurants operate within the bay itself. Soliman Bay Soliman Bay sits about twenty minutes north of Tulum town, on a stretch of coast that never took the density that arrived further south. The reef sits close in, so the water inside the bay is calm and shallow, swimmable and paddleable in conditions the open beaches south of Tulum rarely offer. It is a small community of private houses rather than a hotel strip, which is precisely the appeal at this end of the market. Tulum is close enough for dinner, the airport is a straightforward drive, and Akumal and its turtle bay are a few minutes north. Operation The house has been run as a fully serviced villa with housekeeping, chef and concierge in place. A buyer intending to continue that arrangement should confirm in writing what transfers with the sale, including staff, forward bookings, furnishings and any operator agreements, since none of that passes automatically. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and your notary and bank will handle it as part of closing. On a beachfront title, buyers should also verify the federal maritime zone position, including the ZOFEMAT boundary and any concession attaching to the frontage, as part of due diligence. Singular by the Jungle What sets this one apart is the combination: genuine beachfront on a reef protected bay, 800 square meters of house, two pools, a gym, a cinema and a rooftop, six king bedrooms, and calm water at the end of the terrace. Soliman does not produce many houses like this, and it produces them slowly. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Soliman Bay, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: true beachfront on a reef protected bay between Tulum and Akumal ⛲️ Features: True beachfront with private beach Six king bedrooms, four as en suite suites Rain shower and bathtub to every bathroom Two swimming pools Heated jacuzzi Rooftop terrace with panoramic sea views Private gym Cinema room Multiple indoor and outdoor lounges Air conditioning throughout Two beach clubs within the bay 🛏 6 bedrooms 🛁 5.5 bathrooms 📏 House 800 m² (8,611 sq ft) on 1,000 m² (10,764 sq ft) 🏖 Beachfront, two pools 💵 $6,900,000 USD

Finished property. Villa Luna is a five bedroom house inside Aldea Premium, the gated enclave within Aldea Zamá, arranged over two upper floors with balconies and a terrace attached to the bedrooms rather than pushed to one side of the plan. Aldea Zamá remains the most established address in Tulum, the part of town with paved streets, working services and restaurants you can walk to, and Aldea Premium sits behind its own gate within it. The Bedrooms The first floor holds three. The principal suite has a king bed, an en suite with a bathtub, a large closet, a desk and its own balcony. The second bedroom is also king, en suite, with a balcony of its own. The third takes a queen bed and a large closet, sharing a bathroom with the principal suite. Two further bedrooms occupy the second floor. One is a king with en suite and a large closet. The other is the most flexible room in the house, configured either as two kings or as a king with two singles, with its own en suite and a large terrace. That flexibility is what lets the house sleep twelve without anyone ending up on a sofa. Every room is air conditioned, with premium mattresses and cotton linen throughout. Aldea Premium The community is gated with security at the entrance around the clock, a perimeter electric fence and camera coverage. For an owner who is not in Tulum year round, that combination is the practical difference between a house you can leave and a house you worry about. It is also the reason this pocket of Aldea Zamá holds its value the way it does. Aldea Zamá Aldea Zamá is the neighbourhood that made Tulum livable rather than merely visitable: proper roads, reliable utilities, and a density of restaurants, cafes, shops and services within walking distance. A paddle court and a convenience store are a short walk away. The beach and the hotel zone are minutes by car, the town centre is close, and the cenotes and ruins are an easy drive. Operation The house has been run as a fully serviced villa with chef, concierge and guest support in place. A buyer intending to continue that arrangement should confirm in writing what transfers with the sale, including staff, forward bookings, furnishings and any operator agreements, since none of that passes automatically. Singular by the Jungle Five bedrooms, four of them en suite, inside a gate, on foot from dinner. Villa Luna is not trying to be remote, and that is the point: a large house that works as a family home and as a lock up and leave, in the one part of Tulum where walking somewhere is actually an option. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Aldea Premium, Aldea Zamá, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: gated community, walking distance to restaurants and shops ⛲️ Features: Five bedrooms, four en suite Principal suite with bathtub, dressing area, desk and balcony Two private balconies and a large terrace Flexible fifth bedroom sleeping up to four Sleeps twelve Air conditioning throughout Gated community with 24 hour security Electric fence and camera coverage Walking distance to restaurants, cafes and shops 🛏 5 bedrooms 🛁 4.5 bathrooms 👥 Sleeps 12 🔐 Gated community 💵 $1,800,000 USD

Finished property. The facade announces itself before anything else does. Three levels of white stucco split by a spine of raw stone, arched windows set into the upper floor like a row of held breaths, and at ground level an arch wide enough to walk a sofa through, opening straight onto water. From the lawn the house reads as a single symmetrical gesture. From inside it reads as somewhere you would not hurry to leave. The Ground Floor Living, dining and kitchen run as one continuous volume across the ground plane, floors polished to a soft sheen, walls broken by a single textured feature panel that carries the length of the lounge. Glass slides back on the garden side until the distinction between the sitting room and the pool terrace stops meaning very much. The kitchen sits at the far end in matte black cabinetry against a full height marble slab, island seating for four, doors that open directly to the water. A second galley kitchen handles the work that guests do not need to watch. Beyond the arch, an outdoor dining table under a vaulted ceiling. Beyond that, fifteen metres of heated pool running the length of the lawn, stone daybeds along the far edge, a black boundary wall with a cobalt arched door set into it like a piece of theatre. Upstairs The stair core lifts through the centre of the house in white plaster and stone. Above it the material language changes. Timber floors, warm microcement, layered curtains, arched windows that pull the tree canopy into the room. The master suite takes the arch as its centrepiece, a freestanding tub set beside the glass so the bath and the view are the same event. Six bedrooms in total, each with its own bathroom, finished in green marble, black marble and carved stone basins on floating vanities. A half bath serves the ground floor. The Setting Aldea Zamá is Tulum's planned residential district, paved, gated and quiet, sitting between the town centre and the beach road with easy reach of both. Villa Amana sits within Aldea Premium, a secured enclave inside that wider community.

Finished property. Two bodies of water, one at ground level and one on the roof. The first runs twenty five metres along the side of the house, a lap pool floored in stone that shifts colour as the light moves across it, a floating stone table set into the water at the halfway point. The second sits above the treeline, heated, curved, open to the canopy in every direction. Most houses in Aldea Zamá offer one or the other. This one does not choose. The Living Level A timber soffit carries the length of the ground floor and out over the terrace, so the ceiling reads as continuous whether you are inside or beside the pool. Glass slides away along the pool side. The living room takes a single long modular sofa facing the water, and behind it a bar counter in book matched marble runs toward a wall of stacked stone lit from within its niches. The kitchen sits under the same timber ceiling, black cabinetry against a marble island with leather counter seating, a run of clerestory windows behind the range framing the planting outside. Dining is in the glazed corner, a table for ten with jungle on two sides and stone garden columns beyond the glass. The Rooms Five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms. Timber floors throughout, layered rugs, restrained palettes in sand and clay. One room takes a circular porthole cut through the wall, a piece of architectural mischief that also happens to frame the canopy perfectly. Another carries an oversized timber framed mirror the height of the wall. The bathrooms are where the house raises its voice: one is clad floor to ceiling in green marble, three round mirrors above carved stone basins, the veining doing most of the work. The Setting La Privada is a gated pocket within Aldea Zamá, Tulum's planned residential district, paved and quiet, sitting between the town centre and the beach road with easy reach of both.
