desc.en: Land. A 2,500 square metre parcel at Chunyaxché, fifty metres by fifty, with an open cenote inside its own boundary. The land sits on the corridor south west of Tulum, roughly 700 metres from the Muyil archaeological zone and a short distance from the northern gateway into the Sian Ka'an biosphere reserve. Tulum airport is fifteen minutes north. The Cenote The cenote is open rather than covered, a broad basin cut into the limestone with a cavern mouth at one end and water that runs clear over pale rock. Work has already been done to make it usable. Stone steps have been carved in a wide amphitheatre curve down one side, timber handrails and ladders reach the water, and the rim has been consolidated with dry stone retaining walls. A palapa stands beside it and the parcel is enclosed by a block wall with a timber and bamboo gate. The Land Fifty by fifty gives a square parcel and a straightforward build envelope around the cenote. The ground has been cleared and levelled where it needed to be while the mature canopy has been kept at the perimeter, so the parcel already reads as a finished setting rather than raw jungle. Mains electricity runs 200 metres away. At 2,800 pesos per square metre it prices as land, with the cenote and the groundwork carried inside that figure. The Position Chunyaxché sits at the point where the Tulum corridor gives out and Sian Ka'an begins. Muyil, one of the oldest continuously occupied Maya sites on this coast, is under a kilometre away, and the lagoon system and floating channel that draw visitors into the reserve run just beyond it. Tulum airport is around fifteen kilometres north and reachable in a quarter of an hour, which is the practical argument for this location: it is jungle, but it is jungle fifteen minutes from an international terminal. Tulum town is roughly twenty five minutes, the coast about the same. Title The parcel is currently ejido land and the seller undertakes to deliver private title on purchase. In practice that means the parcel completing the dominio pleno conversion: authorisation by the ejido assembly, regularisation through the Registro Agrario Nacional and registration of the escritura in the Registro Público de la Propiedad. Until that conversion is registered the land cannot be held by a foreign buyer and no fideicomiso can be constituted over it. Buyers should ask where the process currently stands, obtain the supporting documentation, and structure payment so that it follows delivery of the registered escritura rather than preceding it. Once the conversion is complete the parcel sits inside the federally restricted zone and foreign ownership runs through a fideicomiso in the usual way. Further Due Diligence Three further checks are worth making on this corridor. The current land use designation under the municipal and state ecological ordinance, given how close the reserve boundary runs. Whether the parcel falls inside any INAH protection perimeter attached to the Muyil zone. And the regulatory position of the cenote itself, since groundwater in Mexico is national property regardless of who holds the surface title. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Chunyaxché, Reforma Agraria to Puerto Juárez road, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: 700 m from the Muyil archaeological zone, at the northern gateway to Sian Ka'an ⛲️ Details: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) parcel 50 m by 50 m, square Open cenote inside the parcel boundary Carved stone steps and timber access to the water Stone retaining walls around the cenote rim Block perimeter wall and timber gate Palapa built Mains electricity 200 m from the parcel 15 minutes to Tulum international airport 25 minutes to Tulum town 🏞 Type: Land with cenote 📏 Size: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) ⚡ Electricity: mains supply 200 m away 📜 Title: Ejido, private title to be delivered on purchase 💵 Price: 7,000,000 MXN (approximately $408,000 USD) 📊 Rate: 2,800 MXN per m² (approximately $163 USD per m²)

Finished property. Cielo Azul stands in La Veleta, the residential quarter that runs south west of Tulum pueblo and has become the part of town where the larger private villas have gone up. Five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, a 59 square metre pool and a 490 square metre (5,274 sq ft) plot, built in 2020 and delivered fully furnished. The beach road lies around four kilometres east and Avenida Tulum under three to the north. Design and Finishes The house is built in concrete and precast block, a combination that holds up against the salt and humidity here far better than render does, and it has been left legible rather than covered over. Floor to ceiling windows run through the ground floor so the pool terrace and the interior read as one space. Flooring is tiled throughout. The kitchen carries a large marble island and a full appliance package, positioned to work as the centre of the room rather than tucked behind a wall. Bedrooms Five bedrooms, four with king beds and one with two queens, and every one of them carries its own en suite with double sinks. With the guest cloakroom that gives five and a half bathrooms in total. The arrangement means five separate parties can occupy the house without sharing anything, which is the specification that separates a villa of this size from a large family house. Pool and Terraces The pool runs to 59 square metres (635 sq ft), stepped from 1.3 metres at the shallow end to 1.6 at the deep, so it works for swimming and for standing in equally. Terraces wrap it on more than one side with room for lounging and for dining, and two outdoor showers are set into the garden. Total construction including the villa, the terraces and the pool comes to 359.49 square metres (3,870 sq ft). Power and Infrastructure This is where the house separates itself from most of its neighbours. Twenty SunPower solar panels carry the day load, which on a house running air conditioning across five bedrooms is a material difference to the standing cost of ownership. Behind that sits a 20 kW generator on a 100 amp automatic transfer switch that picks up within ten seconds of an outage. Tulum loses power more often than the brochures admit, and a house that carries its own generation and its own backup is a different proposition to one that does not. Security A private security post is built into the perimeter wall rather than bolted on beside it, with its own washroom, kitchenette and monitoring screen for the exterior cameras. It is designed to be staffed. Furnished and Turnkey The villa is sold fully furnished, with custom pieces throughout, and is usable from the day it changes hands. The property has operated as a short term rental and the seller can transfer the existing platform accounts and any forward bookings, along with the management and staff arrangements, where a buyer wants to continue that use. Trading records are available to qualified buyers on request through the agent. The Setting La Veleta sits inland of the highway on the south west side of town, close enough to Avenida Tulum to reach it in a few minutes and far enough out that the streets stay quiet and the canopy stays intact. It has drawn the bulk of Tulum's residential building over the past five years, which means good roads and services by local standards. Tulum international airport is roughly twenty five minutes south west. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial, the land use designation and the status of any rental permits as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Residential quarter south west of the pueblo, about four kilometres from the beach road ⛲️ Features: 59 m² (635 sq ft) pool with shallow and deep ends Expansive terraces for lounging and dining Two outdoor showers Five bedrooms, each en suite with double sinks Kitchen with marble island and full appliance package Floor to ceiling windows and tiled flooring throughout Concrete and precast block construction Twenty SunPower solar panels 20 kW generator with 100 A automatic transfer switch Private staffed security post with camera monitoring Delivered fully furnished Built 2020 🛏 Bedrooms: 5 (4 king, 1 with two queens) 🛁 Bathrooms: 5.5 📐 Construction: 359.49 m² (3,870 sq ft) including terraces and pool 📏 Land: 490 m² (5,274 sq ft) 🏊 Pool: 59 m² (635 sq ft) 💵 Total Price: $899,000 USD

features.feature: Double sinks to every en suite

desc.en: Land. A 2,500 square metre parcel at Chunyaxché, fifty metres by fifty, with an open cenote inside its own boundary and the groundwork already done. The land sits on the corridor south west of Tulum, around a kilometre north of the Muyil archaeological zone and the northern gateway into the Sian Ka'an biosphere reserve. Tulum airport is around fifteen minutes away. The Cenote The cenote is open rather than covered, a broad basin cut into the limestone with a cavern mouth at one end and water that runs from deep turquoise over the drop to pale green across the shallows. The rim has been consolidated in dressed limestone and the walls carry ferns and creeping growth where the light reaches. A cavern runs back under the rock at water level. Below the Surface What is visible from the deck is the opening rather than the whole of it. The cenote is a window into a flooded cave system running beneath the parcel, and the owner reports the passage below as diveable and heavily decorated with stalactite and stalagmite formations. This corridor sits above some of the longest underwater cave networks on the peninsula, so the claim is consistent with the geology, but the extent, the condition and any connection to the wider system are things established by survey rather than by report. A buyer intending to make something of the cave should commission their own mapping and take advice on access before relying on it. The Improvements This is not a raw parcel. A curved hardwood deck runs out over the water at the low end of the basin, wide enough to walk and to sit on, with a handrail set into the rock at the far corner. A stairway has been cut through the limestone with hardwood treads laid into it, connecting the deck up to the level above. A plunge pool is built into the stone terrace at the rim. A two storey cabin stands over the cenote in glass and timber with a rooftop terrace above it and a further deck at ground level, and an elevated timber platform under a thatched palapa roof sits among the trees with swings hung from the frame. The Land Fifty by fifty gives a square parcel and a straightforward build envelope around the cenote. The ground has been cleared and terraced where it needed to be, retaining walls have been laid in local stone, and the mature canopy has been kept at the perimeter, so the parcel already reads as a finished setting rather than jungle waiting to be worked. At 5,200 pesos per square metre it prices as land, with the cenote and the completed groundwork carried inside that figure. The Position Chunyaxché sits at the point where the Tulum corridor gives out and Sian Ka'an begins. Muyil, one of the oldest continuously occupied Maya sites on this coast, is about a kilometre south, and the lagoon system and floating channel that draw visitors into the reserve run just beyond it. Tulum airport is roughly fifteen minutes away, which is the practical argument for this location: it is jungle, but it is jungle a quarter of an hour from an international terminal. Tulum town is around twenty five to thirty minutes and the coast about the same. Title The parcel is currently ejido land and the seller undertakes to deliver private title on purchase. In practice that means the parcel completing the dominio pleno conversion: authorisation by the ejido assembly, regularisation through the Registro Agrario Nacional and registration of the escritura in the Registro Público de la Propiedad. Until that conversion is registered the land cannot be held by a foreign buyer and no fideicomiso can be constituted over it. Buyers should ask where the process currently stands, obtain the supporting documentation, and structure payment so that it follows delivery of the registered escritura rather than preceding it. Once the conversion is complete the parcel sits inside the federally restricted zone and foreign ownership runs through a fideicomiso in the usual way. Further Due Diligence Four further checks are worth making on this corridor. The current land use designation under the municipal and state ecological ordinance, given how close the reserve boundary runs. Whether the parcel falls inside any INAH protection perimeter attached to the Muyil zone. The regulatory position of the cenote and the cave system beneath it, since groundwater in Mexico is national property regardless of who holds the surface title, and a mapped cave network can carry its own constraints on what may be built above it. And the permit position of the structures already built on the parcel, together with confirmation in writing of which improvements are included in the sale. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Chunyaxché, Reforma Agraria to Puerto Juárez road, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: 1 km north of the Muyil archaeological zone, at the northern gateway to Sian Ka'an ⛲️ Details: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) parcel 50 m by 50 m, square Open cenote inside the parcel boundary Flooded cave system beneath the parcel, reported diveable and decorated Curved hardwood deck over the water Rock cut stairway with hardwood treads Plunge pool built into the stone terrace Dressed limestone retaining walls around the rim Two storey cabin in glass and timber with rooftop terrace Elevated timber platform with thatched palapa roof Cleared and terraced ground with mature canopy retained Muyil archaeological zone approximately 1 km away Approximately 15 minutes to Tulum international airport 25 to 30 minutes to Tulum town 🏞 Type: Land with cenote 📏 Size: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) 📜 Title: Ejido, private title to be delivered on purchase 💵 Price: 13,000,000 MXN (approximately $760,000 USD) 📊 Rate: 5,200 MXN per m² (approximately $304 USD per m²)

Finished property. The stair rises out of the living room and keeps going, past the third bedroom, onto a roof that belongs to nobody else. A pool runs the length of the terrace. A concrete dining table sits under timber beams. Jungle fills the middle distance and the gardens of the development lie below. Most penthouses in Tulum borrow their view from a rooftop shared with a hundred neighbours. This one owns its own. The Residence The penthouse runs to 264 m² (2,842 sq ft) across two levels, laid out so the main floor works as one continuous room and the upper floor works as a retreat from it. The main level is open plan: kitchen, dining and living arranged around an island that seats eight, with a laundry closet holding washing machine and dryer, and a terrace off the living space looking over the pools. Two bedrooms sit on this level. The first is the master, with a king bed, a full en suite bathroom with rain shower, a generous closet and its own balcony. The second holds two queen beds with a full en suite bathroom and a balcony facing the jungle. Upstairs, the third bedroom sits at rooftop level with a king bed, full en suite bathroom, large closet and a private entry of its own, opening directly onto the roof terrace and the pool. It is the arrangement that makes this unit unusual: a guest or a teenager gets a floor to themselves without ever crossing the main living space. Air conditioning runs throughout. Parking is underground and secured. The Rooftop The roof is the reason to buy this one. A private pool, a dining table with seating for a full group, a lounge area of low seating under a pergola, and an outdoor kitchen with grill and sink built into the wall. The outlook runs across the tree canopy in one direction and over the development gardens in the other. It is a floor of the house rather than a balcony, and it works in the evening as readily as at noon. The Development MISTIQ Premium is a residential development of 128 residences on Avenida Kukulcán, arranged around a central amenity core. Residents have swimming pools, a jacuzzi, a sundeck, landscaped gardens, underground parking and staffed security. A French bakery, a restaurant and a mini market operate on site, which makes the practical business of arriving and settling in considerably easier than it is in most Tulum buildings. The developer describes the gymnasium as the largest private gym in Tulum; that claim is the developer's own and worth confirming against your own visit. Beach club access is offered through the development, and current terms should be verified with the administration before you rely on them. Region 15 Region 15 sits between Aldea Zamá and the coast, one of the residential districts closest to the beach. Avenida Kukulcán is the commercial artery running from the town centre toward the hotel zone, and the beach is roughly 2.8 km along it, about five minutes by car. Downtown Tulum is a similar distance in the other direction. The restaurants and shops that have grown along the avenue are close enough to reach by bicycle, which is how most people here move. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Setting one up is routine and your notary and bank handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and a private roof with a pool is a specification that exists in Tulum mainly in standalone villas at twice this figure. Finding it inside a serviced development, with a gym and a bakery and a market downstairs and someone at the gate, is the rarer thing. The unit is sold as a resale and is currently in service as a rental, so viewing windows are limited. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: Avenida Kukulcán, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: 2.8 km to Tulum beach, minutes to the town centre, bicycle distance to the restaurants and shops on the avenue ⛲️ Features: Three bedrooms, each with full en suite bathroom Private rooftop pool with jungle and garden outlook Rooftop dining table, lounge seating under pergola and outdoor kitchen with grill Open plan main level with island seating for eight Master bedroom with king bed, rain shower and private balcony Second bedroom with two queen beds, en suite and jungle facing balcony Third bedroom at roof level with private entry and direct pool access Laundry closet with washing machine and dryer Terrace off the living area overlooking the development pools Air conditioning throughout Private secured underground parking Shared pools, jacuzzi and sundeck Gymnasium, French bakery, restaurant and mini market on site Staffed security and landscaped gardens 🛏 3 bedrooms 🛁 3 bathrooms 📏 264 m² (2,842 sq ft) 💵 $450,000 USD

Finished property. The smallest residences are the hardest ones to get right. There is nowhere to hide a bad plan in thirty nine square meters. This one works because it does not try to be an apartment in miniature: it is one clear room with a king size bed, a kitchenette along the wall, a full bathroom, and a terrace off the front that doubles the space you actually use. Ground floor, so the terrace is somewhere you step out onto rather than look down from. The Residence Thirty nine square meters (420 sq ft) on the ground floor, arranged as a single open studio. The kitchenette is fully equipped and set along one wall so the floor stays clear. The bathroom is finished to the development's standard rather than to the budget usually applied at this size. A king size bed, a smart television and air conditioning complete a specification that is short because there is nothing missing from it. The terrace is what separates this from a hotel room. It opens directly off the studio at ground level, which in a building of this kind means you use it every day rather than on the two evenings a year the wind drops. The Development MISTIQ Premium is a residential development on Avenida Kukulcán built around a central amenity core, and the amenity is the reason a studio here makes sense where a studio elsewhere might not. Swimming pools with a jacuzzi and loungers, a gymnasium, restaurants and a French bakery, and a mini market for the ordinary business of living. Reception and security are staffed around the clock and there is a concierge. Parking is on site and bicycles can be rented in the building. A shuttle runs to the beach twice a day for the building's residents and guests. The developer describes the gymnasium as the largest private gym in Tulum. Both of those are worth confirming directly with the administration, since shuttle schedules and access terms change with management. Region 15 Region 15 sits between Aldea Zamá and the coast. Access is straight off Avenida Kukulcán rather than the beach road, which in practice means about five minutes to the sand and a similar five to the centre of town, without the queue that builds on the coastal route through the afternoon. El Camello and the seafood places locals actually use are four minutes away. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Setting one up is routine and your notary and bank handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle At this figure the alternatives in Tulum are a pre construction unit in a building with no amenity yet built, or a resale in something older with none at all. This is a finished studio in a serviced development where the pool is full, the gym is open and there is a bakery downstairs. That is a different proposition from a floor plan and a delivery date. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: Avenida Kukulcán, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: five minutes by car to Tulum beach, five minutes to the town centre, direct access from Avenida Kukulcán ⛲️ Features: Ground floor studio with private terrace Fully equipped kitchenette Full bathroom King size bed and smart television Air conditioning Swimming pools, jacuzzi and sun loungers Gymnasium on site Restaurants and French bakery on site Mini market on site Reception and security staffed around the clock Concierge service Parking on site and bicycle rental available Beach shuttle operated for the building 🛏 Studio 🛁 1 bathroom 📏 39 m² (420 sq ft) 💵 $119,000 USD

features.feature: King size bed and smart television

desc.en: Land. Corner lots do not come up often at this size. Manzana 559 Lote 004 is a full 2,500 square metres, fifty by fifty, sitting on the junction of Calle 44 Sur and Calle 59 Sur with frontage to both. Fifty metres away is Avenida Kukulcán, the road that runs from Tulum town down to the hotel zone and the beach. It is titled, it is square, and it is inside the urbanised grid rather than out past the edge of it. The Parcel Two thousand five hundred square metres (26,910 sq ft) in a clean square, fifty metres on every side. The corner position gives two street frontages, which matters more than it sounds: it opens up access and servicing options, allows a scheme to be entered from either side, and on a parcel intended for more than one dwelling it makes phasing and separate entrances straightforward rather than awkward. Density and Use The lot carries an H2 residential density designation under the municipal plan. Buyers should confirm the current coefficients of land occupation and land use, the permitted number of storeys and the applicable unit count directly with the Dirección de Desarrollo Urbano before committing to a scheme, since these parameters are periodically revised and the figure that matters is the one in force at the time of application rather than at the time of purchase. The Position Region 8 sits in the corridor running from Tulum town toward the coast, and Avenida Kukulcán is the road that connects the two. Fifty metres of separation from that avenue is close enough for access and far enough to be off it, which on a residential parcel is the arrangement most buyers are looking for. The hotel zone and the beach lie at the end of the avenue, the town centre lies at the other, and the surrounding blocks are already built and occupied rather than waiting on infrastructure. Title The parcel is escriturado, meaning private title has already been registered. This is not ejido land and there is no dominio pleno conversion to wait on, which removes the single largest source of delay and risk in Tulum land transactions. Buyers should still obtain a current certificate of no encumbrance from the Registro Público de la Propiedad and confirm that predial payments are up to date as a matter of routine. The parcel sits inside Mexico's federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Setting one up is routine and your notary and bank handle it as part of closing. Singular by the Jungle Most of what trades at this size in Tulum is either raw parcel beyond the services or a subdivided lot inside a development with a design code attached. A titled square corner inside the grid, fifty metres off the main avenue, with two frontages and no conversion to complete, is a different kind of thing entirely. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Manzana 559, Lote 004, Region 8, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: 50 m from Avenida Kukulcán, on the corridor between Tulum town and the hotel zone ⛲️ Details: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) 50 m by 50 m, square Corner parcel with double street frontage H2 residential density designation Escriturado, private title registered 50 m from Avenida Kukulcán Within the built and serviced street grid 🏞 Type: Land lot 📏 Size: 2,500 m² (26,910 sq ft) 📜 Title: Escriturado, private title registered 🏗 Density: H2 💵 Price: $1,050,000 USD 📊 Rate: $420 USD per m²

Finished property. Five thousand square metres of jungle, and a house set into it rather than cleared out of it. The approach runs in over gravel under a closed canopy, past low stone planters and flowering shrubs, and arrives at a wall of rustic limestone with a tall timber door set into it. Nothing announces itself from the track. That is the point of building at Rancho San Martin. The House Approximately 200 m² (2,153 sq ft) of construction holding four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms. The main volume runs double height, with a band of clerestory glazing above the main openings that lifts the ceiling line well beyond the usual and pulls light across the plaster from two levels. Full height sliders open the living and dining space to the trees along one side. The material palette is consistent and hand worked rather than specified from a catalogue: warm ochre plaster on the walls, polished concrete underfoot, timber shelving set into recesses, and a sculpted plaster shelving wall in the living area built as part of the structure rather than furniture placed against it. The kitchen works off a concrete island with a breakfast bar and open shelving behind. Bathrooms are clad in split face stone with ceiling mounted rain heads. Stage of Completion The house is described by the owner as approximately 90 percent finished and is fully livable now. Kitchen, bathrooms, glazing, flooring and joinery are all in place and in use. Work outstanding is finishing rather than structural, and a buyer should walk the property with a list and price the remaining items before agreeing terms, since ninety percent is a seller's estimate rather than a surveyed figure. Services The property currently runs off grid. A CFE connection is available and can be taken if a buyer prefers mains supply, which on a lot this size and this far into the jungle is a meaningful choice rather than a formality. Confirm the current arrangement for water, drainage and power, the cost and timeline of a CFE connection, and what capacity the existing off grid system carries. The Land Five thousand square metres (53,820 sq ft) is a little over an acre, and at Rancho San Martin that means genuine separation from neighbours rather than a nominal setback. The owner reports subdivision potential on the parcel. Any subdivision requires municipal authorisation and a buyer should confirm with the Dirección de Desarrollo Urbano what the parcel actually permits before treating it as a given. Rancho San Martin sits inland from the coast between Akumal and Xpu Há, reached off the highway through jungle track. It is quiet, it is unpaved, and services are basic. That is the trade against being twenty minutes from Akumal bay and the reef, and inside a stretch of the Riviera Maya where a lot of this size close to the water is otherwise gone. Title The property sits inside Mexico's federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should obtain a current certificate of no encumbrance from the Registro Público de la Propiedad, confirm the title status of the parcel, and verify that the constructions on site carry the appropriate municipal permits. Singular by the Jungle Four bedrooms, an acre and a quarter of jungle and a house already standing, at a figure that in Tulum now buys a two bedroom condo with a shared pool. What you give up is pavement, mains services as standard and the walk to a restaurant. What you get is a house nobody can build next to. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Rancho San Martin, Akumal, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: inland jungle parcel between Akumal and Xpu Há, around twenty minutes from Akumal bay ⛲️ Features: 5,000 m² (53,820 sq ft) private jungle lot Approximately 200 m² (2,153 sq ft) of construction Four bedrooms, four and a half bathrooms Double height ceilings with clerestory glazing Rustic limestone facade with timber entrance door Polished concrete floors and hand worked plaster throughout Open kitchen with concrete island and breakfast bar Sculpted plaster shelving built into the living area Stone clad walk in showers Off grid services with CFE connection available Approximately 90 percent finished and fully livable Subdivision potential subject to municipal approval 🛏 4 bedrooms 🛁 4.5 bathrooms 📏 200 m² (2,153 sq ft) on 5,000 m² (53,820 sq ft) 💵 $320,000 USD

Finished property. Two front doors, two escrituras, one building. Casa Rosi is a pair of independent units within a small project in La Veleta, sold together, with the option to knock them into a single townhouse or leave them exactly as they are. That optionality is the whole proposition. Live in one and let the other. Use both. Combine them into one house. Or keep them separate and decide later. The Units Departamento 5 holds 92.51 m² (996 sq ft) of interior across two bedrooms and two bathrooms, with an open living and kitchen space and a 20.59 m² (222 sq ft) terrace off the living area. Departamento 5B holds 68.63 m² (739 sq ft) of interior with one bedroom and one bathroom, an open living and kitchen space, and considerably more outdoor area at 44.47 m² (479 sq ft) split across two terraces. Together that comes to 161.14 m² (1,735 sq ft) of interior and 65.06 m² (700 sq ft) of terrace, for a combined 226.20 m² (2,435 sq ft). Three bedrooms and three bathrooms in total, with two kitchens and two living areas as currently configured. The Finish Plainer and more practical than the Tulum norm, and better for it. Concrete counters cast in place, polished concrete and large format tile underfoot, white joinery, open shelving, ceiling fans throughout. The upper terrace sits under a timber pergola with the canopy of the surrounding trees at eye level. Bedrooms carry fitted wardrobes and built in storage. It reads as a building made to be lived in rather than photographed. Combining the Units The two sit adjacent within the same structure and the plans show a stair connecting the levels. Any physical combination would need structural advice and municipal authorisation, and a buyer should establish what the condominium regime permits before assuming the units can be merged. The two escrituras remain separate whether or not the units are physically joined, which is useful: it keeps the option of selling one and keeping the other. La Veleta La Veleta is the residential district west of the highway, and it is where the people who actually live in Tulum have mostly ended up. Quieter than Aldea Zamá, more grown up than Region 15, close enough to the centre to cycle. Streets are a mix of finished and unfinished, which is what keeps prices where they are, and the neighbourhood has filled in steadily with restaurants and small studios rather than large developments. Ownership The property sits within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Two separate escrituras means two separate title processes, which a notary will handle together but which a buyer should budget for accordingly. Singular by the Jungle Most of what trades at this level in Tulum is a one bedroom in a building that has not broken ground. This is built, finished, in use, and comes with two titles and the choice of what to do with them. Not a fantasy, and not trying to be. Viewings are by appointment. 📍 Location: La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: residential La Veleta, cycling distance to the centre of Tulum ⛲️ Features: Two independent units on two separate escrituras Departamento 5: 92.51 m² (996 sq ft) interior, two bedrooms, two bathrooms Departamento 5B: 68.63 m² (739 sq ft) interior, one bedroom, one bathroom Terraces of 20.59 m² and 44.47 m² Combined 226.20 m² (2,435 sq ft) including terraces Two kitchens and two living areas as configured Covered terrace under timber pergola with canopy outlook Fitted wardrobes and built in joinery Ceiling fans throughout Potential to combine into a single townhouse subject to approval Built, finished and in use 🛏 3 bedrooms 🛁 3 bathrooms 📏 226.20 m² (2,435 sq ft) combined 💵 $275,000 USD

desc.en: Land. A cleared and fenced building lot of 261 m² / 2,809 sq ft on Calle 14 in El Cuyo, roughly 250 meters back from the sand. El Cuyo is a working fishing village on the north coast of Yucatán, at the edge of the Ría Lagartos biosphere, and it is still a place where a buildable lot inside the village and within walking distance of the beach comes to market at a village price. 📍 Location Calle 14, Polígono II, N° 212, El Cuyo, municipality of Tizimín, Yucatán. The plot sits inside the village grid on a quiet sand street of low houses and palms, about 250 meters from the beach. Distances as given by the seller: 146 km to Playa del Carmen, 163 km to Cancún, 181 km to Tulum, 262 km to Mérida, 192 km to Chichén Itzá, 35 km to the Ría Lagartos natural park, and roughly 2 hours 30 minutes by road from Cancún International Airport. 📏 The Lot 261 m² / 2,809 sq ft. The cadastral survey gives 10.40 m of frontage to Calle 14 against a rear boundary of 10.00 m, with side boundaries of 25.90 m and 26.10 m, so the parcel is marginally irregular rather than a true rectangle. It is cleared, enclosed by a timber palisade fence with a gate to the street, and carries mature palms and hardwood on and around the boundary. 🌴 El Cuyo El Cuyo sits where the Gulf meets the Caribbean, which gives it steady cross shore wind through most of the year and a following among kitesurfers that has grown without turning the village into a resort town. The beach runs for kilometers with very little built on it. Behind the village, the Ría Lagartos reserve holds flamingos, crocodiles and the pink lakes at Las Coloradas. The road in is good, the village has power, water and mobile coverage, and the pace is closer to a fishing town than to anywhere on the Riviera Maya. ⛲️ Details Land area 261 m² / 2,809 sq ft Frontage 10.40 m to Calle 14 Approximately 250 m from the beach Cleared and fenced with a timber palisade and street gate Mature palms on the plot Walking distance to shops, restaurants and the pier Calle 14, Polígono II, N° 212, El Cuyo, Tizimín, Yucatán Singular by the Coast Buildable lots this close to the beach in El Cuyo do not reach the market often, and those that do tend to be larger and priced accordingly, or set well back from the sand. At 261 m² this is a workable footprint for a single house on a street that is already residential, in a village that has kept its character while the coast either side of it has not. Viewings by appointment. 📏 Land 261 m² / 2,809 sq ft 📐 Frontage 10.40 m 🏖 Distance to beach approximately 250 m 💵 Price $2,700,000 MXN (approximately $158,500 USD) Buyers should satisfy themselves as to title status, permitted density and the connection of services before contracting. El Cuyo lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale, lease and inheritance. The USD figure shown is indicative only and moves with the exchange rate; the contract price is in Mexican pesos.

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Stephanie sits on the corner of Rio Otate and Rio Basca, on the town side of the avenida, roughly seven minutes on foot from Palma Central. Four bedrooms, four bathrooms, a pool and a garden, delivered furnished and ready to use. 📍 Location Tulum Centro. Palma Central is about 600 meters away for food and evenings out, and the Unidad Deportiva with its running track and pitches is around ten minutes on foot. La Veleta and the jungle neighborhoods sit across the avenida; this side of it keeps you in the town, on a residential corner rather than a through street. 🏡 The House 357 m² / 3,843 sq ft of construction on a 480 m² / 5,167 sq ft plot. Four bedrooms and four bathrooms across the plan, with a separate TV room, a laundry, and a dependencia that works as staff quarters, a guest room or a study depending on how the house is used. The living spaces are bright, and the plot carries both a garden and a rear yard rather than a single strip of outdoor space. 🌴 Outside Private pool set in the garden, with a separate backyard behind the house. ⛲️ Features 4 bedrooms 4 bathrooms Private pool Garden and separate backyard TV room Laundry room Dependencia Individual air conditioning units Delivered furnished and turnkey Singular by the Jungle Most houses of this size in Tulum sit out in the newer jungle developments, where a car is not optional. Villa Stephanie is finished, furnished, sized for a family, and inside the town itself, on a corner plot with the depth to keep a pool and two separate outdoor spaces. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 Bedrooms 4 🛁 Bathrooms 4 📏 Construction 357 m² / 3,843 sq ft 📐 Lot 480 m² / 5,167 sq ft 💵 Price $995,000 USD Annual predial is estimated by the owner at approximately 30,000 MXN and should be confirmed against the current municipal assessment. Tulum lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale, lease and inheritance.

Finished property. Oasis is the final phase of Xpu-Ha Beach Residential Resort, 47 titled residential lots running from 602 m² / 6,483 sq ft to 661 m² / 7,118 sq ft. Lots are delivered ready to build, with services already run underground to the lot line, and buyers take access to the resort's beach club and sports facilities from the day they close rather than at some future completion date. 📍 Location Xpu-Ha, municipality of Solidaridad, Quintana Roo, on the coast between Puerto Aventuras and Akumal. Playa del Carmen is roughly 20 minutes north and Tulum about 30 minutes south, with Cancun and Tulum airports each around an hour away. Puerto Aventuras, with its marina, golf club, supermarket and cinema, is five to eight minutes up the road. 📏 The Lots 602 m² / 6,483 sq ft to 661 m² / 7,118 sq ft, with most of the run sitting close to 604 m². Building parameters are set at 35 percent ground coverage and 105 percent total floor area, to a maximum of three levels and 10 meters in height, which allows a substantial house with a pool and garden on any lot in the phase. 💵 Availability and Pricing 29 of the 47 lots remained available on the July 2026 inventory, across four price bands set by position within the phase. Prices run from $3,500,000 MXN, approximately $205,500 USD, to $5,250,000 MXN, approximately $308,000 USD, with the majority of available lots at $4,200,000 MXN, approximately $246,500 USD. The official list is denominated in Mexican pesos and the developer notes that prices are subject to change without notice. Current availability should be confirmed at the time of enquiry. 🌊 The Beach Club The resort's private beach club sits on Xpu Ha beach, one of the wider and calmer stretches on this coast, and is reached from the residential side through a dedicated underpass built for crossing on foot, by bicycle or by golf cart rather than on the highway. The club runs a restaurant and bar, lounge areas, sun terraces and loungers. From the Oasis lots it is about 1.5 km, roughly six minutes by bike. ⚽ The Sports Club A semi olympic pool with a dedicated swim lane, a gym with professional equipment, courts for tennis, padel and pickleball, and a multi use court for basketball, volleyball and football. The Casa Club adds family and adult pools, with ecological trails and a cycle path threading the green areas. 🌴 Infrastructure Hydraulic concrete streets, LED street lighting, pedestrian sidewalks and trails, and all services run underground to the lot line: power, water, drainage and telephone. Entry runs through a double security filter. ⛲️ Details 47 lots in the final phase of the development Lot sizes 602 m² / 6,483 sq ft to 661 m² / 7,118 sq ft Ground coverage 35 percent, total floor area 105 percent Maximum 3 levels and 10 meters in height Titled and ready to sign Immediate delivery, ready to build Underground services at the lot line Beach club access via dedicated underpass, about 1.5 km Full access to resort amenities from closing Singular by the Coast Xpu-Ha sits at the quiet middle of the Riviera Maya, close enough to both Playa del Carmen and Tulum to use either and far enough from both to avoid their traffic. Oasis is the last release inside a resort that has already built and delivered its earlier phases, which means the roads, the beach club and the sports facilities exist rather than being drawn. Viewings by appointment. 📏 Lot sizes 602 m² / 6,483 sq ft to 661 m² / 7,118 sq ft 🏗 Build envelope 35 percent coverage, 3 levels, 10 m maximum height 🏖 Beach club approximately 1.5 km via private underpass 💵 From $3,500,000 MXN, approximately $205,500 USD Lots are held as units of exclusive property within the Condominio Maestro Xpu-Ha Beach regime, each carrying an undivided share of the common property, so buyers should review the condominium rules and the maintenance quota alongside the title. Xpu-Ha lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale, lease and inheritance. USD figures are indicative only and move with the exchange rate; the contract price is in Mexican pesos.

desc.en: Finished property. Selvamia sits inside the Xpu-Ha Beach complex on the coast between Puerto Aventuras and Akumal, laid out as 227 lots of roughly 1,000 m² with an entire block held back as natural green space. It is a deliberately low density scheme: wide plots, retained vegetation, and a plant nursery, kitchen garden and outdoor teaching areas in place of the density that usually comes with a masterplan of this size. 📍 Location Xpu-Ha, municipality of Solidaridad, Quintana Roo. Playa del Carmen is 27.4 km and roughly 20 minutes north, Tulum 42.2 km and about 30 minutes south, and Puerto Aventuras with its marina, golf and supermarket sits 5 km up the road. Cancun and Tulum airports are each around an hour. 📏 The Lots Available plots run from 877 m² / 9,439 sq ft to 1,600 m² / 17,228 sq ft, with most sitting close to 1,000 m². Positions are described by aspect, with lots fronting a park, a garden, a street or a corner, and pricing follows that rather than size alone. 💵 Availability and Pricing 86 of the 227 lots remained available across the most recent inventories, with Manzanas 11 and the greater part of 10 and 12 already placed and the current release concentrated in Manzanas 13 and 15. Prices run from $3,162,000 MXN, approximately $185,500 USD, to $4,301,000 MXN, approximately $252,500 USD. Lists are denominated in Mexican pesos and availability moves, so both should be confirmed at the time of enquiry. 🌴 Within Selvamia Each block carries its own amenities rather than routing everyone to a single clubhouse: recreational pools and jacuzzis, terraces and social areas, bathrooms and showers, picnic stations and green space. Across the scheme there is a pet park, a children's playground, a yoga deck, an outdoor gymnasium and equipped grills. Urbanisation runs to hydraulic concrete roadways, wide pedestrian trails, indirect lighting along the streets, an access control booth and security around the clock. 🌊 Xpu-Ha Beach As part of the wider complex, Selvamia owners have access to the beach club, reached through the paso a desnivel that carries residents under the highway on foot or by bicycle. The club runs a restaurant and bar, pools, sun terraces and loungers, an events salon and lounge areas on one of the better stretches of sand on this coast. The sports club adds a gymnasium, a semi olympic swim lane, changing rooms and lockers, courts for tennis, padel, pickleball and basketball, and a cafeteria. ⛲️ Details 227 lots in total, 86 available at the latest count Available lot sizes 877 m² / 9,439 sq ft to 1,600 m² / 17,228 sq ft Low density layout with a full block of retained green space Plant nursery, kitchen garden and outdoor teaching areas Per block pools, jacuzzis, terraces and social areas Access control booth and 24 hour security Hydraulic concrete roads and pedestrian trails Beach club and sports club access within Xpu-Ha Beach Singular by the Coast Most lot developments on this coast maximise the number of plots and concentrate the amenities in one place. Selvamia does the opposite, giving up a whole block to planting and spreading pools and social space through the scheme, which is why the plots run to 1,000 m² rather than the 600 m² that is standard nearby. Viewings by appointment. 📏 Available lot sizes 877 m² / 9,439 sq ft to 1,600 m² / 17,228 sq ft 🏘 227 lots total, 86 currently available 🏖 Beach club access via private underpass 💵 From $3,162,000 MXN, approximately $185,500 USD Buyers should confirm which shared amenities are complete and in service at the time of purchase, and review the complex rules and maintenance quota alongside the title. Xpu-Ha lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale, lease and inheritance. USD figures are indicative only and move with the exchange rate; contract prices are in Mexican pesos.

desc.en: Land. A little over a hectare inside the Tulum grid. Manzana 910 Lote 002 runs 10,330 square metres between Calle 6 Sur and Calle 8 Sur, with frontage to 25 Avenida Sur Bis, in Region 12 southwest of the town centre. It is escriturado, it has been surveyed, and part of it has already been cleared. Parcels of this size inside the urbanised street network, rather than out past the edge of it, are usually held rather than sold. The Parcel 10,330 square metres (111,192 sq ft), 78.57 metres of frontage by 131.51 metres of depth. The proportion is a long rectangle running back from the street, which is the geometry that suits phased development: a scheme can be entered once from the front and built out toward the rear in stages rather than committing the whole surface at the start. Just over one hectare, held in a single title. What Comes With It The groundwork that normally follows a land purchase has already been done here. A topographic survey has been carried out and contour levels recorded, vehicle access is established, and part of the surface has been cleared. There is also a substantial quantity of loose stone already on the parcel, which on this peninsula is worth counting: limestone won on site is what goes into foundations, retaining walls and hardcore, and having it already there removes a haulage line from the build budget rather than adding one. Density and Use The parcel carries a mixed density designation, with two land use codes recorded against it, PE/rs and Tr1b. Where a parcel of this size carries more than one code, the division across the surface is what determines the buildable envelope. The document to obtain before committing to a scheme is therefore the constancia de uso de suelo from the Dirección de Desarrollo Urbano, showing which portion of the hectare carries which designation, together with the current coefficients of land occupation and land use, the permitted number of storeys and the applicable unit count. Those parameters sit with the municipal plan rather than with the deed and are periodically revised, so the figures that matter are the ones in force at the time of application. The Position Region 12 sits southwest of Tulum town centre, inside the numbered street grid rather than beyond its edge. The cadastral plan shows the surrounding manzanas already divided into numbered lots with the street layout set out around them. Calle 6 Sur runs along the northern edge of the block, Calle 8 Sur along the southern, and 25 Avenida Sur Bis along the western frontage. The Carretera Federal corridor runs a short distance to the northwest. Tulum town centre is roughly three kilometres northeast. The seller reports a cenote nearby, known locally as a hidden cenote, and a number of sustainable developments in the surrounding blocks. Both are worth confirming on the ground, and the cenote in particular carries a due diligence consequence set out below. Title The parcel is escriturado, meaning private title has already been registered. This is not ejido land and there is no dominio pleno conversion to complete, which removes the single largest source of delay and risk in Tulum land transactions. Buyers should still obtain a current certificado de libertad de gravamen from the Registro Público de la Propiedad, confirm that predial payments are up to date, and have the surveyed surface reconciled against the figure recorded in the escritura, since on a parcel of this size even a small percentage discrepancy is a material number. The parcel sits inside Mexico's federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance, or through a Mexican corporation where the intended use is commercial. Your notary will advise which structure fits the plan and handles it as part of closing. Further Due Diligence Three checks are worth making here specifically. The split of the two land use codes across the surface, as above, since it governs how much of the hectare is actually buildable. The position of the reported cenote relative to the boundary, since groundwater in Mexico is national property regardless of who holds the surface title, and proximity to a cenote can carry its own setbacks and constraints on what may be built around it. And the status of service connections to the parcel, water, drainage and electricity, which on the outer reaches of the grid vary block by block rather than region by region. Singular by the Jungle A hectare is not a lot, it is a site. What trades at this size around Tulum is usually raw ground well beyond the services, or a parcel still waiting on its title. A titled hectare inside the numbered grid, surveyed, part cleared, with its stone already on the ground, is a different proposition and a different starting point. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Manzana 910, Lote 002, Region 12, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: between Calle 6 Sur and Calle 8 Sur, frontage to 25 Avenida Sur Bis, approximately 3 km southwest of Tulum town centre ⛲️ Details: 10,330 m² (111,192 sq ft), just over one hectare 78.57 m of frontage by 131.51 m of depth Escriturado, private title registered Mixed density designation, codes PE/rs and Tr1b recorded Topographic survey completed with contour levels Vehicle access established Part of the surface already cleared Substantial loose stone already on the parcel Within the urbanised Tulum street grid Cenote reported nearby, per the seller Approximately 3 km southwest of Tulum town centre 🏞 Type: Land parcel 📏 Size: 10,330 m² (111,192 sq ft) 📐 Dimensions: 78.57 m frontage by 131.51 m depth 📜 Title: Escriturado, private title registered 🏗 Density: mixed, PE/rs and Tr1b 💵 Price: 7,500,000 MXN (approximately $440,000 USD) 📊 Rate: 726 MXN per m² (approximately $43 USD per m²)

desc.en: Land. Manzana 189 Lote 023 sits on the corner of Avenida Guardianes Mayas and Calle 25 Poniente Bis, in Region 15, the residential quarter running southwest of Tulum town. It is 628 square metres, it is escriturado, and it carries a mixed commercial designation alongside its residential density. Two street frontages, one of them an avenue, and a zoning that permits commercial activity rather than excluding it. Most land at this price in Tulum gives a buyer one thing to do with it. This gives a buyer a choice. Density and Use This is where the parcel separates itself. It carries an H2 residential density together with an MS/MB mixed commercial designation, which means commercial use is permitted alongside residential rather than instead of it. A single house is available under it. So is a ground floor local facing the avenue with apartments above it. So is a small residential building, a boutique operation, a wellness or studio use, or an office and services scheme. The designation widens the field of what can go on the ground rather than narrowing it to one answer, and on a corner with avenue frontage that flexibility has somewhere to point. The parcel is escriturado as well, so the zoning sits on top of registered private title rather than on top of an ejido parcel waiting on conversion. The two together are what make this a site a buyer can move on rather than plan around. Confirm the specifics before a scheme is drawn. The constancia de uso de suelo from the Dirección de Desarrollo Urbano will show the designations in force together with the current coefficients of land occupation and land use, the permitted number of storeys and the applicable unit count. Those parameters sit with the municipal plan rather than with the deed and are periodically revised, so the figures that matter are the ones in force at the time of application rather than at the time of purchase. The Lot 628 square metres (6,760 sq ft), 22.14 metres of frontage by 28.47 metres of depth. The proportion is close to square, which is the geometry that gives a designer the most freedom: a plan can open sideways to a pool and a courtyard rather than being pushed back into a corridor, and on a corner parcel it can be entered from either street. The cadastral plan shows why the size matters here. Most of Manzana 189 is divided into narrow strips running back from the interior streets. Lote 023 is one of the few parcels on the block with genuine width, and it holds the avenue frontage. The Corner Two frontages open up what a single frontage closes down. Access and servicing can come from either side, a scheme can present its commercial face to Avenida Guardianes Mayas and take its residential entrance from the quieter interior street, and where more than one unit is intended, separate entrances become straightforward rather than awkward. The 22.14 metres facing the avenue is the number that matters for anyone planning ground floor commercial space, since it sets what can be presented to the street. Avenida Guardianes Mayas is a through route rather than a residential cul de sac, and passing frontage is what gives a commercial designation something to work with. Services Access and electricity are already established on the manzana, which on a Tulum parcel is not a given and is the difference between building and waiting to build. Buyers should confirm the position on water and drainage connections specifically, since these vary block by block on this side of town and are worth establishing before a scheme is drawn rather than after. A commercial ground floor use will also have its own servicing requirements, so establish those early. The Position Region 15 is the part of Tulum where the town has grown inland, a grid of numbered streets and avenues between the centre and the jungle edge, already built and occupied rather than waiting on infrastructure. That resident population is the argument for the commercial designation: a ground floor here has a local customer base rather than depending on visitors finding it. Avenida Kukulkán, the road that runs from town down to the hotel zone and the beach, lies close by to the east. Calle 25 Poniente and Calle 27 Poniente bound the manzana north and south, with Calle 8 Sur along its eastern edge. Title The parcel is escriturado, meaning private title has already been registered. This is not ejido land and there is no dominio pleno conversion to wait on, which removes the single largest source of delay and risk in Tulum land transactions. Buyers should still obtain a current certificado de libertad de gravamen from the Registro Público de la Propiedad, confirm that predial payments are up to date, and have the boundaries as staked on the ground reconciled against the plano and the escritura. The parcel sits inside Mexico's federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance, or through a Mexican corporation where the intended use is commercial. Your notary will advise which structure fits the plan. Singular by the Jungle Corner parcels with width on an avenue do not turn over often in Region 15, and when they do they are usually either inside a development with a design code attached or still carrying an ejido title. A titled square corner, wide across the front, zoned for commercial alongside residential, with power and access already on the block, leaves the decision about what to build with the buyer rather than with the paperwork. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Manzana 189, Lote 023, Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌿 Position: corner of Avenida Guardianes Mayas and Calle 25 Poniente Bis, close to Avenida Kukulkán ⛲️ Details: 628 m² (6,760 sq ft) MS/MB mixed commercial designation with H2 residential density Commercial use permitted alongside residential 22.14 m of frontage by 28.47 m of depth Corner parcel with double street frontage Avenue frontage to Avenida Guardianes Mayas Escriturado, private title registered Vehicle access and electricity on the manzana Close to Avenida Kukulkán Within the built Region 15 street grid 🏞 Type: Mixed commercial land lot 📏 Size: 628 m² (6,760 sq ft) 📐 Dimensions: 22.14 m frontage by 28.47 m depth 📜 Title: Escriturado, private title registered 🏗 Density: H2 residential with MS/MB mixed commercial 💵 Price: $125,600 USD 📊 Rate: $200 USD per m²

Finished property. A cenote at the center of the community, glass and concrete towers wrapped around it, and six ways to live beside it. Xalet Tulum sits on Av Coba, close enough to walk to the town's restaurant strip and a short ride from the beach road — brand new 1 and 2 bedroom lofts, ready for immediate delivery, unfurnished. 📐 Availability, starting from $233,782 USD: Tower A — 1 Bed Loft, 689.43 sq ft — $5,253,000 MXN (≈ $309,912 USD) Tower B — 1 Bed Loft PH, 1,123.22 sq ft — $6,921,600 MXN (≈ $408,354 USD) Tower C — 1 Bed Double-Height Swim-Up, 638.31 sq ft — $3,962,600 MXN (≈ $233,782 USD) Tower Cenote D — 2 Bed + 2 Bath, 1,216.39 sq ft — $8,541,745 MXN (≈ $503,939 USD) Tower F — 1 Bed Loft, 713.65 sq ft — $5,253,000 MXN (≈ $309,912 USD) Level XN — 2 Bed + 2 Bath, 1,216.39 sq ft — $8,541,745 MXN (≈ $503,939 USD) USD figures are approximate, converted at ~16.95 MXN/USD on the day of listing — please confirm exact pricing before publishing. 📍 Location: Av Coba, Tulum, Quintana Roo. The cenote sits at the heart of the community, with residences and walkways built directly around it. Xalet Tulum is a one-of-a-kind development that pairs sustainable management practices with a rare feature for the area: a natural cenote woven into the site itself. Owners are a few steps from the beach, shopping centers, restaurants and the most cosmopolitan corners of the Mayan Riviera — all without leaving the community. 🛠 Developer: Inzignia Capital 🏗️ Status: Brand new, ready for immediate delivery, unfurnished.

Finished property. Nine bedrooms, nine private plunge pools, and a central courtyard pool besides — Hacienda Babylon is a hacienda in Region 15 built less like a family home and more like a small, self-contained resort. Sleeps up to 20 guests, with every operational piece a hotel, retreat or high-end rental business would need already in place. 🏡 A Sanctuary of Modern Luxury Set on a 1,640 m² lot with 940 m² of thoughtfully curated construction, the villa blends natural stone, warm woods and minimalist lines into a sanctuary that feels both organic and undeniably luxurious. At its heart is an iconic central courtyard: an aesthetic pool framed by sculpted stone columns, lush greenery and bespoke loungers that evoke a boutique retreat. Sun-drenched suites with floor-to-ceiling windows, artisanal furnishings and hand-crafted textures carry the design through to every room, with a seamless indoor-outdoor flow throughout. 🛏 The Rooms Nine bedrooms in total: seven with king beds, one with two queen beds, and a master suite with its own private sitting room and king bed. Each of the nine has a private plunge pool attached — no shared pool schedule, no compromise between groups sharing the house. ♨️ Wellness & Social Spaces Central courtyard pool, plus 9 private plunge pools Multiple refined social lounges and elegant communal dining spaces Designer game room with a billiards table Fire pit gathering area beneath the trees Dedicated yoga studio Temazcal for traditional Mayan sweat lodge ceremonies CrossFit-style gym Bicycles for guests 56 solar panels 4 covered parking spaces Independent staff house: double bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and private terrace, keeping operations separate from guest space 📊 The Numbers Created to operate as both a private residence and a high-performance investment, the villa generated $550,000 USD in revenue in its first year of operation, reflecting its desirability among luxury travelers seeking privacy, comfort and elevated design. Both figures are seller-reported — buyers should verify independently against booking and financial records before relying on them. 📍 Location: Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo. 📐 Land: 1,640 m² (17,653 sq ft) 🏗 Construction: 940 m² (10,118 sq ft) 👥 Capacity: up to 20 guests 🔑 Bathrooms: 9.5 🚗 Parking: 4 covered spaces 📈 Year one revenue: $550,000 USD (seller-reported) 💰 Price: $2,800,000 USD Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and handled as part of closing. Viewings by appointment.

Finished property. A turn-key 4-bedroom house in Aldea Zama, finished and furnished to move straight into — no waiting on construction, no guesswork on quality. 📏 The Numbers 📏 Lot: 357.37 m² 🏗 Construction: 326.67 m² 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 🚿 Bathrooms: 3.5 💰 Price: $650,000 USD ✅ Features Private pool Turn key, ready for immediate move-in High quality finishings Gated community 📍 Location: Aldea Zama, Tulum, Quintana Roo — walking distance to Tulum's restaurant and shopping district. Finished property. Villa de Lujo — a striking 4-bedroom residence in Region 8, three minutes from the beach, built around black. Matte black kitchens and furniture, dark star-shaped pendant lights, raw concrete against floor-to-ceiling glass — the kind of contrast that makes the jungle outside look even greener. 🏡 The Villa Two private pools run through the property: one set into the ground-floor lounge behind glass underfoot, the other a rooftop plunge pool with its own terrace and daybeds. Multiple lounge areas, a modern kitchen, and an elegant dining space are enhanced by rich textures — wood, stone, natural fiber — against the villa's dark, industrial-luxe palette. Each of the four bedrooms offers privacy and a sophisticated ambiance, suited to both personal use and luxury vacation rental. 📏 The Numbers 📏 Land: 528 m² (5,683 sq ft) 🏗 Construction: 430 m² (4,629 sq ft) 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 🚿 Bathrooms: 4 🚗 Garages: 2 📅 Built: 2022 💰 Price: $1,050,000 USD 📍 Location: Region 8, Tulum, Quintana Roo — three minutes from the beach, in one of the Riviera Maya's fastest-growing and most desirable locations.
