Establishing one is routine and handled as part of closing.

Finished property. Twenty-six fully furnished lofts stacked five stories over Tulum Centro, with a rooftop pool looking out over the jungle and town skyline — immediate delivery, ready to move in or start renting the day the trust closes. 📐 Availability, starting from $1,200,000 MXN: Ground Floor Loft — Queen Bed & Extra Bed, 33.00 m² (355 sq ft), private garden Ground Floor Loft — King Bed & Extra Bed, 44.00 m² (474 sq ft), private garden Ground Floor Loft — 2 Queen Beds & Extra Bed, 51.00 m² (549 sq ft), private garden Upper-Floor Loft — Queen Bed & Extra Bed, 24.80 m² (267 sq ft) Upper-Floor Loft — King Bed & Extra Bed, 36.00 m² (388 sq ft) Upper-Floor Loft — 2 Queen Beds & Extra Bed, 42.20 m² (454 sq ft) Corner Loft, Levels 2–4 — 2 King Beds & Extra Bed, 51.00 m² (549 sq ft), private terrace MXN figure is the developer's listed starting price; USD figure is approximate, converted at ~16.92 MXN/USD on the day of listing. The source brief didn't break down pricing by unit type — please confirm exact pricing per floor plan before publishing. 🏢 The Building Each loft comes fully equipped and furnished: kitchenette with electric cooktop and stainless sink, mini-split A/C, blackout curtains, smart TV, dresser and clothing rack, and dining and living areas. Ground-floor units open onto a private garden; select corner units on levels 2–4 carry a private terrace. The rooftop level adds a shared pool with wooden sun deck, shower and powder room. 📍 Location In the heart of Downtown Tulum, minutes from the new Maya Train station, banks, pharmacies, supermarkets and the town's restaurant strip — walkable, well-connected, and close to the ADO bus terminal. 💳 Terms Reserve with a $20,000 MXN deposit. Financing available up to 18 months interest-free. HOA is $2,000 MXN/month. Ownership The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and handled as part of closing.

Finished property. Villa Palma is a brand-new contemporary residence on the lagoon in Puerto Aventuras — one of the few properties in the Riviera Maya with its own private dock and direct water access. Four suites, travertine from floor to pool edge, and an architecture that treats the lagoon not as a backdrop but as part of the house. Built in 2026, delivered immediately, unfurnished and ready for its first owner. A House That Opens Onto the Water The ground floor is designed around one idea: no separation between inside and out. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass walls pull back entirely, connecting the open-plan living area to a bar terrace and then straight through to the pool deck and lagoon beyond. Travertine marble runs continuously from the interior through to the exterior — the same stone, the same level, no threshold. Plafones at 3.00 m throughout keep the proportions generous and the light constant. Four Private Suites Upstairs, four bedrooms — each a full suite with its own terrace overlooking the marina and lagoon. Cedar closets, chukum-finished walls, and double-glazed windows throughout. The material palette is deliberately restrained: travertine, chukum, cedar, and matte black ironwork. Nothing competes with the water and sky outside. The Waterfront A travertine-clad pool sits at the property's edge, 8.00 by 4.60 metres, level with the lagoon. Behind it, a 58 m² pergola with a built-in grill for outdoor dining. The garden stretches to 219 m², the terraces to 112 m² — in total, nearly 390 m² of exterior living space, all oriented toward the water. The private dock means a boat can be moored steps from the house. Built to Last, Not to Impress Steel-and-concrete structure. Series 10,000 European-line aluminum window frames. Double-glazed throughout, tempered in bathrooms. Two cisterns with 22 m³ capacity and a water softener. Central air conditioning. Fiber optic internet. No gas installation — fully electric. The construction is finished, documented, and permitted. This is not a promise on paper; it is a house you can walk through today. 📍 Location: Puerto Aventuras, Quintana Roo — a gated community with controlled access on the Riviera Maya corridor between Playa del Carmen and Tulum. The beach is approximately 2 km away. ⛲️ Features: Private dock with direct lagoon access Travertine pool at the water's edge (36.8 m²) Pergola with built-in grill (58.62 m²) Bar terrace facing the waterfront 3.00 m ceiling heights throughout Central air conditioning Two cisterns (22 m³) with water softener Fiber optic internet 2 covered parking spaces Gated community with 24/7 security 🛏 Bedrooms: 4 suites 🛁 Bathrooms: 4 full + 2 half + 2 service 📏 Size: 653 m² (~7,028 sqft) on 750 m² lot 💵 Total Price: $2,950,000 USD The property lies within Mexico's restricted zone, so foreign buyers take title through a fideicomiso, a bank trust conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Establishing one is routine and handled as part of closing. The property is deeded, free of liens, with all construction permits in order. Touristic-residential land use (Tr2b–Tr3). Delivered unfurnished. Immediate delivery.

Finished property. Casa de Lola stands in Aldea Savia, the gated community on 5ta Avenida in Tulum Centro. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, 111 square metres (1,195 sq ft), sold fully furnished and turnkey. The house is styled as a working art gallery: the textiles, ceramics and tapestries on the walls are made locally and can be bought, and the collection rotates. Downtown Tulum is a minute on foot and the beach road is about twelve minutes by car. Living and Dining The living and dining run as one open space. A sectional sofa sits under a macrame hanging, a round dining table seats five beneath a ring pendant, and a breakfast bar takes three more. The kitchen is fully equipped with stone counters, oven and induction hob. Sliding glass doors open to a private enclosed patio with two hanging egg chairs, so the room extends outward on an evening rather than stopping at the glass. Bedrooms Two bedrooms, each with a full en suite bathroom and generous closet space, finished to the same standard as the living areas. Premium linens, textured throws, macrame hangings and organic shaped mirrors throughout. The principal bedroom carries hammocks strung above the headboard, which is a Tulum detail rather than a decorative one. The Art Gallery Concept Every piece on the walls is by a local maker and is available to purchase, and the collection changes. It gives the house an identity that most two bedroom residences in Tulum Centro do not have, and it is the reason the property reads as a place rather than a unit. A turntable and vinyl collection, poetry books and board games are included, as are two bicycles. Aldea Savia The community carries a rooftop adults only infinity pool, a natural lazy river pool, a children's pool and playground, two gyms, tennis courts, outdoor grills, hammock gardens, yoga and meditation spaces, a coworking area with 200 Mbps fibre, and communal dining and social areas. Access is gated with security. Short Term Letting The property has operated as a short term rental and is set up to continue, with a concierge programme covering private chefs, mixology classes, cenote day trips, scooter rentals, airport transfers and guided tours. Trading records are available to qualified buyers on request through the agent. No projection of income or return is made here. The Setting Tulum Centro puts the restaurants, shops and the ADO terminal within walking distance, which is a different daily proposition to the residential quarters further out. The beach road is around twelve minutes by car and Tulum international airport roughly thirty minutes. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. This is a resale by owner. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial, the maintenance quota and the status of any rental permits as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: 5ta Avenida, Aldea Savia, Tulum Centro, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Gated community a minute from downtown, about twelve minutes from the beach road ⛲️ Features: Two bedrooms, each with a full en suite bathroom Fully furnished and turnkey Private enclosed patio with hanging egg chairs Rotating local art gallery concept, pieces available to purchase Fully equipped kitchen with stone counters and induction hob Breakfast bar seating three Turntable and vinyl collection, poetry books, board games Two bicycles included Washer and dryer Air conditioning throughout 200 Mbps fibre optic WiFi Rooftop adults only infinity pool and natural lazy river pool Children's pool and playground Two gyms and tennis courts Hammock gardens, yoga and meditation spaces Coworking area and communal dining Gated community with security 🛏 Bedrooms: 2 🛁 Bathrooms: 2 💵 Price: $200,000 USD

Finished property. Casa Dulce Vida stands on Calle Palenque in La Veleta, the residential quarter running south west of Tulum pueblo. Three bedrooms and four bathrooms across 250 square metres (2,691 sq ft) of construction on a 370 square metre lot, delivered furnished. The house is two storeys with a rooftop, and behind it sits a self contained guest pool house with swim up access to the pool. Downtown Tulum is a short walk north and the beach road about fifteen minutes by car. The Main House Downstairs holds an open kitchen and dining area, the living room, a maid's room with its own bathroom, and access to the front garden and pool. Upstairs are two bedrooms, each with a full en suite bathroom and views over the neighbourhood canopy. The rooftop is reached by internal stairs and is open air, with solar panels already installed and room left for whatever a buyer wants to put up there. The Guest Pool House A standalone studio at the back of the property with its own swim up access to the pool, a kitchenette, and a large chukum bathtub. It functions as a self contained unit, which is what gives the property three bedrooms rather than two and lets it operate as three separate spaces if a buyer wants it to. It works equally as a guest suite or a private retreat within the grounds. Design and Finishes Chukum finished walls in sections, polished concrete floors and pine joinery throughout. Ceiling height is 2.70 metres. The structure is reinforced concrete with hollow block, which is the specification that holds up against the salt and humidity here. The finish is restrained rather than decorative, and it has been left legible rather than covered over. The Grounds The 370 square metre lot carries a front garden with parking, the pool area, a landscaped backyard, a hanging net lounge and a jacuzzi. The pool runs between planted palms with a timber bridge across it. The perimeter is fully walled. Solar panels supply the pool equipment and parts of the house, which on a property running air conditioning and pool plant is a material difference to the standing cost of ownership. The Setting Calle Palenque is a quiet residential street in the heart of La Veleta, between 5ta Avenida and Avenida Kukulkan, within walking distance of restaurants, shops and Tulum Centro. La Veleta has taken the bulk of Tulum's residential building over the past five years, which means roads and services are good by local standards while the canopy has largely stayed intact. Tulum international airport lies roughly twenty five minutes south west. Ownership The property is titled, free of liens and in good condition, with residential land use designation H/3/45. It lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial and the land use designation as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Calle Palenque, La Veleta, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Quiet residential street between 5ta Avenida and Avenida Kukulkan ⛲️ Features: Three bedrooms across the main house and guest pool house Four bathrooms in total Guest pool house with swim up pool access and kitchenette Full size chukum bathtub in the guest casita Maid's room with its own bathroom Rooftop terrace reached by internal stairs Solar panels installed Swimming pool with timber bridge and planted palms Jacuzzi and hanging net lounge Landscaped backyard and front garden with parking Fully walled perimeter Chukum finished walls and polished concrete floors Pine joinery throughout, 2.70 m ceiling height Reinforced concrete and hollow block construction Delivered furnished 🛏 Bedrooms: 3 (2 in the main house, 1 guest studio) 🛁 Bathrooms: 4 📏 Size: 250 m² (2,691 sq ft) on a 370 m² lot 💵 Price: $480,000 USD

Finished property. SLS Harbour Beach stands at Novo Cancun, inside the gated Puerto Cancun development, and this residence occupies the fourteenth floor of it. Three bedrooms, four full bathrooms, 260 square metres (2,798 sq ft) of interior space, sold fully furnished and turnkey. The tower is the work of Piero Lissoni, and the apartment sits on the curve of the building where the glazing turns to hold the marina on one side and the open Caribbean beyond it. Design and Finishes Floor to ceiling glazing runs the length of the living space, so the terrace and the interior read as one room rather than two. Finishes were specified to the building's own standard rather than chosen unit by unit, which is why the apartment reads as a piece of the architecture instead of a fit out inside it. The kitchen is fully equipped with high end appliances and opens to the dining and living run rather than being closed off behind a wall. Bedrooms Three bedrooms, every one of them carrying its own full bathroom. A fourth full bathroom serves the living space and guests. A family room sits off the main living area and works as a second sitting room, a study, or a fourth sleeping space depending on how the household uses it. A service room with its own full bathroom sits apart from the main bedrooms, which is the arrangement that lets staff live in without the house feeling shared. The Terrace The terrace runs off the living space at the building's widest point, which is where the view opens out across the marina to the sea. It is wide enough to be used rather than looked at, and on a fourteenth floor on this coast it is where most of the living happens. The Building SLS Harbour Beach carries a private beach club, a pool terrace looking over the Caribbean, a fitness centre, a kids club and activity lounge, concierge and 24 hour security. Residents also have access to Ciel Spa at SLS Cancun, which is the hotel operation next door rather than a facility built for the residences alone. The marina below the building runs to 175 slips and takes vessels of any size, which matters if a boat is part of the reason for buying here. Furnished and Turnkey The residence is sold fully furnished and equipped. Nothing needs specifying, ordering or waiting on. At this level in Cancun that is less common than the listings suggest, and it is the difference between owning the apartment this season and owning it next. The Setting Puerto Cancun is a master planned community rather than a strip of towers. Inside the gate sit an 18 hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf, the Marina Town Center with more than a hundred shops and boutiques, a cinema complex, and the restaurants along the water. Cancun international airport is roughly twenty minutes south, and the hotel zone begins a few minutes east. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial, the maintenance quota and the building's regulations as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Novo Cancun, Puerto Cancun, Cancun, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Fourteenth floor, facing the marina and the Caribbean ⛲️ Features: 260 m² (2,798 sq ft) of interior space Three bedrooms, each with a full bathroom Four full bathrooms in total Family room or flexible fourth space Service room with its own full bathroom Fully equipped kitchen with high end appliances Floor to ceiling glazing to the living space Private terrace with marina and ocean views Sold fully furnished and turnkey Private beach club and Caribbean pool terrace Fitness centre and access to Ciel Spa at SLS Cancun Kids club and activity lounge Marina with 175 slips Concierge and 24 hour security Tom Weiskopf 18 hole golf course within Puerto Cancun

Finished property. Villa 14 stands in Las Olas at La Marina, the waterfront cluster inside the gated Puerto Cancun development. Four bedrooms and a service room, five and a half bathrooms, 800 square metres (8,611 sq ft) of construction arranged over four levels, with a private pool on the roof. The marina and the Puerto Cancun plaza are reached directly from the cluster without leaving the gate. Four Levels The house is distributed rather than stacked. Each level carries its own function instead of repeating the plan above the one below, which means the household can occupy the house at different heights at the same time without being on top of one another. At 800 square metres across four floors, that distribution is what stops the volume feeling like a block. Bedrooms Four bedrooms, with five and a half bathrooms in total, and a separate service room. The half bathroom serves the living floor and guests. The bedroom count is modest for the footprint, which is deliberate: the space has gone into the rooms rather than into more of them. The Rooftop The top level is given over to a private pool and the views that come with being above everything around it, across the marina and the development. It is the part of the house that does the work on an evening, and it is the reason the fourth level exists at all. Parking A covered garage takes six cars. That number means something in Puerto Cancun, where street parking is not the answer and most houses at this size manage two or three. For a household with visitors, or a buyer who keeps more than one vehicle in Mexico, it removes a problem that is otherwise permanent. The Setting La Marina has 24 hour security and controlled access, direct access to the marina and the Puerto Cancun plaza, and a children's play area. The wider development holds the Tom Weiskopf golf course, the Marina Town Center and the restaurants along the water, all inside the gate. Cancun international airport lies roughly twenty minutes south. Price The asking price is $39,000,000 MXN. The USD figure shown on this listing is indicative, converted at approximately 17 pesos to the dollar, and it moves with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial, the maintenance quota and the cluster's regulations as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: La Marina, Puerto Cancun, Cancun, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Waterfront cluster with direct marina and plaza access ⛲️ Features: 800 m² (8,611 sq ft) of construction Four carefully distributed levels Four bedrooms plus a service room Five and a half bathrooms Rooftop with private pool and open views Covered garage for six cars 24 hour security and controlled access Direct access to the marina and Puerto Cancun plaza Children's play area within the cluster Tom Weiskopf 18 hole golf course within Puerto Cancun Marina Town Center shopping and waterfront dining

features.feature: Four bedrooms plus a service room

desc.en: Finished property. Unit 501 sits in SLS Marina Beach Residences at Novo Cancun, the third residential tower with hotel style service inside the gated Puerto Cancun development. Three bedrooms, each with its own en suite, a service bedroom with its own bathroom, and terraces facing the marina and the Caribbean. Sold fully furnished and equipped. The building is the work of Grow Arquitectos with the international design firm Meyer Davis, twenty storeys holding 104 residences. Design and Finishes The living and dining run as one open plan space behind floor to ceiling windows, so the terrace and the interior read together rather than as separate rooms. Finishes were specified to the building's own standard rather than chosen unit by unit, which is what gives the residence its consistency and why it does not read as a fit out dropped inside someone else's architecture. Bedrooms Three bedrooms, every one of them carrying its own en suite bathroom. A separate service bedroom has a private bathroom of its own, and there is a dedicated laundry room rather than a cupboard doing the job. The arrangement means three parties can occupy the residence without sharing anything, and staff can live in without the apartment feeling shared. The Terraces The terraces are wide enough to be used rather than looked at, and they face the marina with the Caribbean beyond it. On a fifth floor the view sits above the waterfront without losing the detail of it, which is a different proposition to the higher floors in the same tower. The Building Direct access to the private beach club at Novo Cancun, an infinity rooftop pool and sun deck, a gym and spa, a clubhouse with lounge areas, 24 hour concierge running hotel style services, and controlled access with round the clock security. The service model is the distinction here. It is a residence that behaves like a hotel when the owner wants it to and like a home when they do not. Furnished and Turnkey The residence is sold fully furnished and equipped, so it is usable from the day it changes hands. Nothing needs specifying, ordering or waiting on. The Setting Puerto Cancun is a master planned community rather than a strip of towers. Inside the gate sit an 18 hole golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf, the marina, the Marina Town Center with more than a hundred shops, a cinema complex and the restaurants along the water. Cancun international airport is roughly twenty minutes south. Price The asking price is $27,900,000 MXN. The USD figure shown on this listing is indicative, converted at approximately 17 pesos to the dollar, and it moves with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the current predial, the maintenance quota and the building's regulations as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Novo Cancun, Puerto Cancun, Cancun, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Fifth floor, facing the marina and the Caribbean ⛲️ Features: Three bedrooms, each with an en suite bathroom Service bedroom with private bathroom Dedicated laundry room Open plan living and dining with floor to ceiling windows Expansive terraces with marina and ocean views Sold fully furnished and equipped Direct access to the Novo Cancun private beach club Infinity rooftop pool and sun deck Gym and spa facilities Clubhouse with lounge areas 24 hour concierge with hotel style services Controlled access and 24 hour security Designed by Grow Arquitectos with Meyer Davis Twenty storey tower of 104 residences

features.feature: Infinity rooftop pool and sun deck

desc.en: Finished property. AMAN Jungle Residences stands in Region 15, a gated development of townhouses built inside standing jungle rather than on cleared ground. Two and three bedroom houses from 116 to 290 square metres of construction, every bedroom with its own full bathroom, and every house with a private terrace and plunge pool. Prices start at $4,800,000 MXN for the entry model. Casa Tipo A 116 square metres (1,249 sq ft) of construction on a 56 square metre architectural footprint. Two bedrooms, each with a full bathroom, a terrace with a plunge pool, and a service area. Built with the lock off system. Casa Tipo B 175 square metres (1,884 sq ft) of construction on the same 56 square metre footprint, so the additional space goes upward rather than outward and the house keeps the same relationship to the jungle around it. Three bedrooms, each with a full bathroom, a terrace with a plunge pool, and a service area. Also built with the lock off system. Casa Tipo C 290 square metres (3,122 sq ft) of construction, of which 217 square metres is habitable, on a 92 square metre footprint. Three bedrooms with full bathrooms, a double height of 4.2 metres across the ground floor, and a terrace carrying both the plunge pool and a full bathroom of its own. Tipo C is not listed with the lock off system. The Lock Off On Tipo A and Tipo B, part of the house can be closed off and let independently while the owner keeps the rest. It is the difference between a house that sits empty when the owner is not in it and one that does not, and it is the specification that decides how these houses are used rather than how they look. Water and Power The whole development runs on its own water treatment plants, and each house additionally carries a four step filtration system of its own. Electrical eco technologies are used throughout. In Tulum, where municipal water and power are both less dependable than the brochures admit, a scheme that treats its own water and filters it again at the house is a materially different proposition to one connected and hoping. Security and Service The private is gated with 24 hour security and a 24 hour concierge service. The houses are set among retained jungle rather than facing one another across a road, which is what the privacy in the name actually refers to. The Setting Region 15 sits inland on the south side of Tulum, one of the areas that has taken the bulk of the town's residential building over recent years, which means roads and services are good by local standards. Tulum international airport lies roughly twenty minutes south, and the beach road is reached through the pueblo to the east. Price and Terms From $4,800,000 MXN for the entry model. The USD figure shown on this listing is indicative, converted at approximately 17 pesos to the dollar, and it moves with the rate. Per model pricing for Tipo B and Tipo C is available on request. The developer offers financing over three years at 0% interest, on their terms. Ownership The property lies within the federally restricted zone, so foreign buyers acquire through a fideicomiso, the standard bank trust used throughout the Riviera Maya, conferring full rights of use, sale and inheritance. Buyers should confirm the escritura, the land use designation and the status of the development's permits as part of standard due diligence. Viewings by appointment. 📍 Location: Region 15, Tulum, Quintana Roo 🌴 Position: Gated private set among retained jungle, south of the pueblo ⛲️ Features: Two and three bedroom townhouses from 116 to 290 m² Every bedroom with its own full bathroom Private terrace with plunge pool on every house Lock off system on Tipo A and Tipo B Double height of 4.2 metres on Tipo C Terrace bathroom on Tipo C Service area in every model Development wide water treatment plants Four step water filtration in each house Electrical eco technologies throughout 24 hour security and controlled access 24 hour concierge service Houses set among retained jungle Developer financing over three years at 0% interest

Finished property. Kaan Ha occupies the upper levels of a low rise condominium building inside Tulum Country Club, laid out over three floors with 240 square metres of construction. The living floor opens through floor to ceiling glazing onto a terrace facing the fairway, and the stair climbs to a private rooftop with its own plunge pool. Inside, a wall of rough cut limestone runs the length of the main living room, set against polished travertine floors and a floating stair with a full height glass balustrade. The ceiling opens to double height where the stair rises, so the main volume reads considerably taller than its footprint suggests. Sliding glazing pulls the terrace into the room. The residence is sold furnished and has been lived in rather than staged for photographs. Layout Three bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms across three levels. The principal bedroom and a second bedroom sit on the middle floor, each with its own glazed terrace and louvred shading against the afternoon sun. The architect plan records the unit as a penthouse loft with a lock off, meaning one bedroom can be closed behind its own entrance and used independently of the rest of the home. That suits an owner who occupies part of the year, and it is worth asking to see the plan before relying on it. The rooftop The rooftop is the reason to take this unit rather than a lower floor. A louvred pergola shades a dining table for eight, a masonry counter runs along one side for a grill, and the plunge pool sits at the open edge behind a glass balustrade. The outlook is jungle canopy in the foreground and the golf course beyond it, with the low Tulum skyline on the horizon. The setting Tulum Country Club is a gated golf community built around the PGA Riviera Maya course, and the fairway sits directly below the terrace. Residents share two large swimming pools, a gym, a coworking lounge, a multipurpose room and a play area for children. The grounds are planted densely enough that neighbouring buildings are largely screened by palms. Most of what trades at this level in Tulum is a floor plan and a delivery date. This is finished, furnished and standing.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Xaha stands on a lot of 1,262.83 square metres inside Tulum Country Club, with 750 square metres of construction arranged as six independent suites around a shared social core. It sleeps fourteen. The building was conceived closer to a small private hotel than a family house and it runs that way, with a reception, a lounge, a dining room, a full kitchen behind it and a terrace with a barbecue opening onto the pool and gardens. The suites Each of the six suites has its own bathroom. A deluxe suite sits on the ground floor with a garden outlook, a private terrace and an unheated plunge pool of its own. A superior suite, also at ground level, looks across the pool to the golf course. The master suite takes the upper floor with golf course views, a living area with a sofa bed and a fully equipped kitchen, so it can be closed off and used independently of the rest of the house. Materials Marble, granite and natural stone run through the building, warmed by handcrafted tzalam and parota timber. Air conditioning is fitted in the suites and in the common areas. Four parking spaces sit on the lot, and separate bathrooms serve the reception and lounge so visitors never cross into private space. The setting Tulum Country Club is a gated community built around a PGA certified golf course, with paved roads, controlled access and security around the clock. Downtown Tulum is fifteen minutes away and the coast a short drive beyond it. A house that sleeps fourteen across six lockable suites is a different proposition from a large family villa. It suits an owner who wants flexibility over how the building is occupied without rearranging it each time.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Casa Kabil is a contemporary residence on a 375 square metre lot in La Privada, the gated enclave inside Aldea Zama. Three hundred and sixty square metres of construction rise over three storeys and finish on a rooftop, and there is a swimming pool on both the ground floor and the roof. Layout Three bedrooms sit above a full ground floor of social space, with a separate maid room and its own private bathroom bringing the total to four and a half bathrooms. The kitchen is fully equipped and there is a dedicated laundry area with washer and dryer. The house is sold turnkey and is ready to occupy from the day it changes hands. Energy Solar panels are installed and carry part of the load, which matters more in Tulum than the brochures usually admit. Running costs on a house of this size, with two pools and air conditioning across three floors, are not trivial, and the panels take a measurable share off the monthly bill. La Privada and Aldea Zama La Privada is gated within a gated community, with controlled access and security around the clock. Residents have a clubhouse with a swimming pool and a padel court. A gourmet market, restaurants and a convenience store sit directly across the street, which is unusual in Tulum, where most residential addresses still involve a drive for groceries. Aldea Zama is the most established residential district in Tulum, and the part of the town where infrastructure arrived first. Houses here trade on that.

features.feature: Second swimming pool on the rooftop
Laundry area with washer and dryer

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Amayal occupies a 376 square metre lot in La Privada, Aldea Zama, with a further 144 square metres of exclusive use area attached to it. Four hundred square metres of construction run over three storeys and finish on a rooftop, and there is a private swimming pool on the ground floor as well as a second pool on the roof. Layout Five bedrooms and six and a half bathrooms, which is a generous ratio even at this level, and it means guests are never sharing. The kitchen is fully equipped. The house is delivered turnkey with the interior design in place rather than as a shell to be furnished, and the specification of that work is a good deal higher than the market standard for a house of this size. The exclusive use area The 144 square metres of exclusive area is worth understanding before viewing. It is not lot in the ordinary sense and it is not common area either, and how it may be used is set by the community rules. Ask to see them alongside the escritura. La Privada and Aldea Zama La Privada sits gated inside Aldea Zama, with access control and security around the clock, a clubhouse with a swimming pool and a padel court. Restaurants, a fresh market and a convenience store are directly across the street. Aldea Zama is where Tulum built its infrastructure first, and where the paved roads, drainage and services are oldest and most reliable. That is most of the reason houses here hold their position.

features.feature: Second swimming pool on the rooftop

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Yaxkin sits on a 382 square metre lot in La Privada, Aldea Zama, with 130 square metres of exclusive use area beyond it. Two hundred and seventy square metres of construction run over two storeys and a rooftop. There is a private swimming pool on the ground floor and a second on the roof. Layout Four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms. The kitchen is fully equipped, a washer and dryer are included, and the villa is delivered turnkey and furnished rather than as an empty shell. For a buyer arriving from abroad that removes the single most tedious part of the process, which in Tulum routinely runs to months. Twenty four solar panels The array is the detail worth pausing on. Twenty four panels on a 270 square metre house is a serious installation rather than a token gesture, and on a property running two pools and air conditioning across two floors it takes a real share off the monthly electricity bill. Ask for twelve months of CFE statements at viewing and the effect will be visible in the numbers. La Privada and Aldea Zama La Privada is gated within Aldea Zama, with access control and security around the clock, and residents share a clubhouse with a swimming pool and a padel court. Restaurants, a fresh market and a convenience store sit across the street. This is the smallest of the La Privada villas on our books and the one that asks least of a buyer on arrival.

features.feature: Second swimming pool on the rooftop

desc.en: Finished property. Casa 65 Tortugas is a three level family house on a 329.92 square metre lot inside Tulum Country Club, with 304.67 square metres of construction and a private swimming pool. Layout Three bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms. The ground floor bedroom opens directly onto the pool, and the two bedrooms on the second floor open onto a balcony that wraps around the house. The kitchen is fully equipped. There is an enclosed garage with an electric gate, which is less common here than it should be and matters during the rains. The back boundary The house backs directly onto the community common areas, so it has private access to the amenities without going out onto the street, and nothing will be built behind it. In a community still filling in, knowing what sits on the far side of your back wall is worth more than most of what appears on a specification sheet. Community and setting Residents share a family swimming pool, a children pool, a playground and two palapas with barbecue grills. Tulum Country Club is gated, with paved roads, controlled access and security around the clock, built around a PGA certified golf course. Downtown Tulum is fifteen minutes away. This is a family house rather than a rental instrument, and it reads that way in person.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Villa Grieta sits on a lot of 1,050 square metres in Yalku, the private community at Akumal, with 579 square metres of interior construction and a further 650 square metres of exterior in patios and deck. It has four bedrooms and six and a half bathrooms, two private swimming pools, a rooftop pool, a temazcal, a sunken conversation pit and a cenote of its own. The materials The timber is the reason to see this house in person. Tzalam, zapote, jabin and parota were cut from the owner private ranch or taken through recycled channels, then kiln dried and naturally treated by hand. Those are dense tropical hardwoods, and treated this way they stand up to salt air, movement and boring insects in a way that imported softwood on this coast simply does not. On a beachside house that is a maintenance question before it is an aesthetic one. The art Custom pieces by Rigoberto Orozco are included with the estate rather than staged for the photographs. Confirm the schedule of works in writing at offer stage, since art included in a sale is unusual enough here that it belongs in the contract rather than the conversation. Yalku and Akumal Yalku is private and gated with security around the clock, and the house looks out to sea. Akumal sits between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, and is known for the reef and the calm water in the bay. Houses with their own cenote come up rarely, and rarely at this level of finish.

Finished property. White Condo is a one bedroom penthouse in Tulum Centro with a private rooftop of its own, a terrace and a pool in the building. One bedroom, one bathroom. The rooftop is the point of the unit and the reason to take the top floor rather than a lower one, and in a town where most one bedroom stock offers a balcony and nothing more, private outdoor space at this price is the distinguishing feature. What is not recorded The fact sheet for this unit gives no floor area, and we have not published one rather than estimate it from photographs. Ask for the measured area and the cedula catastral before making an offer, and expect to see both before signing anything. The same goes for the maintenance fee, which is not stated either. Tulum Centro Centro is the working town rather than the hotel strip. Shops, the market, schools and the bus station are all walkable, and it is the part of Tulum where full time residents actually live. Prices per square metre sit well below Aldea Zama and the beach road, which is most of the appeal at this level. At one hundred and ten thousand dollars this is entry level for Tulum, and the honest reading is that it suits a buyer who wants a foothold in the town rather than a trophy.

Finished property. Takh is a two bedroom apartment of 102.9 square metres on the third level, in the Cancun hotel zone and a short walk from the beach. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms. The position is the substance of this one. The hotel zone is a narrow strip of land with the Caribbean on one side and the Nichupte lagoon on the other, and the difference between an address on it and an address off it is not a matter of a few minutes. What is nearby Puerto Cancun Marina Town Center and Plaza La Isla cover the shopping, and the Costa Occidental National Park at Isla Mujeres is reachable for the day. The airport is closer from here than from anywhere in the Riviera Maya proper. Worth checking The fact sheet does not record the lot, the maintenance fee or the year of construction, and it does not say whether the apartment comes furnished. Ask for all four. Hotel zone buildings vary widely in age and in how well the condominium has been run, and the fee is the number that tells you which you are looking at. Cancun is a different market from Tulum. It is older, deeper and less prone to sudden swings, and buyers who want the coast without the volatility tend to end up here.

Finished property. Terrazas PH402 runs to 211 square metres over two levels on one of the more established streets in Playa del Carmen Centro. The lower level holds 100 square metres and a terrace, the upper level 111 square metres and a second, larger terrace. Layout Three bedrooms plus a studio and TV room with a day and night bed, four full bathrooms and a guest bathroom. Kitchen, dining and living are fully fitted. There is a service closet, a laundry area and a large parking space. The two levels are built to work as a lock off, so they can be occupied together or closed off and used separately. The upper terrace This is the part that is genuinely unusual. The terrace carries a heated plunge pool with a spa option, a decorative waterfall with its own lighting, a bar, a dining table and a lounge. Above it sits a retractable roof on a remote and a mobile app, with storm shutters alongside it. On this coast that combination is the difference between a terrace that works nine months of the year and one that works all twelve, through the rains and through a blow. Playa del Carmen Centro Centro is walkable, dense and already built out, which is why penthouse stock here is thin. Nothing new is going up on the good streets.

features.feature: Lower level of 100 m2 with terrace
Upper level of 111 m2 with terrace
Heated plunge pool with spa option
Terrace bar dining and lounge area

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Playa del Carmen.

desc.en: Finished property. A805 is a two bedroom penthouse of 171.95 square metres in Bosques Mayakoba, inside the master planned community of Ciudad Mayakoba in Playa del Carmen. It has a private roof garden and one parking space. The community Ciudad Mayakoba is the most thoroughly planned residential development in Playa del Carmen and it does not behave like the rest of the market. More than 60,000 square metres are held as green area, there is a private natural cenote inside the grounds, and the infrastructure went in before the houses rather than after them. Access is controlled and security runs around the clock. Amenities Residents share a semi Olympic swimming pool and a children pool, a clubhouse with a gym, tennis and paddle courts, rooftop lounges with jacuzzis, an outdoor cinema and barbecue areas, a kids and juniors club, and walking trails through the landscaping. Phasing The development runs in two phases. La Ceiba is almost sold out and Roble is the newer stage, carrying more amenities. Establish which phase a unit sits in before you compare prices between them, because the two are not equivalent and the sheets do not always make the distinction plain. Two bedroom stock with private outdoor space at this level is scarce in Playa, and a roof garden of this size is scarcer still.

features.feature: More than 60 000 m2 of green areas

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Playa del Carmen.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Villa 09 puts 1,044 square metres of construction on a plot of 1,915.40 square metres inside Tulum Country Club. That ratio is the story. Most of what sells at this level in Tulum crowds the build to the boundary, and here more than eight hundred square metres of the site stays open as garden. Layout Five bedrooms and six bathrooms, with a gym, an office that doubles as a family room, and separate maid quarters. Living and dining are laid out for numbers rather than for a couple. Ceilings are high and the glazing is generous, so the social floor holds light well into the afternoon. Built on demand This is an on demand build rather than a finished house standing empty, which means the specification is still open and the timeline starts when the contract is signed. That cuts both ways. A buyer who wants to influence finishes has room to do it, and a buyer who wants to move in this season should look elsewhere on our books. Ask for the construction schedule and the payment ladder in writing before committing. Tulum Country Club Residents have a PGA certified golf course, a clubhouse with pool, spa and gym, tennis and paddle courts and beach club access. The community is gated with controlled access and security around the clock.

features.feature: Clubhouse with pool spa and gym

property.notes: Stage: pre-construction. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Villa 25 carries the same 1,044 square metres of construction as its sister house on plot 09, set here on a tighter site of 1,368 square metres. The house is identical in layout and specification. The difference is the land, and it is reflected in the price. Layout Five bedrooms and six bathrooms, with a gym, an office that also works as a family room, and separate maid quarters. The living and dining areas are sized for entertaining. High ceilings and full height glazing carry natural light through the social floor. Built on demand Like Villa 09, this is built to order rather than standing finished. Finishes remain open to a buyer who wants a say in them, and the clock starts at contract rather than at handover. Ask for the schedule and the payment ladder in writing, and compare both against Villa 09 before choosing between the two, since the houses are the same and only the ground differs. Tulum Country Club A PGA certified golf course, a clubhouse with pool, spa and gym, tennis and paddle courts, and beach club access. Gated, with controlled access and security around the clock.

features.feature: Clubhouse with pool spa and gym

property.notes: Stage: pre-construction. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Residence 203 runs to 192.73 square metres at SLS Marina Beach in Puerto Cancun, sold fully furnished and equipped. Layout Three bedrooms and five bathrooms, with a service room carrying its own private bathroom. Living and dining are open plan behind floor to ceiling glazing, and the terraces are deep enough to use rather than merely to look at, facing the ocean and the marina. The building SLS Marina Beach Residences sits inside Puerto Cancun with direct access to the private beach at Novo Cancun. There is an infinity edge pool, a fitness centre, spa and wellness facilities, concierge and hotel style service, and security around the clock behind controlled access. Why the second floor Unit 203 sits low in the building. Buyers chasing the highest floor should know the trade honestly: the view from a second floor terrace is shorter, but the terrace is used more, the lift matters less, and the price per square metre is lower than the same layout eight floors up. Whether that is the right side of the trade depends entirely on whether the residence is to be lived in or looked at. Puerto Cancun is a settled, serviced address rather than a bet on a coming one.

Finished property. Residence 1806 runs to 260 square metres on a high floor at SLS Puerto Cancun, delivered turnkey and ready to occupy. Interiors The interiors are by Piero Lissoni, which is the detail that separates this building from its neighbours. Lissoni works in restraint rather than ornament, and the result reads quieter in person than the renderings suggest. There is a gourmet kitchen open to the dining area, a large ocean view terrace, a maid room with its own service area, and two private parking spaces. Layout Three bedrooms and four bathrooms. At 260 square metres on a single level this is a genuinely large apartment by Cancun standards, and the floor plan spends that area on the social side rather than on corridors. The building and the address Private beach access and a waterfront promenade, a gym and spa, an infinity edge pool, restaurants and bars, concierge and valet around the clock, a children play area and multipurpose rooms. Puerto Cancun holds its own marina and a golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf, and the Marina Town Center sits within the development for shopping. Floor eighteen puts the terrace above the tree line and the noise.

Finished property. Villa Muun is a 246 square metre house in the Muun Tulum development in Tulum Centro, laid out over three levels and a rooftop terrace and delivered fully furnished. Layout Four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms. The house is turnkey rather than a shell, and at this price that is the part worth weighing: four bedrooms furnished and finished, in central Tulum, for under three hundred thousand dollars is a long way below what the same configuration costs in Aldea Zama or on the beach road. The development Residents share a swimming pool, a rooftop viewpoint terrace, a games room, a dedicated yoga room and a climbing wall, with security and controlled access around the clock. The climbing wall is not a detail we would normally note, but it is genuinely unusual here and it tells you who the building was designed for. Tulum Centro Centro is the working town. The market, the schools, the bus station and the day to day shops are walkable, and it is where full time residents actually live rather than visit. Prices per square metre sit well under the tourist corridor. For a buyer who wants four bedrooms and does not need a beach address, this is among the most efficient uses of the money on our books.

Finished property. PH 301 at Tuk Origen runs to 210 square metres in Tulum Centro, with two bedrooms on a lock off system and a rooftop terrace carrying a private pool. The lock off Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, arranged so one side can be closed off behind its own entrance and used independently. That is the practical value of this unit rather than a line on a sheet: an owner can occupy half and leave the other half separate, without moving through shared space. The building Tuk Origen was built as a condo hotel and it carries the amenities that implies. There is an elegant lobby, two pools including a panoramic rooftop pool, a cenote inspired courtyard, a rooftop bar, an on site restaurant, lounge areas and landscaped green space, a commercial zone with boutique shops, and private beach club access. What to check Condo hotel buildings carry higher running costs than a plain residential block, because the amenities have to be staffed. Ask for the current maintenance fee and the last two years of condominium accounts before making an offer. A building that runs a restaurant and a bar has a cost base, and the fee is where it shows up. Two hundred and ten square metres with a private rooftop pool is a great deal of unit for a two bedroom.

features.feature: Two bedrooms with lock off system

desc.en: Finished property. GH 105 is a ground floor residence at Paramar Viva, in the newest phase of Aldea Zama. The unit totals 196 square metres, of which 97 is interior and 99 is private garden, with a plunge pool of its own. Layout Two bedrooms on a lock off system and two bathrooms. Roughly half the area you are buying is outdoors, which is unusual for a condominium at this price and is the reason to take a ground floor unit rather than a higher one. The garden is genuinely private rather than a strip of planting against a shared path. The development Paramar Viva is the sixth development under the Paramar name and sits in Selvazama, a pedestrian first neighbourhood built around electric mobility, bike paths and elevated walkways. Residents share an infinity pool with a jacuzzi, a rooftop palapa sky bar, a coworking space, a fully equipped gym, an outdoor cinema, a kids and juniors club, and concierge service around the clock. This is a resale The unit is being sold on by its owner rather than by the developer. That usually means a shorter path to closing and a price set by a person rather than a price list, and it means the escritura and the maintenance account should both be checked as they stand today.

features.feature: Two bedrooms with lock off system

desc.en: Finished property. Helices Garden B101 is a two bedroom apartment of 95.10 square metres on a lot of 146.76 square metres inside Tulum Country Club. Layout Two bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms. The ground floor position gives the unit direct outdoor space rather than a balcony, which at this size makes a material difference to how the apartment lives. The setting Tulum Country Club sits roughly twenty five kilometres from the centre of Tulum, which is worth being plain about: this is not a walk into town, and a car is not optional. What the distance buys is a fully serviced community with paved roads, controlled access and security around the clock, built around the PGA Riviera Maya golf course, with the Real Madrid Academy and the German International School close by. The Tulum Country Club beach club is a few minutes away. Shared amenities A swimming pool, a gym and a private barbecue area serve the building. For a buyer with school age children the combination of an international school and a sports academy inside the same gated community is rare on this coast, and it is the reason most of the year round residents here chose it.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. This is the ground floor garden condo at Kaan Ha, a separate unit from the three level penthouse in the same development. Ninety nine square metres of interior open onto 16.20 square metres of terrace, an 11.22 square metre private garden and a splash pool of 5.59 square metres, for a total of 132.22 square metres. Layout Two bedrooms and two bathrooms on a lock off layout, so one side can be closed behind its own entrance and used independently of the other. On a unit this size that flexibility is worth more than an extra few square metres would be. Why the ground floor The garden and the splash pool are the argument for taking a lower unit here rather than a higher one. Upstairs you get elevation and a longer view. Down here you get ground you can walk out onto barefoot, which for a full time resident or a family tends to matter more day to day than the outlook does. The setting Kaan Ha looks out over the golf course and a natural cenote inside the grounds. Residents share generous pools, a gym, a barbecue area, a kids zone, a multipurpose room and a coworking lounge. Tulum Country Club is gated around a PGA certified course, with paved roads, controlled access and security around the clock, fifteen minutes from downtown. At three hundred and fifty thousand this is the accessible end of Tulum Country Club, and the only unit on our books here with its own garden.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Residence 09 runs to 260 square metres at SLS Puerto Cancun, delivered turnkey and ready to occupy. Layout and interiors Three bedrooms and four bathrooms, with a maid room and its own service area and two private parking spaces. The interiors are by Piero Lissoni, whose work here is restrained rather than decorative, and the apartment reads quieter in person than in photographs. A gourmet kitchen opens to the dining area and a large terrace faces the ocean. How it compares Residence 1806 in the same building carries the identical specification at a lower floor and a lower price. The difference between the two is height and outlook rather than layout or finish, and a buyer weighing them should see both before choosing. We list them separately for that reason. The building Private beach access and a waterfront promenade, a gym and spa, an infinity edge pool, fine dining restaurants and bars, concierge and valet around the clock, a children play area and multipurpose rooms. Puerto Cancun holds a private marina and a golf course designed by Tom Weiskopf, and the Marina Town Center is inside the development. Puerto Cancun is one of very few addresses on this coast where a marina, a golf course and a private beach sit inside the same gate.

Pre-construction. Cardinal is a run of villas inside Selvazama, sold by unit rather than as a single house. The base configuration is three bedrooms and four bathrooms across 274 square metres, made up of 214 square metres of interior, a 16 square metre garden and a 43 square metre rooftop. Four bedroom layouts run to 229 square metres of interior and carry four and a half bathrooms. Buying by unit Because these sell individually, availability moves. At the time of writing the inventory sheet shows several villas available, one reserved and two already sold, and the furniture package is quoted separately at one million pesos. Ask for the current availability list and the price for the specific villa you want rather than working from the headline figure, and confirm whether the quoted price includes the package. Selvazama Selvazama is the planned community that connects the town to the beach and the jungle, and it carries the infrastructure that much of Tulum still lacks. Paved roads, sewage, water treatment and electricity all went in ahead of the houses. Green School Tulum sits inside the grounds, which is the reason a good share of the year round families here chose it. Prices are quoted in pesos on the developer sheet. The dollar figure shown here is a conversion and will move with the rate.

features.feature: Beach a short bicycle ride away

desc.en: Pre-construction. Orkadia is a pair of apartment buildings inside Tulum Country Club, sold by unit across several layouts rather than as a single product. The range The entry configuration is a two bedroom, two bathroom apartment of roughly 120 square metres of interior, taking the total past 132 square metres with the parking space included. Above that sit two bedroom layouts with three bathrooms, double height apartments, and three bedroom units with four bathrooms running to 143.90 square metres of interior with a 60.03 square metre private garden. Several types carry a private roof terrace and every unit includes a parking space of 12.5 square metres. How to read the price The figure quoted here is the lowest unit on the current December price list. Because the range spans from the low three hundred thousands to the high four hundreds depending on layout, garden and roof terrace, the headline is a starting point rather than a price. Ask for the availability sheet and price the specific type and building you want. Tulum Country Club Gated around a PGA certified golf course, with paved roads, controlled access and security around the clock, fifteen minutes from downtown Tulum.

property.notes: Stage: pre-construction. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. House 33 sits in Las Olas, a private cluster inside Tulum Country Club, with 358 square metres of construction on a 512 square metre lot. Layout Four bedrooms and four bathrooms. The house is contemporary in design and sits within the most closely held of the clusters at Tulum Country Club. The community Residents have a PGA certified golf course, a clubhouse with swimming pool, spa and fitness facilities, beach club access, tennis and paddle courts, dining and natural walking trails, behind controlled access with security around the clock. Availability This residence is held off market. It is not advertised publicly and details are released to qualified buyers on request through the broker. Enquire for the full specification, the current price and a viewing.

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Casa Luna is a modern villa in Holistika, delivered turnkey and furnished, laid out to host ten people comfortably. The bedrooms Three bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms. The master is a suite with a king bed and its own bathroom. The other two are suites as well, each holding two double beds and each with a private bathroom, which is why the house sleeps ten without anyone ending up on a sofa. That configuration is deliberate and it is unusual at this size. Living space An open concept living and dining area seats ten, alongside a fully equipped modern kitchen. The terrace is large and furnished, with a private pool, a grill and a bar. There is a fully equipped laundry room and private parking, and the community runs gated security around the clock. Holistika Holistika is the wellness quarter of Tulum, built around the hotel and retreat of the same name, and it has held that character as the town has grown. Art installations, yoga centres and jungle paths sit between the houses. It is quieter than Aldea Zama and less exposed than the beach road. A three bedroom that genuinely sleeps ten, finished and furnished, is a specific proposition. It suits an owner who expects the house to be full.

features.feature: Grill and bar on the terrace

desc.en: Finished property. Nequen is a boutique development on Avenida 5 in La Veleta, and this is a one bedroom residence within it, delivered turnkey with a private pool of its own. The unit One bedroom and two bathrooms, which is a generous ratio for a one bedroom and means a guest never shares. The private pool is the feature that separates this from the rest of the one bedroom stock in La Veleta, where a balcony is the usual ceiling at this price. The building A rooftop infinity pool and solarium, a gym and yoga area, a bar, restaurant and coffee area, a coworking garden, a wellness pavilion, concierge and security, a lift and parking, bicycle rental and internet throughout. The carrying cost The HOA fee is 233 dollars a month, and we quote it because a building carrying a restaurant, a gym and a wellness pavilion has staff behind those amenities and the fee is where that shows. Against a one bedroom purchase it is a material share of the running cost and belongs in the arithmetic from the start rather than as a surprise at closing. La Veleta La Veleta sits between the town centre and the beach road and has absorbed most of Tulum recent growth. Avenida 5 is one of its established streets.

features.feature: HOA fee of 233 USD per month

desc.en: Finished property. Olimpo 5 is a two storey family house in Cumbres, one of the established gated communities in Cancun, with 230 square metres of construction on a 285 square metre lot. Layout Three bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, plus a service room with its own full bathroom and a laundry room. The kitchen is brand new and integral. There are four new air conditioning units, a gas boiler and blackout blinds throughout, and a private swimming pool with a large patio. Why the detail matters here The specification reads like a list of small things because that is exactly what it is, and on a family house those small things are the difference between moving in and spending six months on works. New air conditioning, a new kitchen, a boiler and blinds already fitted means nothing needs doing on arrival. Cumbres and Cancun Cumbres is a residential gated community with controlled access and security around the clock, close to schools, shops, restaurants and services. It is pet friendly and quiet, and it is where families in Cancun live rather than where visitors stay. This is a house for someone moving to Cancun rather than buying a view of it.

Finished property. PH 305 at Santamar is a two bedroom penthouse of 131.92 square metres on the point at Aventuras Akumal, a short walk from a secluded beach, with a private rooftop terrace looking out to sea. The penthouse Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms, built on a lock off system so one side closes behind its own entrance and can be used or let independently of the other. That is the plan to look at if you want to use part of the home and let the rest, or let the two halves separately, which the smaller apartments here cannot do. The living space is open through to the kitchen, which is fitted with a gas range, a large fridge and an island, and the bedrooms carry built in timber joinery. The roof Above the apartment is a private rooftop terrace with views out to the Caribbean. It is the reason to take the top floor here rather than a lower unit, and it is yours rather than shared. Santamar Santamar is 117 apartments in seven low buildings on the point at Punta Sur, laid out through landscaped gardens, and every building has its own rooftop pool looking at the sea. There are ten pools across the site, a private beach club with its own pier, direct beach access, barbecue areas, a gym and a yoga area. Akumal Akumal sits between Playa del Carmen and Tulum and is known for the reef close in and the calm water behind it, for the turtles in the bay and for being a good deal quieter than either town. Snorkelling starts off the rocks here, and Tulum and Playa del Carmen are each about half an hour away. Price $365,000 USD. The apartment is a resale, sold on by its owner rather than by the developer. Fuller information on the penthouse follows genuine interest. For the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

features.feature: Two bedrooms on a lock off system
Ten swimming pools across the site

desc.en: Pre-construction. Mayan View is a boutique development of fifteen apartments on a 1,700 square metre site in El Mirador, inside the Jaguar Park boundary and minutes from the Tulum ruins and the beaches below them. The apartments Thirteen of the fifteen residences are two bedroom with two full bathrooms, running 80 to 81 square metres inside with a terrace of 20 to 25 square metres. The two ground floor apartments in Torre B are three bedroom with three full bathrooms, 112 square metres inside, a terrace of 37 square metres and a private garden of 25 square metres. Every unit is designed around comfort and privacy rather than unit count, and each has a private pool in its own garden. The development carries a panoramic infinity pool with views across the jungle canopy, and several units look toward the pyramids. The finishes The specification is regional rather than imported. Chukum plaster on walls and soffits, natural stone facing, tzalam plywood and joinery, porcelain floors, granite counters and bahareque work. Chukum is a traditional Mayan render made from tree bark, and it is the reason these interiors read warm rather than clinical in person. El Mirador El Mirador is the residential pocket closest to the archaeological zone. Being inside the park boundary limits what can be built around it, which is worth more here than an amenity list. Sold by unit, so availability and price move. Ask for the current price list against the specific apartment you want.

features.feature: Chukum plaster to walls and soffits

desc.en: Pre-construction. Grand Aston Alquimia is a hotel and residences development in Tulum Centro, built across four towers named Ignis, Terra, Caeli and Aqua. It is sold by unit rather than as a single property, and there are nineteen distinct layouts across the four buildings. The entry unit The figure quoted here is the cheapest currently available layout, a one bedroom of 42.50 square metres with one bathroom in the Ignis tower. The one bedroom range runs up to 79.60 square metres in the Aqua garden studios, and the wider development carries larger typologies above that. Ask for the availability sheet and price the specific tower and layout you want, because the spread between the smallest Ignis suite and the larger Aqua units is considerable. What it is This is a resort operated under the Aston brand rather than a plain residential block, so the building runs hotel services and the running costs reflect that. Ask for the projected maintenance schedule and the operator agreement before committing. A unit inside a managed resort is a different instrument from an apartment, and the paperwork is where that difference lives. Under construction Nothing here is finished. Every image in the developer material is a render, and the delivery timeline starts at contract. Request the construction schedule and the payment ladder in writing. Tulum Centro is the working town rather than the beach strip, walkable to the market, the shops and the bus station.

features.feature: One bedroom layouts up to 79 60 m2

desc.en: Finished property. Unit 102 at Artilia runs to 255 square metres inside Luum Zama, the gated community within Aldea Zama. Two hundred and six square metres are interior and a further 49 are exterior. Layout Four bedrooms and two bathrooms, one of the bedrooms configured as a lock off suite that can be closed behind its own entrance and used independently. Two bathrooms across four bedrooms is a low ratio and worth knowing before viewing, particularly if the house is intended to sleep four separate parties. There is a private terrace, a private swimming pool and a laundry room. This is a resale The unit is being sold on by its owner rather than by the developer, so the escritura, the maintenance account and the condominium rules should all be reviewed as they stand today rather than as they were at launch. Luum Zama Artilia is a collection of ten residences inside Luum Zama, gated with access control, security around the clock and 24 hour CCTV. Residents share a clubhouse holding an open air gym, a natural spa, a temazcal, a yoga palapa and a play area for children, with walking trails through the green areas. Aldea Zama is where Tulum built its services first, and Luum Zama sits gated inside it.

Pre-construction. SLS Ocean Beach Residences is a boutique collection of 92 residences on the shoreline at Puerto Cancun, carrying the SLS name and running down to the Caribbean. The layouts Five residence types are documented. Residence 01 is the reference plan quoted here: three bedrooms and four bathrooms plus a service room, with 174.44 square metres of interior and 38.28 of terrace, taking the total to 212.72 square metres. Across the five types the range runs from three to four bedrooms and four to five bathrooms, so establish which residence you are pricing before comparing figures. Specification Kitchens carry panel ready refrigeration, an oven tower and a dishwasher. Bathrooms are fitted with double sinks, LED lit mirrors and natural stone. Every residence includes dedicated service accommodation with its own bedroom, bathroom and linen storage, and two assigned parking spaces. Under construction This is pre construction. The material is renders rather than photographs, and the timeline starts at contract. Ask for the construction schedule, the payment ladder and the current availability list, since the entry price quoted is the development floor rather than the price of any particular unit. Puerto Cancun holds a marina, a golf course and private beach inside one gate, which is rare on this coast.

Land. Tulum Country Club is releasing residential lots across eleven separate areas of the community, and they are not one product at one price. On the developer's August list there are 114 lots open, running from 310.37 square metres to 1,462.01 square metres and from 2,833,499 pesos to 11,300,668 pesos, about $166,400 to $663,600 USD. Where a lot sits inside the community decides most of what it costs. Why The Price Moves Between Areas Each area has its own character, its own lot sizes and its own floor price. Park Village is the entry point and the densest part of the book, with compact plots from 310 square metres. Las Flores runs larger and prices well above it. Manzana 024 holds the lake frontage and the biggest ground in the community, up to 1,462 square metres. Sunset 3 offers size at a low rate per square metre. Position matters again inside each area: an interior lot on a quiet loop, a lot facing a common green, one on the perimeter, one looking down the golf course or across a lake. Ground rates across the whole book run from about $335 to $821 per square metre, and that spread is about outlook and position rather than the land itself. Where Each Area Starts Starting prices from the developer's list, cheapest first. Park Village, 57 lots, 310 to 518 m2, from 2,833,499 MXN, about $166,400 USD Herradura, 5 lots, 345 to 619 m2, from 2,919,200 MXN, about $171,400 USD Las Flores, 27 lots, 312 to 685 m2, from 3,108,313 MXN, about $182,500 USD Tortugas, 1 lot, 333 m2, from 3,264,515 MXN, about $191,700 USD Manzana 021, 8 lots, 440 to 590 m2, from 4,091,061 MXN, about $240,200 USD Sunset 3, 4 lots, 703 to 840 m2, from 4,265,367 MXN, about $250,500 USD What You Are Buying Into The community is built around PGA Riviera Maya, the only PGA golf course inside a Mexican residential development, certified by the PGA and laid out through jungle, cenotes and lakes. Around it sit La Plaza and Market Square for shops and restaurants, the Kay Beach Club on the coast, the Members Club, BEGYM Tulum, a spa, a casino, the Real Madrid Foundation football school and the Aleman International School of the Riviera Maya. Concierge, medical service, housekeeping, car rental and internal transport run inside the gates, and owners take a discount across every consumption centre. It is gated with controlled access and security around the clock, about fifteen minutes from Tulum and entered off the Carretera Federal 307 at Akumal. Read The Prices Carefully These are peso prices, taken from the developer's own inventory list dated 4 August 2026 and the community master plan dated August 2026. The dollar figures on this page convert at about 17.03 pesos to the dollar and will move with the exchange rate, so treat the peso number as the price and the dollar number as a guide. Availability moves as well, and the lots at the bottom of each area are the ones that go first. We confirm the lot, the area and the peso price of the day before anything is signed. Ground is the cheapest way into this community. The lots open below what any finished apartment on the same developer list asks, and they let a buyer choose the outlook rather than take the one that came with the unit. Financing Bahia Principe Residences finances its own buyers, which is unusual in this market and is the reason a purchase here can be structured without going to a Mexican bank. The terms the developer publishes are a fixed rate of 5 to 7 percent, taken in pesos or in dollars, with no origination fee, from 30 percent down, and a reservation from $5,000 USD. They quote pre authorisation inside 24 hours and state that the decision does not touch your credit history. The credit sits with Piñero, the group behind Bahia Principe, and carries their guarantee. Those are the developer's own terms and their own descriptions of them. They are subject to the developer's approval and to change, and the rate you are offered may not be the rate at the top of that range. Tulum Land and Property does not arrange, underwrite or guarantee credit and nothing here is an offer of finance. What we do is put you in front of their finance team and stay in the conversation.

One bedroom with its own bathroom sits behind the parking, a covered bay for two cars. The stairs and a guest toilet are set in the middle. Two bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a half bathroom. Terrace, pool deck and garden bring it to 239.7 m2 in total. Inside Living, dining and kitchen share one open room under a ceiling that lifts at the far end, with a band of clerestory glass along the top of the wall, so the light arrives high and the neighbours stay out of it. The kitchen works off a stone topped island with seating for three. Both bedrooms face the garden through full height glass, and the main bathroom carries twin basins, a separate shower and a skylight cut over the vanity. Outside The rear terrace runs under a wood lined ceiling with recessed lights, deep enough for a dining table at one end and armchairs at the other. The pool sits along the garden edge with a strip of lawn behind it. At the front a carport covers two parking spaces, and the entrance door is set into a rough stone wall behind them. The exterior areas come to 110.6 m2. What the price covers The developer quotes the Lirio Center at 7,800,000 pesos. That peso figure is the construction of the house and nothing else. Land is bought separately. The price shown on this listing, 640,500 USD, is two numbers added together and rounded: the build, about 458,015 USD converted at roughly 17.03 pesos to the dollar, plus 182,520 USD for the cheapest interior lot in Las Flores that this model can sit on. The exchange rate moves and the dollar side of the figure will move with it. Choose a bigger lot, or one on the golf course, and the total changes. The house sits inside the Las Flores block rather than on its outer edge, so there is no golf frontage and no street elevation to speak of. That is why the lot under it is the cheapest of the qualifying options. It is worth saying plainly: this is a two bedroom house at Tulum Country Club prices. desc.en: Pre-construction. The Dalia Center is a two storey Signature home of 200.7 m2, or 2,160 square feet, on an interior lot in Las Flores at Tulum Country Club. Three bedrooms, three full bathrooms and a half bathroom. With the terrace, the pool deck and the lawn counted in, the plan covers 365.2 m2. The ground floor Living, dining and kitchen run in one line from the entrance to the garden doors, a stone wall down one side and the island kitchen down the other. The half bathroom sits behind the kitchen, out of the way of the main room. Sliding glass opens the living end straight onto the terrace, and the pool is visible from the sofa. Upstairs All three bedrooms are on the upper floor, served by the three full bathrooms, with a landing between them and a balcony on a glass balustrade over the rear terrace. That is the trade this plan asks for. There is no bedroom on the ground floor, and there are stairs every night. Outside The pool sits out in the lawn rather than tight against the house, with a small arched pavilion beside it holding a pair of loungers in the shade. The terrace under the balcony takes an outdoor dining table, shaded by the floor above it. Exterior areas total 164.5 m2. What the price covers The developer quotes the Dalia Center at 10,100,000 pesos. That peso figure is the build of the house only, with no land in it.
