Financing Bahia Principe Residences finances its own buyers, which is unusual in this market and is the reason a purchase here can be structured without going to a Mexican bank. The terms the developer publishes are a fixed rate of 5 to 7 percent, taken in pesos or in dollars, with no origination fee, from 30 percent down, and a reservation from $5,000 USD. They quote pre authorisation inside 24 hours and state that the decision does not touch your credit history. The credit sits with Piñero, the group behind Bahia Principe, and carries their guarantee. Those are the developer's own terms and their own descriptions of them. They are subject to the developer's approval and to change, and the rate you are offered may not be the rate at the top of that range. Tulum Land and Property does not arrange, underwrite or guarantee credit and nothing here is an offer of finance. What we do is put you in front of their finance team and stay in the conversation.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Ebano is a two storey house of 189.62 m² (2,041 ft²) built on its own lot inside Tulum Country Club, with two bedrooms, a studio, two full bathrooms and a half bath. The ground floor opens its full width onto a covered terrace, a 24.04 m² pool and a planted garden. House and outdoor space together come to 330.11 m². Inside Kitchen, dining, living and a family room sit on the ground floor, with the laundry, a store room and the half bath behind. Parking for two cars is at the front of the lot. Upstairs the principal bedroom has its own bathroom and a balcony over the street elevation, a second bedroom has the second bathroom, and the studio sits between them. About the studio The studio is the reason to look at Ebano rather than a plainer two bedroom plan. It is a real room with a door, not a widened landing, and it takes an office or a sofa bed without stealing space. It is not a bedroom and the plan does not call it one. Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms is a thin count for 189.62 m² of house. If you need three or four bedrooms, this is the wrong plan. Outside There is 37.49 m² of terrace, a 24.04 m² pool and 103 m² of exterior area. The terrace seats a full dining table under cover with a grill at the far end, and the pool runs the width of the garden. What the price covers The developer prices the house build at $9,863,130 MXN. That is construction only and it excludes the land. At about 17.03 pesos to the dollar the build works out at roughly $579,162 USD. The peso figure is the developer's number, so the dollar conversion moves with the rate. The listing price of $745,500 USD is that build price plus $166,383 USD for the cheapest qualifying lot in the community, which is in Park Village. Ebano is a model house, tied to no one area, so the buyer picks the lot, and a larger lot or a golf frontage changes the total. Not yet built Ebano has not been constructed. Every image here is an architect's render and is illustrative. Finishes, furniture and planting show design intent, not specification. The house is built to order once the lot is chosen. The setting Tulum Country Club sits about fifteen minutes from Tulum, off the Carretera Federal 307 at Akumal. It is gated, with security around the clock, and laid out around the PGA Riviera Maya golf course, certified by the PGA of America and Troon. Inside the grounds are cenotes and lakes, a protected reserve, a beach club on the coast and a football school run by the Real Madrid Foundation. The golf cart in the render is not set dressing. desc.en: Pre-construction. Cumaru is the largest of the Model homes at Tulum Country Club. It is a four bedroom house of 254.37 square metres of construction, which is 2,738 square feet, arranged over two floors, with a service room on top of the four bedrooms. There are four full bathrooms and a half bath. Terraces run to 58.33 square metres, the private pool is 25.19 square metres, and the published total once the outdoor areas are counted is 398.34 square metres. It has not been built yet This is a new build. Construction follows a signed contract and a chosen lot, so there is no finished house to visit. Every image on this page is a developer render and is illustrative. Treat the furniture and the planting as an indication of how the spaces are meant to work, not as a specification. You pick the lot Model homes are not attached to any one part of the community. The design is fixed and the position is open, so the same house can go on a quiet interior lot or on one with more frontage. The Signature homes work the other way around. They are built in Las Flores in set interior, street facing and golf view positions. How the price is put together The developer's price for Cumaru is 13,110,500 pesos, and that figure buys the construction of the house only. The land is not in it. Our listed price of 936,200 US dollars is that build price converted at about 17.03 pesos to the dollar, roughly 769,847 US dollars, plus 166,383 US dollars for the cheapest lot in the community, in Park Village. So the dollar total moves with the exchange rate rather than sitting still, and choosing any other lot pushes it upwards, because Park Village land is the cheapest in the community. The developer does not quote a combined figure. We do, because a construction price with no land under it is not what a buyer ends up paying. The numbers Construction area 254.37 m2, or 2,738 sq ft Terraces 58.33 m2 Private pool 25.19 m2 Total with outdoor areas 398.34 m2 4 bedrooms plus a service room 4 full bathrooms and a half bath Developer build price 13,110,500 pesos, land not included Tulum Country Club sits off the Carretera Federal 307 at Akumal, about fifteen minutes from Tulum, gated and with controlled access, and built around the PGA Riviera Maya golf course. desc.en: Pre-construction. Granada is a two storey house of 216.16 m² (2,327 ft²) built on its own lot inside Tulum Country Club, with four bedrooms, three full bathrooms and two half baths. One bedroom is on the ground floor, with a bathroom next to it and a vestibule between it and the living space. Know that first. It is what makes Granada work for a household where someone should not be on stairs. House and outdoor space together come to 318.56 m². Inside Living, dining and kitchen run as one space across the ground floor and open through black framed sliding glass to the terrace, the lawn and a 22.91 m² pool. The laundry room, a half bath and a full bathroom serve that floor. Two cars park at the front. Upstairs are three more bedrooms. The principal has a dressing room, its own bathroom and a balcony; the other two share a bathroom and each has one. The plan also carries a solarium. Outside Here is the awkward part. Granada has 9.64 m² of terrace, very little for a four bedroom house. The outdoor living is the pool deck, the lawn and a pergola over an outdoor kitchen with a grill and a bar counter, not a deep covered terrace, and on a wet afternoon that shows. Exterior area runs to 92.76 m² and the pool is 22.91 m², enough water to swim in rather than stand in. What the price covers The developer prices the house build at $10,992,650 MXN. That figure is construction only and it excludes the land. At about 17.03 pesos to the dollar the build works out at roughly $645,487 USD. desc.en: Finished property. Comfort Inn Cabo San Lucas is an operating hotel of 171 guest rooms on the Carretera Transpeninsular at Km 4.1, the corridor that carries traffic between Los Cabos International Airport and the town. The building was completed in 2018 and has traded since. The building Land of 4,966.81 square metres carrying 4,555.03 square metres of construction over eight levels, completed in 2018 and trading since. The ground floor holds reception, a lobby lounge, administrative offices, the restaurant, a gym, laundry, kitchen, plant rooms and warehousing. The roof carries a bar and an infinity pool looking out to El Arco de Cabo San Lucas. Two Schindler lifts serve the building and parking is on site. The address is Carretera Transpeninsular Km 4.1, Cabo San Lucas. The building Eight levels sit above a ground floor given over to reception, the lobby lounge, administrative offices, a restaurant and kitchen, a gym, laundry, mechanical and electrical rooms, storage and guest restrooms. Two Schindler lifts serve the floors. Guest parking is on site. The rooftop The top of the building carries a bar and an infinity pool, looking out over the town toward El Arco de Cabo San Lucas. Land and construction The site runs to 4,966.81 square metres and carries 4,555.03 square metres of construction, which is 49,030 square feet. Building systems Air conditioning is a Samsung VRF high efficiency system rated at 1.5 tons per room. Power arrives through a Prolec GE transformer of 750 kVA. Water is pressurised by Barnes duplex and triplex hydropneumatic sets and heated in two tanks of 5,000 litres on a recirculating pump. A full fire suppression system with smoke detection covers every guest room and all common areas. Wireless internet runs throughout and CCTV covers the common areas. Brand and tenure The hotel trades under the Comfort Inn franchise, part of Choice Hotels International. The seller reports freehold ownership with clean title and a registered deed, and states that municipal and federal taxes are current. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Finished property. Ambre & Epices is a former boutique hotel in La Veleta, converted into an eight bedroom private villa. The design pulls Moroccan and Mexican together: a Moorish facade, arched doorways and lantern lit courtyards, set among endemic trees on a 1,070 square metre lot. Indoor and outdoor run into one another, so the patio jacuzzi leads to the dining table, which leads to the pool and the garden beyond. The house 515 square metres of construction over two floors, built in 2019, on a lot of 1,070 square metres with 750 of that laid out as garden. Eight bedrooms, each with a king bed, a private bathroom and either a bathtub or a stone jacuzzi set into the suite. The kitchen is fully equipped and has its own recycling area. There is a laundry, storage and staff area of 20 square metres. Two pools and the courtyards The main pool runs 22 metres by 4 in the garden. A second pool of 3 metres by 3 sits in the patio. Around them are a large lobby, an open lounge beside the dining area, and a larger oriental lounge that looks over the water. A barbecue area and an outdoor spa sit in the grounds, and the roof is currently being extended. Services and plant Eight optimised CFE meters with a generator for emergencies, a water filtration system, a wastewater filtration system, a gas boiler, fibre optic and wireless internet, and camera coverage. Licences The seller reports that the accommodation, restaurant and bar licence is current, that the property carries uso de suelo comercial, and that the construction and fin de obra licences are up to date. The expansion the seller has drawn up An architectural project has been conceptualised and the plans are ready to take capacity from 18 guests to 28, by adding two rooms on the terrace: one sleeping four and one dormitory sleeping six. Where it sits La Veleta, five minutes from the town centre and about fifteen from the hotel zone and the beach clubs. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Garden of 750 m2 with endemic trees

desc.en: Land. Two adjoining parcels at Zacbó, on the first dry ground south of the Río Lagartos lagoon system, in the municipality of Tizimín. The land lies 8 kilometres from the ocean in a straight line and 18 kilometres by road from El Cuyo, with the barrier beach and the Gulf beyond. It is unworked: secondary low forest and palm over exposed limestone, areas of former milpa now open and regenerating, and several aguadas that hold water through the year. Size and price Parcela 28 runs to 453.89 hectares and Parcela 25 to 339.89, which is 793.78 hectares together, or 7,937,762 square metres. The asking basis is MXN 50 per square metre, so Parcela 25 comes to MXN 169,944,300 and Parcela 28 to MXN 226,943,800, with the two together at MXN 396,888,100. The headline figure above is Parcela 25 alone, converted at 17.03 pesos to the dollar on 31 August 2026. Acquisition parcel by parcel is possible, and the rate should be checked on the day. The water Several aguadas across the block were holding standing water at the end of the dry season, with water lilies and a clear limestone bottom. None of them has been dredged or worked. Their number, area and depth have not been surveyed. Land cover Three conditions run across the block. Wooded areas of secondary low forest and palm mixed with open stony ground. Areas previously planted with milpa, now open and regenerating. Reed and grass fringe around the water bodies, untouched. Access Follow the highway toward El Cuyo, turn right 8 kilometres before the village at the junction known as Caño Mucho, then 10 kilometres of unpaved interior track to the boundary. The condition of that track has not been surveyed. Tenure The parcels sit in the ejido N.C.P.A. Tekal Nuevo, Tizimín, and are held in dominio pleno, which is full freehold, authorised in ejido assembly in 2009 with the parcels delimited and assigned in a prior assembly in 1998. The acta records that they are free of litigation, subject to no contract or agreement, and fall outside any municipal or state urban growth plan. The Procuraduría Agraria stated that no archaeological monuments or vestiges are known within the parcelled area. The complete document file is available for review to a serious buyer. Services A substation serves El Cuyo, 18 kilometres away; a substation at Moctezuma, the nearer settlement, is not confirmed. Water is surface water in the aguadas plus the regional karst aquifer, with no well or extraction permit in place. On that basis a first phase should be designed to run off grid, on solar generation, rainwater capture and on site treatment. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Finished property. Mayan View is a completed boutique residential building of fifteen apartments in Fraccionamiento El Mirador, Tulum, offered in full as a single asset. The site faces Parque del Jaguar, the federal protected reserve, and sits 700 metres from the Tulum archaeological zone. The asset Fifteen residences of two and three bedrooms, in lock off configurations, each with a private terrace and plunge pool. Shared amenities run to a central courtyard pool, a 25 metre lap pool and an infinity pool, a paddle court and jungle gym, a gym, a rooftop, a coworking space, a large palapa and security around the clock. The Tulum archaeological zone is 700 metres away on foot. The asset Fifteen residences across Torre A and Torre B, each of ground floor plus three levels. Thirteen are two bedroom units with two full bathrooms, an interior area of 80 to 81 square metres and terraces of 20 to 25 square metres, giving a commercial area of 100 to 110 square metres. Two ground floor apartments in Torre B are three bedroom with three full bathrooms, 112 square metres of interior, a terrace of 37 square metres and a private garden of 25 square metres, for a commercial area of 174 square metres each. Every unit is built to a lock off configuration and carries a private terrace with a plunge pool. Areas Private areas run to 1,675 square metres, roofed common areas to 689 square metres and total common areas to 2,058 square metres. Total roofed development area is 2,364 square metres and the final global surface is 3,733 square metres, on a site of 1,669 square metres. The condominium regime is registered and current. Finishes Chukum plaster to the walls, tzalam carpentry, porcelain floors and premium glazing. Units are delivered furnished. The offer Two structures are on the table. An all cash acquisition of the whole asset at 6,350,000 US dollars, or a financed purchase at 6,600,000 US dollars with seventy per cent on signing and thirty per cent deferred. Why the position holds Being inside the Jaguar Park boundary limits what can be built around it. Upper terraces look directly at the pyramids and those views cannot be built out. Individual apartments at Mayan View are also listed separately, for buyers who want a single unit rather than the whole building. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Finished property. Hotel Boutique Tankah is a working beachfront hotel of twenty one suites in Tankah Bay, on a site of 1,000 square metres carrying approximately 2,020 square metres of construction and twenty five metres of frontage directly on the sand. The building and the rooms One thousand square metres of land carrying approximately 2,020 square metres of construction, with 25 metres of beachfront. Twenty one rooms: six ocean view suites and six ocean front suites at 39 square metres each with private terraces, two ocean view swim up suites and two beachfront swim up suites also at 39 square metres, four penthouse suites of 59 square metres with private terrace and private pool, and one master suite of 50 square metres with beach access. The restaurant seats about fifty and has a fully equipped kitchen. The rooms Twenty one suites across six categories. Six ocean view suites of 39 square metres with private terraces, two ocean view swim up suites of the same size, six ocean front suites also of 39 square metres, two beachfront swim up suites, four penthouse suites of 59 square metres each with a private terrace and its own pool, and one master suite of 50 square metres with direct beach access. Restaurant and public areas The restaurant seats approximately fifty and runs from a fully equipped kitchen. Guests share a reception, two lounge rooms, a terrace lounge, a gym, a swimming pool, a jacuzzi, a massage area and a sunbed area on the beach itself. The property also holds a crocodile sanctuary, which is as much a part of the character of this stretch of coast as it is an amenity. Service areas Back of house covers an office area, a storage room and a staff dining area, so the operation runs without borrowing space from the guest side of the building. Tankah Bay Tankah sits north of Tulum between the town and Soliman Bay, on a calm protected stretch with the reef close in and cenotes behind the beach road. It is quieter than the Tulum hotel zone and the sand is better, which is why the small hotels along here hold their rate. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Pre-construction. Prana is a boutique residential building of seven apartments under construction in Holistika, Tulum, offered in full as a single asset. The site runs to 650.96 square metres and the project carries 1,640 square metres of construction. The project Seven apartments only, which is what makes it a manageable proposition for a developer or an investor taking the whole building rather than for a fund. The scheme is designed around the Holistika idea of building into the jungle rather than clearing it, with a rooftop pool deck, a covered palapa social area and open sided living spaces looking out across the canopy. Holistika Holistika is the wellness quarter of Tulum, built around the Holistika hotel and its art walk, with yoga studios, temazcal, vegetarian kitchens and a resident community that skews toward long stays. It is one of the few parts of Tulum where the character came first and the property market followed, which is why product here tends to hold its identity. Status Under construction. The images on this listing are the architect renders rather than photographs of a finished building. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

Finished property. Hotel 5ta Avenida is a fully operational hotel on Fifth Avenue in Playa del Carmen Centro, between Calle 38 and Calle 34, with three active commercial units fronting the avenue itself. The lot runs to 1,338.50 square metres and carries 2,361.51 square metres of construction. The beach is 400 metres away, about a five minute walk. The building The lot runs to 1,338.50 square metres with 2,361.51 square metres of construction. The room mix is five standard double rooms, five one bedroom junior suites, two two bedroom junior suites, two fully equipped studios and a two bedroom penthouse, alongside three street front retail units on Fifth Avenue. The beach is 400 metres away, a five minute walk. Room mix Fifteen keys in total. Five standard double rooms, five junior suites of one bedroom, two junior suites of two bedrooms, two fully equipped studios and one penthouse of two bedrooms. That spread suits long and short stay travellers, families and groups alike. The retail Three street front retail spaces trade on Fifth Avenue. This is the busiest pedestrian street in the Riviera Maya, and the ground floor frontage is a large part of what the asset is worth. Room to add The seller reports potential to build additional units above the existing retail. The location Fifth Avenue between Calle 34 and Calle 38 is the northern stretch, quieter than the blocks around Calle 12 but still fully commercial, and closer to Playacar and the Cozumel ferry than the far north end. Rooms here sell on walkability rather than on a sea view. Further information The full information pack on this asset is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest, and the complete file follows a letter of intent.

features.feature: Four hundred metres from the beach

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Playa del Carmen.

desc.en: Finished property. Ninety two lots, one price per square metre, and title at closing. Aldea Xcacel is an eco residential subdivision in Chemuyil, on the quiet stretch of the Riviera Maya between Akumal and Xel Há. Every lot in the release sells at 60 USD per square metre. Nothing is charged for a corner, a frontage or a position on the map, so the only thing that moves the price is the size of the ground. The 92 lots cover 63,165 m² across six manzanas, numbered 28, 33, 35, 37, 38 and 44. They run from 485 m² to 2,630 m², which is 29,117 USD at the bottom and 157,808 USD at the top. The median lot is 579 m² and 69 of the 92 sit under 700 m², a comfortable single family footprint on this coast and a good deal more ground than the same money buys inside Tulum. Five lots pass 1,000 m². The largest two, MZA 28 Lote 11 at 2,630 m² and MZA 44 Lote 2 at 1,985 m², are big enough for a multi unit or boutique scheme. Land use across the development is H3. The groundwork is done. Avenues are cut, graded and kerbed, laid as sacbé in white limestone, and the streets carry names and signage: Avenida Kopo, Calle Yaaxché, Calle Piich, Calle Beel Sinik, all of them Maya tree names. Power runs overhead along the avenues and the junctions have been planted. The photographs on this listing show the development as it stands rather than a render. Xcacel is three kilometres away. It is a protected natural area and one of the most important sea turtle nesting beaches in the Mexican Caribbean, more than two kilometres of white sand backed by jungle instead of hotels, and it is the reason this pocket of the Riviera Maya has stayed quiet while the rest of the corridor has not. The Xunaan Ha cenote is two kilometres away, about five minutes. Xel Há is twelve minutes, Akumal fifteen, Tulum twenty, and the Tren Maya route runs the corridor alongside Highway 307. Title transfers on closing. The developer offers 48 months of interest free financing against a 20 percent deposit, which is uncommon on titled land and lets a buyer hold the lot while deciding what to build. For scale, titled residential land on our own books inside Tulum currently runs from about 115 to 1,375 USD per square metre. This is land you can simply hold. Title transfers on closing, so there is no rush in any direction. A buyer can sit on the plot while the corridor fills in around it, build on it in their own time and to their own design, or bring us in and we will help them build it.

Finished property. A 345.32 m² lot with every service already underground and the plan drawn. Lote 134 sits in La Herradura Residencial, Manzana 15 of Tulum Country Club, a gated enclave of 141 single family lots inside the wider gated community. The plot runs 27.55 m down one side and 27.46 m down the other, with a 10.03 m curved frontage to Avenida del Sol and 13.75 m to Circuito Herradura behind it. Lotes 133 and 135 sit either side. On the developer's classification it is a lote frente, one of the run numbered 121 to 140. What can be built here is set out rather than left to interpretation. Land use is habitacional unifamiliar. The coefficients are COS 0.60 and CUS 1.20, so the footprint can reach 207 m² and the total built area 414 m², over a maximum of two storeys and 10 m. Setbacks are 5 m front and rear and 1 m either side. The plano is dated February 2023, forms the annexe to the promise of sale contract, drawn ad corpus against the Manzana 15 master plan and subject to municipal licensing like any build here. La Herradura is serviced ground, not raw land. Water, electricity, telephone and internet run underground, drainage is in, the streets are lit and have pavements, and the enclave has its own dual gated entrance and exit inside the main gates. Lots across the 141 run from 300 m² to 705 m², so at 345 m² this sits at the compact end and at the entry price for the sector. The enclave carries 7,062 m² of common area of its own: four pools, a sun lounge, a padel court, a playground, a BBQ area, meeting and event space, a coworking room, a pet zone and security around the clock. The horseshoe curves along the edge of Central Park, thirty hectares of lagoon, preserved cenote, sports fields, nature trails, orchards and a yoga pavilion, which the developer describes as the heart of the community. Beyond the enclave is the rest of Tulum Country Club: PGA Riviera Maya, the only PGA licensed golf course in Mexico, with its academy and pro shop, Kay Beach Club on the coast, La Plaza, Market Square, the Real Madrid Foundation football school and the Colegio Internacional Alemán. The gates are on the Carretera Federal 307 at Akumal, about fifteen minutes from Tulum. The price is a peso price. Until the end of September the developer is running this lot at 2,697,000 MXN against a list price of 2,919,200 MXN, on 25 percent down with the balance financed over five years. At about 17.40 pesos to the dollar that is roughly 155,000 USD, so treat the peso figure as the price. Those are the developer's terms, offered for the month and subject to their approval. Tulum Land and Property does not arrange or underwrite credit.

features.feature: Kay Beach Club on the coast

property.notes: Stage: finished. Zone: Tulum Country Club.

desc.en: Finished property. Thirty two apartments on Manzana 16, four layouts, and Central Park in front of them. Hélices II is a boutique building inside Tulum Country Club, four levels over a ground floor with a lift and a roof top, white render with Mayan stone detailing and planted terraces. It fronts Avenida Retorno Lago, and it is finished, so a buyer here is choosing a completed apartment rather than a delivery date. The two bedroom apartment runs 102.50 m² of interior with a 17.16 m² terrace, two full bathrooms and a half, a separate laundry area, kitchen, dining and living. The garden version is the same 102.50 m² interior with a larger 21.75 m² terrace, a 23.22 m² private garden and a 9.21 m² splash pool. Above them sit the penthouses, which are duplex. The two bedroom penthouse carries 127.60 m² of interior across two levels, a 17.36 m² terrace, a storeroom, and a 49.12 m² private rooftop with a 6.64 m² splash pool, a BBQ and a 15.43 m² pergola. The three bedroom penthouse runs 158.75 m² of interior with three full bathrooms and two half baths, the same terrace, and a 44.57 m² rooftop with its own splash pool and BBQ. Finishes are set out in the developer's Anexo A. Interiors are matte porcelain in neutral tones, walls and ceilings finely plastered in white with grey stucco detailing. The front door, the internal doors and the wardrobes are all in a Tzalam wood finish, window frames are black aluminium, bathrooms carry tempered glass screens and granite or sintered stone counters with matte satin fittings, and the kitchen has a stone worktop, electric hob and oven, extractor and a stainless steel sink. Lighting is recessed and warm inside and out. Cooling is mini split. The common area carries a lobby with concierge, a pool and a separate children's pool, a wet and dry play area, a sun deck, a BBQ area, an events area, a reading and sitting pavilion, a fire pit and mirador, a fruit garden, bathrooms, and thirty two parking spaces with visitor parking on top. Past that is the rest of Tulum Country Club: PGA Riviera Maya, the only PGA affiliated golf course in Mexico, Kay Beach Club on the Caribbean, La Plaza, Market Square, the Real Madrid Foundation football school and the Colegio Internacional Alemán. Pricing Two bedroom apartments start at $7,058,765 MXN. The USD figures here are indicative, converted at approximately 17 pesos to the dollar, and move with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Every image on this page comes from the developer's drawings and renders. The building itself is finished.

desc.en: Finished property. Four furnished apartments are open at KI Tulum, and they run from a 72 m² one bedroom to a 235 m² penthouse with its own roof garden. The building sits on the corner of Calle Kabah and Calle Iximché in Aldea Zamá, a short walk from the shops and restaurants on the avenue and a few minutes from the beach road. It holds 27 apartments in total, laid out around a planted courtyard with a pool running through it. Departamento 01 is a one bedroom of 60 m² interior with 12 m² of private outdoor space, 72 m² in all, at 165,000 USD. Departamento 04 is the same configuration at 71 m² interior with an 11 m² garden, 82 m² in all, and it comes with a parking space and a closet hall, at 175,000 USD. Both have one bathroom and a cleaning closet, and both open directly onto planting rather than onto a corridor. The two penthouses are a different proposition. PH 206 carries two bedrooms and two bathrooms across 102 m² of interior with a 28 m² terrace, then a spiral stair to an 86 m² roof garden with a jacuzzi, a sun deck, a covered pergola, a store room and its own bathroom. That is 216 m² in total at 320,000 USD. PH 205 is the larger of the two, three bedrooms and three bathrooms over 129.50 m² of interior with a 20 m² terrace and the same 86 m² roof, 235.50 m² in all, at 350,000 USD. Every one of the four is sold fully furnished, and the photographs on this page are of the actual apartments rather than renders. The finish through the building is contemporary Mediterranean with a lot of dark timber: granite kitchen counters, full kitchens with oven, hob and extractor, fitted wardrobes and bathroom furniture, laminated windows, generous ceiling heights, LED lighting, a laundry area and mini split air conditioning. Several layouts in the building are designed as lock off, which matters if the apartment is going to be let. The building shares a garden courtyard with a swimming pool, an outdoor jacuzzi, a grill area, a lobby with a front desk, a lift, security around the clock, parking and bicycle parking. Aldea Zamá is the part of Tulum that has services in the ground and pavements to walk on, which is why it has held its value while other zones have not. Furnished stock at this size inside it does not sit around.

Finished property. Two lots are left of twelve, both at the same price, in a gated development that is already built. Casa Verde sits on Manzana 223 in Región 15, off Avenida Kukulkán, five minutes from Tulum centre and 2.5 km from the beach, with Aldea Zamá immediately alongside. Lots 7 and 11 are the last two on the developer's list. The other ten are sold. Each lot is identical: 15.57 m of frontage by 37 m deep, 571.60 m² or 6,152.65 sq ft, and each one is 160,000 USD. That works out at about 280 USD per square metre. Delivery is with title deed. What matters here is that the groundwork is finished rather than promised. The perimeter wall is up and planted, the gatehouse is manned around the clock, the automatic timber gates are hung, and the 10 m central street is laid in adocreto with landscaping down it and pavements either side. Electricity runs underground with meters already set, there is a water treatment plant and softened water, fibre optic internet, LED lighting through the common areas, visitor parking, and a maintenance and storage room. The photographs on this page are of the development as it stands, not renders. The build envelope is set out by the developer rather than left open. Two levels to a maximum of 9 m, 200 m² on the ground floor and 200 m² on the first, 400 m² of construction in all. Sixty percent of the plot stays green, and the pool counts inside that. There is a 6 m front setback for parking in paving stone, a 1.50 m planted strip at the facade and 1 m to each side. Facades follow a set palette of green, sand and concrete, with black or timber frames and clear glass, and a timber front wall planted with regional species. Twelve houses on a private street, walled and gated, five minutes from town. There is not much ground left inside Región 15 that is titled, serviced and this close to Aldea Zamá, and ten buyers have already taken the view that this was worth having.

Finished property. 7,724 m² of jungle ground in the pocket of Francisco Uh May that Azulik chose for its City of Arts. The parcel is an irregular quadrilateral, 75.11 m and 99.69 m on two sides and 78.93 m and 100.99 m on the others, and the surveyor has set out the bearing, the distance and the coordinates of every corner. At 100,000 USD that is a little under 13 USD per square metre. For scale, the cheapest titled land on our own books inside Tulum runs at about 115 USD per square metre and ground in Aldea Zamá at many multiples of that. What moves the price here is distance from the town and the absence of services. What you get for it is room. Francisco Uh May sits inland from the Tulum to Cobá road, and it is where a good deal of the town's cultural weight has quietly moved. SFER IK Uh May opened out here, the Azulik City of Arts followed, and the network of tracks across the area gets cut and graded a little further every year. It is not a serviced neighbourhood and should not be bought as one. It is ground with a road to it, in a part of Tulum that has a reason to matter. Getting there is simple enough to describe and worth knowing before you look. Take Camino Blanco past Azulik, and fifty metres on turn right and follow the track for eight hundred metres. SFER IK Uh May and the Azulik City of Arts sit on the same road, which is the reason this stretch of Francisco Uh May has any attention at all. The satellite image on this page shows the parcel outlined against the surrounding grid of tracks. This is raw land. Jungle and nothing else, priced accordingly, and sold with the survey already drawn and the corner coordinates recorded. Ground at this scale within reach of the Cobá road rarely comes to market with the boundary work done.

Finished property. A clean rectangle of three hectares, one hundred metres by three hundred, with an access road already on the boundary. 29,972.427 m² in Francisco Uh May, the stretch inland from Tulum that Azulik built the City of Arts and SFER IK Uh May into. The surveyor has recorded the bearing, the distance and the coordinates of all four corners. At 300,000 USD it works out at almost exactly 10 USD per square metre, which is the lowest rate on anything we carry. The shape is the other half of the argument. A hundred by three hundred with road frontage is a parcel you can plan on, rather than an awkward polygon you have to design around, and three hectares is enough ground for a compound, a retreat or a subdivision. Francisco Uh May sits inland from the Tulum to Cobá road, and it is where a good deal of the town's cultural weight has quietly moved. Finished property. A studio penthouse at Noïl Residences Foresta, finished, furnished and currently let on the short stay market. What separates it from the rest of the building is the roof: this unit has its own terrace with a plunge pool, a bar and a grill, reached from the apartment rather than shared with the building. The apartment One open room with a king bed, a kitchen along one wall with a stone breakfast bar and stools, and a bathroom in slate and limestone with a walk in shower. Air conditioning and a ceiling fan. Sliding glass out to the terrace. It sleeps two, and it sells furnished as the photographs show it. The private rooftop The plunge pool sits in a walled terrace with a timber screen at one end. That terrace is the reason to take this unit over a lower floor in the same building. The building Noïl Residences Foresta runs four levels over a ground floor, wrapped in planted facades. Past this apartment's own roof there is a pool at ground level, a second pool on the common rooftop, a restaurant and bar, a panoramic mirador, a gym, lounge areas, an elevator and beach club access. The developer runs a vacation rental program for owners who want the unit worked while they are away. Region 15 The building sits about 2.3 kilometers inland from the beach road, which puts the archaeological zone, the cenotes and the town center within a short ride. Region 15 is still filling in, so expect construction on neighboring lots and streets that are not all paved. That is the trade for buying this close to the coast at this price. Pricing The asking price is $3,100,000 MXN. The USD figure here is indicative, converted at about 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the one that stands. Sold furnished. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 Studio penthouse, 1 bathroom 🏊 Private roof terrace with plunge pool, bar and grill 🏢 Noïl Residences Foresta, four levels plus rooftop 🚴 2.3 km from the beach road 🧾 Sold furnished 💵 $3,100,000 MXN, about $182,000 USD

Finished property. A two bedroom apartment on the second floor at TAO Tulum, in Aldea Zama, sold furnished and currently working on the short stay market. Unit M-214 runs 70.62 square meters of interior with a 13 square meter private terrace off the living room, and the terrace carries a jacuzzi. The apartment Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms. Living room, dining and kitchen run as one space along the front of the unit, the kitchen in walnut cabinetry against a stone counter with a breakfast island. Both bedrooms carry fitted wardrobes, ceiling fans and air conditioning. The unit sits on what TAO calls the mezzanine level, the second of three floors, so the terrace looks into the tree canopy rather than onto a path. The terrace Thirteen square meters running the width of the living room, jacuzzi at one end and room for a six seat table at the other. It faces the jungle planting rather than another building. TAO Tulum Ninety condos in three story buildings set into the original tree cover. Residents have two swimming pools with shaded poolside patios and loungers, a gym, the open air Melipona lounge at the center of the community, botanical gardens, a yoga deck, reading areas and a restaurant. Parking is on site. Aldea Zama Aldea Zama is the planned district between the town and the beach road, and it is the most complete address in Tulum for a buyer who wants services rather than jungle. Supermarkets, banking, pharmacies, boutiques and a long list of restaurants sit inside the masterplan. The beach is about 2.5 kilometers away. Sold furnished. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms 📐 Interior 70.62 m² (760 sq ft) 🌿 Private terrace 13 m² (140 sq ft) with jacuzzi 📏 Total 83.62 m² (900 sq ft) 🏢 TAO Tulum, unit M-214, second floor 🧾 Sold furnished 💵 $245,000 USD

Finished property. A beachfront hotel and spa on the Boca Paila road, sitting on ten thousand square meters of land with ten thousand square meters of construction and its own frontage on the sand. It has traded since 1988, which on this coast makes it one of the originals rather than one of the arrivals. The inventory, 36 keys Thirty luxury rooms, four two bedroom apartments, one villa style house of three bedrooms, and one residence of four bedrooms with a utility room. That mix is unusual and it is useful: the property can run as a hotel, carry long stay or owner accommodation alongside it, or be repositioned around the larger units. Water and grounds Seven pools across the site, a spa, tropical gardens, and a sea view terrace as the common area. A number of rooms have a pool of their own. On the sand there is a beach club of loungers and day beds with a shaded restaurant behind it, and the hotel runs a weddings and events business off the same frontage. Back of house On a hotel of this age the plant is what decides the deal. There is a drinking water plant, a treatment plant handling wastewater along with soapy and grease waste, three generators at 150 KVA each, a ten thousand liter diesel store, a laundry, a wine cellar, a warehouse, corporate and human resources offices, and parking. Reception carries the manager's office. Trading Those are the seller's figures and the seller's plan, not ours, and both should be verified independently. Boca Paila The site sits in the middle of the Tulum beach strip, about twenty minutes from the town and a little over an hour from Playa del Carmen. Beachfront hotel land on this road is finite, and very little of it comes to market openly. Further information The full information pack is released to seriously interested parties. Speak to your broker to register interest and the current position will be confirmed directly. 🏨 36 keys: 30 rooms, 4 two bedroom apartments, 1 three bedroom villa, 1 four bedroom residence 🏖 Beachfront on the Carretera Tulum Boca Paila 📐 Land 10,000 m², construction 10,000 m² 🏊 Seven pools and a spa 📅 Trading since 1988 💵 $35,000,000 USD

Finished property. Anah Village 2 bed is a condominium in Bahía Príncipe, the gated golf resort community at Akumal, built in 2020, carrying 110.42 square meters (1,189 sq ft), 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms. Anah Village Anah Village was finished in 2020 and is laid out as low rise blocks around planted courtyards. Inside It is sold furnished, cooling is by mini split, floors are tiled throughout. The community The resort itself runs to 717 acres between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, roughly halfway along the Riviera Maya and about 80 kilometers south of Cancun airport. It is gated and staffed around the clock, built around a golf course, and the Caribbean is a few minutes east. The golf course is the spine of the place and it is the reason most owners are here. Around it sit tennis and paddle courts, pools, a clubhouse, restaurants and a beach club run for residents, with a supermarket and pharmacy inside the gates. Roads are paved and lit, and the perimeter is staffed day and night. Who it suits This is a family sized unit inside a serviced community. The community is fully built out and running, so what you see is what you get, and the services are already in place rather than promised. Getting there Bahía Príncipe sits on the inland side at Akumal, about 25 minutes from Tulum and 35 from Playa del Carmen, with Cancun airport roughly an hour and a quarter north. Akumal bay, the turtles and the reef are the nearest coast. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms 📐 110.42 m² (1,189 sq ft) 📅 Built 2020 ⛳ Bahía Príncipe, gated golf resort community, Akumal 💵 $299,000 USD

Finished property. A residential building lot in La Herradura Residencial, the enclave of 141 single family lots inside Tulum Country Club, sold with title held privately and every service already underground. La Herradura has its own dual gated entrance inside the main gates, lit streets with pavements, and 7,062 square metres of common area of its own: four pools, a sun lounge, a padel court, a playground, a barbecue area, meeting and event space, a coworking room, a pet zone and security around the clock. The horseshoe of lots curves along the edge of Central Park, thirty hectares of lagoon, preserved cenote, sports fields, nature trails, orchards and a yoga pavilion. Lots across the enclave run from 300 to 705 square metres, land use is single family, and the developer sets the building envelope at two storeys, a footprint of 60 per cent and a total of 120 per cent of the lot. The community Tulum Country Club is the gated golf community entered off the Carretera Federal 307 at Akumal, about fifteen minutes from Tulum. It is built around PGA Riviera Maya, the only PGA licensed golf course in Mexico, with its academy and pro shop, and around it sit La Plaza and Market Square for shops and restaurants, Kay Beach Club on the coast, the Members Club, a spa, the Real Madrid Foundation football school and the Colegio Internacional Alemán. Concierge, medical service, housekeeping and internal transport run inside the gates, and the perimeter is staffed around the clock. Building here Lots inside the community come with roads, drainage, water and power already run underground, which is the practical difference between building here and building on raw land outside a gate. Tulum Land and Property can hold the lot for you, put you with architects and builders, or run the build itself. Viewings by appointment. ⛳ La Herradura Residencial, Tulum Country Club 💵 $162,717 USD

The lot sits inside the perimeter, so the community’s security, roads, drainage, water and power come with it. desc.en: Finished property. Sian Kaan 1 bed is a condominium in Bahía Príncipe, the gated golf resort community at Akumal, built in 2010, carrying 90 square meters (969 sq ft), one bedroom, one bathroom. Sian Ka'an The Sian Ka'an buildings are the older resort stock inside Bahía Príncipe, put up between 2009 and 2012 and run with a front desk, so a unit here can be handed to the rental desk and left alone. They are the entry point to the community on price. Inside It is sold furnished, there is a private roof terrace, with a hot tub, and the building carries a pool, cooling is by mini split, floors are tiled throughout. The community The resort itself runs to 717 acres between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, roughly halfway along the Riviera Maya and about 80 kilometers south of Cancun airport. It is gated and staffed around the clock, built around a golf course, and the Caribbean is a few minutes east. The golf course is the spine of the place and it is the reason most owners are here. Around it sit tennis and paddle courts, pools, a clubhouse, restaurants and a beach club run for residents, with a supermarket and pharmacy inside the gates. Roads are paved and lit, and the perimeter is staffed day and night. A front desk operates in the building, which is what makes these units workable as a rental without an owner on the ground. Who it suits This is a buyer who wants a golf and beach base with no maintenance to manage. The community is fully built out and running, so what you see is what you get, and the services are already in place rather than promised. Getting there Bahía Príncipe sits on the inland side at Akumal, about 25 minutes from Tulum and 35 from Playa del Carmen, with Cancun airport roughly an hour and a quarter north. Akumal bay, the turtles and the reef are the nearest coast. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 1 bedrooms, 1 bathrooms 📐 90 m² (969 sq ft) 📅 Built 2010 ⛳ Bahía Príncipe, gated golf resort community, Akumal 💵 $170,000 USD

Getting there The gates are on the 307 at Akumal, about fifteen minutes from Tulum and thirty five from Playa del Carmen, with Cancun airport roughly an hour and a quarter north. The USD figure shown here is indicative, converted at approximately 17 pesos to the dollar, and it moves with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms 📐 109.97 m² (1,184 sq ft) 📅 Built 2025 ⛳ Bahía Príncipe, gated golf resort community, Akumal 💵 $5,250,000 MXN, about $309,000 USD

Finished property. A three bedroom house on a 250 square meter lot in Region 11, built in 2022 and finished in chukum, the lime and bark render used across the Yucatan. 120 square meters of construction over two levels, a private pool in the garden, a roof terrace, and it sells furnished. The layout The ground floor carries one bedroom and a full bathroom, usable as a guest room, a study or a bedroom without stairs. A timber staircase rises to two further bedrooms and a second full bathroom. Kitchen, dining and living run together, with a stone breakfast bar, gas cooktop and a separate service kitchen behind. Joinery is in tropical hardwood. Outside The pool sits in a gravel garden under the original trees, with a filtration system and uplighting. A patio sits beyond it. Parking is covered and takes two cars behind a solid timber gate. The roof terrace The roof is finished and lit, and the plumbing and electrics for a jacuzzi are run to it. The jacuzzi is not installed, so budget for one. Room to grow The structure was built with foundations sized for a third level, and there is room on the footprint to extend sideways. Neither is built. What the house has is the engineering to do it later without starting again. The owner will also sell the adjoining lot separately, 250 square meters at $900,000 MXN. It is listed here in its own right, and buying both doubles the holding to 500 square meters. Services Electricity and internet are connected. Water comes from a private well rather than a municipal main, which is normal here and worth understanding before an offer. Region 11 Region 11 sits on the town side of Tulum, north of the center, on the grid of numbered avenues, not in a gated development. The seller puts the first shopping center at fourteen minutes and the beaches at fifteen. A working residential area of one and two level houses, about half built out, pricing below the planned districts nearer the coast. Pricing The asking price is $4,000,000 MXN. The USD figure is indicative, converted at about 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the one that stands. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms 📐 Construction 120 m² (1,292 sq ft) 🌱 Lot 250 m² (10 x 25 m) 🏊 Private pool with filtration 🌇 Roof terrace, plumbed for a jacuzzi 🏗 Built 2022, foundations for a third level 🚗 Covered parking for two 💵 $4,000,000 MXN, about $235,000 USD

features.feature: Stone breakfast bar and gas cooktop

desc.en: Finished property. A 250 square meter residential lot in Region 11, on the town side of Tulum, fronting 5 Avenida Bis Norte. It sits directly beside a finished three bedroom house the same owner is selling, and the two can be bought together as a single 500 square meter holding. The lot Regular in shape and flat, with the rear boundary onto a common green area, so nothing gets built directly behind it. The plot is under jungle cover with mature trees standing on it and will need clearing before a build. Title and tenure The lot is held in condominium, carrying an undivided interest in the common areas alongside the private plot. What can be built Zoning is residential. Ground coverage is set at 0.60 and floor area ratio at 1.70, against a permitted density of 60 dwellings per hectare. On 250 square meters that works out at a footprint of about 150 square meters and roughly 425 square meters of built area across the levels, subject to the municipality approving the project. Three ways to take it Hold it while Region 11 builds out. Build on it yourself. Or have Tulum Land and Property handle the build, a service we run alongside the brokerage with architects and contractors already working here. Region 11 Region 11 sits on the numbered avenue grid north of the center, a working residential area of one and two level houses, about half built out. Services run in the street. Pricing The asking price is $900,000 MXN, about $3,600 pesos per square meter. The USD figure is indicative, converted at about 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the one that stands. Viewings by appointment. 📐 250 m² (2,691 sq ft) 🌳 Rear boundary onto a common green area 🏗 COS 0.60, CUS 1.70, residential use 🧾 Held in condominium 🏠 Adjoining three bedroom house available separately 💵 $900,000 MXN, about $52,900 USD

Pre-construction. Maranta is a development of seventeen beachfront residences on Bahía Solimán, at kilometer 254 of the federal highway, thirteen of them facing the Caribbean and four looking over the mangrove. Delivery is set for the first half of 2028. The bay Solimán is a natural cove, so the water sits calm and shallow and stays clear, with a coral reef a few meters off the shore and jungle closing the back of it. There are no large hotels on this stretch and the beach is semi private. It is the quietest bay between Tulum and Akumal, and those who use it would rather it stayed that way. Sargasso Worth saying before anything else, because it is the question every buyer on this coast asks. The residents of Bahía Solimán organized and funded a barrier of their own, 1.6 kilometers long, running the full length of the bay to intercept sargasso before it reaches the shore. That is why the water here looks the way it does through the year. The residences One, two and three bedroom apartments, each carrying as many bathrooms as bedrooms. The entry unit runs 45.07 square meters of interior with a 9.84 square meter terrace over the mangrove, and the largest runs to 2,604 square feet in total with its own garden. Every residence has a private terrace, a laundry area, and a kitchen open to the living and dining space. The build is exposed concrete and natural materials, with terraces opening straight onto the sea rather than screened off from it. Solar and water Solar panels and a rainwater collection system are in the base build rather than sold as an upgrade. The developer is plain that this is a practical decision about running a building on this coast, not a certification exercise. Amenities A beachfront pool with a sun deck and sun beds, a rooftop terrace with a bar, a beach club, a dining room and lounge, a gym, interior gardens, a lobby, bicycles and parking, with security on site. Pricing Prices are set in Mexican pesos and run from $6,250,000 MXN for a one bedroom on the mangrove facade to $16,490,000 MXN for a three bedroom on the beach facade, which is roughly $368,000 to $971,000 USD. The USD figures here are indicative, and the developer processes dollar payments at the rate on the day the transaction takes place. Payment plans run from 30/40/30 at list down to 90/0/10 against a ten percent discount. Viewings by appointment. 🛏 1, 2 and 3 bedroom residences 📐 591 to 2,604 sq ft total 🏖 Beachfront on Bahía Solimán 🏗 Delivery first half of 2028 ☀️ Solar panels and rainwater collection 💵 $6,250,000 to $16,490,000 MXN, about $368,000 to $971,000 USD

desc.en: Finished property. Apartment 101 is a two bedroom home on the first level of Casa Emilia, a boutique building of nine apartments in La Veleta, Tulum. It measures 105 square meters, about 1,130 square feet, and holds two bedrooms, two full bathrooms, a kitchen with a laundry area, a living and dining room, a terrace off the living space and a private roof of 30.60 square meters with its own pool. It is finished and ready to hand over, and it comes with basic furniture already in place. The apartment The plan runs the depth of the building, so both bedrooms sit away from the street and the living room opens onto its own terrace. The principal bedroom and the second bedroom each have a full bathroom of their own. The kitchen is fitted in solid wood with stone counters and an induction hob. Floors are polished cement in a warm sand tone, the walls are hand finished plaster, and the doors, wardrobes and shelving are all tropical hardwood. Air conditioning and ceiling fans are installed throughout. The roof The private roof terrace measures 30.60 square meters and is reached by its own stair. It holds a pool of 4.40 by 1.45 meters, a pergola in timber and canvas over a built in bench, an outdoor kitchen with a sink, and planters along the parapet. It looks out over the jungle canopy of La Veleta and takes the sunset. Casa Emilia Casa Emilia is nine apartments across two small towers, drawn from the architecture of the Yucatecan haciendas and rebuilt in a contemporary register. Arched openings, a stone base, lime plaster and heavy timber run through the whole building, and a planted courtyard leads in from the street. Every apartment has two bedrooms, two full bathrooms and its own rooftop pool. The developer is Reyvitru y Jacal, whose earlier work in the region includes Casa Laguna in Tulum and the Alea and Nerea boutique hotels. Location La Veleta sits west of the Tulum town center and has become the part of Tulum where people actually live rather than visit. The building is one block from Seventh Avenue, the main street through the neighborhood, and two minutes from Avenida Tulum. The beach is ten minutes away and Tulum airport about thirty. Shops, cafes, bakeries, yoga studios and restaurants are all within walking distance, and the town center is a short drive. Price This apartment is priced at $2,900,000 MXN. The dollar figure quoted here is indicative, converted at about 17 pesos to the dollar, and it moves with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Delivery is immediate. For the floor plans, the remaining unit list and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Pre-construction. Marina Aqua is a gated, marina front development of 44 two bedroom residences on a 7,000 m² lot in Puerto Aventuras, arranged across five low rise buildings. This is the 2BR A Type 2 layout, available on the second floor as unit A-201 at $567,568 and on the third floor as A-301 at $589,189. The residence holds 118.06 m² of interior space with two bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms, a living room, a dining room and kitchen, and a separate laundry room. A 23.38 m² terrace runs off the living space, giving 141.44 m² in total, or about 1,522 sq ft. The interior is within a fraction of a square metre of the standard 2BR A plan. What separates Type 2 is the terrace, which runs 23.38 m² here against 29.12 m² on the standard layout, and the floor it sits on. Every residence at Marina Aqua looks onto water, and the marina berths are a short walk from the buildings, taking boats of up to 35 feet. Puerto Aventuras is a fully gated marina town between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, built around a working harbour of roughly ninety slips. Inside the perimeter there is a nine hole golf course, several beaches, a dive centre, restaurants along the marina front, a supermarket, a school and a small commercial centre. From Marina Aqua the beach club, shopping centre, golf and tennis club and school are each about five minutes away, and the central park and town market about three. The development is by Grupo Aqua, who have been building in the Riviera Maya for more than 35 years. This residence is sold ahead of completion. Full floor plans, the finishes specification and current availability across the five buildings follow an enquiry.

Pre-construction. The Junior is the smallest model at Naomi Selva and the only one bar name that is a one bedroom. It runs 452 square feet of interior with a 32 square foot balcony, 484 square feet in total, in Tower B. 1 bedrooms, 1 bathrooms. The apartment One bedroom and one bathroom carrying both a shower and a bathtub, with the kitchen open to the living room and a balcony off it. Tower B runs the Junior and Deluxe models over all five floors, and the ground floor units add an outdoor garden of their own. The Tower B rooftop Tower B has an adults only rooftop that the other towers do not, with plunge pools, grill areas and sundecks over the canopy. It is the reason to buy in this tower rather than the others. Naomi Selva Naomi Selva sits on Xcalacoco Avenue, eight minutes from downtown Playa del Carmen and forty from Cancun airport, on a site of 208,249 square meters cut into the jungle rather than the beachfront. The residential piece is Naomi Residences by Aston: three towers, 164 apartments and 12 penthouses, designed by Joffroy and Partners. Alongside it on the same master plan sit the Aston Naomi Boutique Hotel, with 80 suites, and Naomi Market, eight commercial units built around The Root, a farm to table restaurant with its own harvest garden, barnyard and craft distillery. Every apartment is operated by Aston, so owners get hotel management and hotel services on a residence. Location Xcalacoco Avenue runs off Federal Highway 307 between Playa del Carmen and Punta Bete, with Xcalacoco beach a few minutes away and the Viceroy Riviera Maya and Gran Coyote golf course as neighbours. Downtown Playa del Carmen is eight minutes, the Maya Train station fifteen, Cancun airport forty and Tulum an hour. Price This model starts at $4,088,904 MXN. Ground floor units add a private outdoor garden and start at $4,533,115 MXN, about $267,000 USD. The dollar figures quoted here are indicative, converted at about 17 pesos to the dollar, and they move with the rate. The peso figure is the one that stands. Prices and availability are the developer's and change without notice. Towers A and B are the phase now selling. Tower C is held for the next phase. desc.en: Pre-construction. THEA is twelve apartments over five levels on Rafael E. Melgar in Puerto Morelos, one and two bedrooms from 40.82 to 101.83 square meters, three minutes from Fundadores park and four from the commercial zone. The apartments Twelve units only, which is the size of the whole building rather than a phase of it. One and two bedroom layouts with one or two bathrooms, sold by view: garden at ground level, front, back, partial ocean and full ocean as the building rises. The two bedroom ocean view apartments on the upper floors run 96.97 square meters and are the largest homes in the building. Selected units carry a private pool or a jacuzzi. Amenities An infinity pool, a rooftop with ocean views, a barbecue zone, a lobby, an elevator, closed circuit surveillance and smart home wiring throughout. Puerto Morelos A fishing town between Cancun and Playa del Carmen with the national marine park offshore. Fundadores park is three minutes away, the commercial zone four, Cancun airport twenty five, Cancun itself thirty and the Maya Train twenty nine. The developer is Tsalach Real Estate, which builds across Tulum, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Morelos, Cozumel, Cancun, El Cuyo and the United States. Price Prices start at $168,562 USD. Delivery is scheduled for December 2027. Prices and availability are the developer's and change without notice. Seven of the twelve available at the time of writing, and that moves. For the current unit list, the floor plans and the payment schedule, get in touch and we will send them over.

Finished property. Distrito Puerto is seventy two apartments facing the Caribbean at Puerto Morelos, over nine floors with a private beach in front of it. Delivery is immediate. Lofts, one bedrooms and two bedrooms, from 45 to 92 square meters. The apartments Eight unit types across the floor plate, eight apartments per floor. Type 01 and types 05 through 08 are two bedroom, two bathroom homes of 88 to 93 square meters with a kitchen, dining room, living room, laundry area and balcony, some with a walk in closet. Types 02, 03 and 04 are one bedroom and loft layouts from 45 to 61 square meters. Types 02 and 04 come with a lock off option, so the apartment can be split and let as two. Amenities A pool facing the ocean, a rooftop with an infinity pool over the Caribbean, a social area with grills, a solarium, a gym and yoga zone, a multipurpose room, a lobby with security, elevators, parking and a private beach. Puerto Morelos The building sits by the dock and the municipal park, with the Chedraui Selecto and the town centre in walking distance and the national marine park directly offshore. The developer is Tsalach Real Estate, which builds across Tulum, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Morelos, Cozumel, Cancun, El Cuyo and the United States. Price Prices start at $250,000 USD. Delivery is immediate. Prices and availability are the developer's and change without notice. Four of the seventy two available at the time of writing, and that moves. For the current unit list, the floor plans and the payment schedule, get in touch and we will send them over.

Pre-construction. Village Blu is twenty four ocean view beach apartments on Avenida Javier Rojo Gomez in Puerto Morelos, on a 750.93 square meter site with 3,700 square meters built. The upper floor apartments run 72.71 to 74.90 square meters, about 782 to 806 square feet, and delivery is winter 2027. The apartments Types A and B are one bedroom with one bathroom and a laundry room of their own. Twenty four units over four levels, six to a floor, with the Caribbean on one side and the avenue on the other. It is a small building by the standards of this coast, which is the point of it. Amenities A rooftop with a pool and sun loungers looking out over the sea, terraces and social areas through the building, and parking below. Puerto Morelos Javier Rojo Gomez is the road that runs the length of the town, so the building sits inside walking distance of the dock, the square and the restaurants, with Cancun airport twenty five minutes north and Playa del Carmen about thirty five south. The national marine park lies directly offshore, which is what keeps the water flat in front of the town and why the diving and snorkelling here are the reason most people come. Availability and price Seven of the upper floor apartments were available on the price list dated 1 September 2026. Unit 201 on the second level is the entry at $310,000 USD for 72.71 square meters. Units 202 and 206 are $325,000, unit 203 is $335,000, units 302 and 306 on the third level are $350,000 and unit 402 is $360,000. Units 205 and 406 are on hold. Delivery is winter 2027. Five further apartments sit on the first level with terraces of 27 to 36 square meters rather than 11, which makes them a third larger overall. They are listed separately. The developer is Eleva Capital Group, which has built a run of projects along this stretch of the coast under the Blu name. Pricing is released on enquiry rather than published, and availability moves. Get in touch and we will send the current unit list, the floor plans and the payment schedule.

Pre-construction. Isola Blu is fourteen residences in a single five level building on the western shore of Isla Mujeres, looking across the bay to Cancun. The site runs 1,367.10 square meters with 2,776.84 square meters built, and unit 101 measures 168.96 square meters in total, about 1,819 square feet. The residences Two apartments on the first level and three on each of levels two to five, fourteen in all, sold as exclusive property units. Every one has a living room, a dining room, a kitchen, a laundry closet, a principal bedroom with its own closet and full bathroom, a second bedroom with a full bathroom, a further full bathroom for guests and a terrace. Unit 101 splits as 111.74 square meters habitable and 57.22 square meters of terrace. Finishes Interiors are laid in Veracruz travertine marble, wet areas in Melia cream marble, hallways and terraces in natural porcelain. Glazing is 2.5 millimeter extruded aluminium with laminated safety glass. The architecture reads as contemporary Caribbean, coral stone and washed timber in sand tones, with pitched roofs and crossed balustrades borrowed from the coastal colonial houses. Amenities A swimming pool, a covered terrace, eight parking spaces and a private pier with room for five boats, backed by a support marina with more capacity. The pier is the reason to buy here. Isla Mujeres The building sits on the sheltered western side of the island between Punta Norte and Punta Sur, twenty minutes by ferry from the mainland. The developer is Eleva Capital Group, which has built a run of projects along this stretch of the coast under the Blu name. Availability and price Four residences were available on the price list dated 1 September 2026. Units 101 and 102 are the garden apartments on the first level, 168.96 and 167.56 square meters with terraces of 57.22, both at $806,565 USD. Units 401 and 403 sit on the fourth level at 124.29 and 129.32 square meters, priced $805,268 and $789,157. Three more are on hold and six are sold. Delivery is winter 2028. The garden apartments are worth a second look: they are about a third larger than the fourth floor units for roughly the same money, because the terrace runs to 57 square meters rather than 13. The trade is height against outdoor space. Lock off Every residence is built as a lock off, so the second bedroom and its bathroom close off from the main apartment and let separately. On an island where inventory is thin that matters more than it would on the mainland. For the floor plans and the payment schedule, get in touch and we will send them over.

Distrito Zen Distrito Zen is forty three apartments over five levels inside the Zen Gardens development at Puerto Cancun, set between the Tajamar lagoon on one side and the mangrove on the other. Eleven apartments to a floor on levels one to three, ten on the fourth, and eleven typologies running from 102 to 443 square meters across two, three and four bedrooms. The ground floor holds the reception, administration, a coworking space, a multipurpose room, a gym, a kids club, a golf simulator and two commercial units. The roof carries a pool, a jacuzzi, a sundeck and a grill area, and the basement holds the parking and the storage cellars. Puerto Cancun Puerto Cancun is the gated marina district on the northern edge of the city, with its own golf course, the Marina Town Center and the beach a few minutes away, and the airport about twenty five minutes south. Price and availability Two are available in this layout, unit 104 at $11,624,833 MXN and unit 304 at $12,565,586 MXN, about $684,000 USD and $739,000 USD respectively. Viceroy Residences Playa del Carmen Viceroy Residences is the brand’s first residential building in the Yucatan, on the Mahekal site in Playa del Carmen. Owners get the hotel apparatus rather than a residents committee: a dedicated Viceroy hospitality team, concierge, hotel and restaurant services, a beach club reserved for residents and a private walkway to the sand. The roof carries three infinity pools, a bar and cabanas. Below them sit a spa with sauna, steam room, hot and cold plunge and massage suites, a fitness centre, a yoga and meditation terrace, a multimedia room, a teens lounge, a kids club, a business centre and a private event space. The entrance is built around the Reloj Solar Maya. Inside the residences Ceilings run 2.8 metres. Kitchens are open with travertine tone counters and backsplash, light oak cabinets, premium Italian cabinetry and a full stainless appliance suite. Floors are imported European porcelain, bathrooms are glass enclosed with natural stone counters, and the principal bedrooms carry walk in closets. Sliding glass doors open to terraces from the living areas and the bedrooms, and corner units wrap their terraces around two sides. Price and availability 3 are available, from $7,797,102 MXN for unit 002 at 735 square feet up to $10,750,572 MXN for unit 058 at 993 square feet, about $459,000 to $632,000 USD. Villa Maravilla is a golf front residence inside the gated community at Puerto Aventuras, 3,702 square feet of construction on an 8,073 square foot lot, five bedrooms and five bathrooms, sold fully furnished and fully staffed. The house The main residence holds four bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a detached one bedroom guest suite alongside it that works for visitors, staff or letting. A one car garage carries an additional bathroom. Interiors are marble floored with archways, solid wood finishes and high ceilings opening onto covered terraces. Outside A large swimming pool with a built in spa sits in mature tropical gardens with open views across the golf course. Covered terraces give shaded lounging and dining, and a rooftop terrace adds open air space above. Solar panels are installed and the kitchen is fully equipped with granite counters, solid wood cabinetry and a central island. Turnkey The house is delivered furnished with fixed and loose furniture, equipped, and with staff already in place. It is a resale rather than a new build, so what you see is what transfers. It is one of the longest established residential communities on this coast, which is why the housing stock here is mature villas on generous lots rather than new build apartments. Price Asking $1,962,000 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.
