Villa Orquidea is a golf front estate inside the gated community at Puerto Aventuras, 3,760 square feet of construction on an 8,073 square foot lot, six bedrooms and six bathrooms, sold fully furnished and fully staffed. The house Alongside the main house a detached building holds two fully equipped studio suites, which suit guests, extended family or letting. Interiors run solid marble floors, handcrafted stone archways, custom woodwork and open living areas that carry through to covered terraces and the pool. The kitchen has granite counters, solid wood cabinetry and a large central island. Outside The pool has a built in spa and natural stone decking with the golf course beyond it, set in mature tropical gardens. A rooftop terrace sits above with room for an outdoor lounge. Solar panels and a backup generator are installed alongside municipal services. Turnkey Delivered furnished and equipped with staff in place. It is the larger of the two golf front resales we hold here, six bedrooms against five at Villa Maravilla for thirty six thousand dollars more. Puerto Aventuras Puerto Aventuras is the gated marina town between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, with its own golf course, marina, dive centre, schools and shops behind a controlled entrance. It is one of the longest established residential communities on this coast, which is why the housing stock here is mature villas on generous lots rather than new build apartments. Price Asking $1,998,000 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Hunab Ku is a five bedroom, six bathroom villa in Aldea Zama, 458 square meters or about 4,930 square feet of construction, known locally for its design. The house Five bedrooms and six bathrooms across 458 square meters. Two pools rather than one, an outdoor gym and a rear lounge area, with solar backup installed. The architecture is what the house is known for, built around planted courtyards with the pools set into them rather than pushed to the edge of the plot. Aldea Zama Aldea Zama is the planned residential quarter between Tulum town and the beach road, with paved streets, services and its own commercial plaza. It is the part of Tulum that functions like a town rather than a jungle lot, which is why the resale market here is the most liquid in the area. Running costs Property taxes ran 48,993 pesos on the most recent bill, which the seller has provided. Solar backup takes the day load, which matters more in Tulum than it does elsewhere because the grid here is not always dependable in storm season. What it suits Five bedrooms and six bathrooms at this size is a house for a family who intend to live in it, or a rental that sleeps a large group without anybody sharing a bathroom. Two pools and an outdoor gym push it further towards the second use than most Aldea Zama villas of this size. Price Asking $1,195,000 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Casa Zorro is a four bedroom, four and a half bathroom villa in Region 15 in Tulum, 3,498 square feet on a 325 square meter lot, sold fully furnished. The house Four bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, under a palapa roof. A fully equipped kitchen opens to the dining area and the living space, and a rooftop lounge sits above. Two private gated parking spaces come with it. Outside A private pool sits in a jungle framed setting with room to hang a hammock or eat outside. The lot is enclosed, so the greenery is the boundary rather than a fence, and the rooftop lounge looks out over the canopy rather than at a neighbour. The numbers 3,498 square feet of construction on a 325 square meter lot puts most of the plot under roof, which is how a four bedroom with four and a half bathrooms fits on a lot this size. Four ensuites means nobody shares, which is the difference between a house that lets well and one that does not. Region 15 Region 15 is the residential belt west of the Tulum town centre, minutes from the white sand beaches and the town centre without paying beach road prices. It is where most of the town’s own residents actually live, which is why the rental market here runs year round rather than in season only. Worth saying plainly The photographs we hold do not do the house justice. It came to us from another agent and the set is what it is. Anyone seriously interested should see it, because the palapa roof and the pool setting read quite differently in person. Price Asking $399,900 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Villa Kookay is a six bedroom villa in Aldea Zama, over 4,000 square feet, built to split into three independent two bedroom units and back again. How it works Three two bedroom lock off units, each with its own kitchen, its own two bathrooms and its own private plunge pool. The ground floor carries a shared terrace and pool. Run as one house it sleeps up to eighteen; run as three it is three separate lettings under one title. That is the reason to buy it rather than a conventional six bedroom. The build Tzalam wood against chukum walls and Mayan stone floors, in soft tones that read organic rather than polished. Solar panels are installed. The house has a private well and is currently connected to the municipal supply, and a buyer can switch it back to the well. Aldea Zama Steps from cafes, small markets and services, in the planned quarter between the town and the beach road, with paved streets and its own commercial plaza. It is the part of Tulum that functions like a town rather than a jungle lot. What it suits A buyer who wants the option of living in part of it and letting the rest, or of letting all three units separately, without owning three properties and paying three sets of costs. Very little in Tulum is built this way from the start, and converting a conventional villa to do it afterwards means three kitchens, three sets of services and a planning problem. Price Asking $875,000 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Casa Xila penthouse is a one bedroom, one bathroom ocean view apartment at Tankah Bay with its own rooftop terrace and plunge pool, sold fully furnished. The apartment One bedroom and one bathroom with sliding doors on every side, so the ocean breeze runs straight through. A terrace wraps the apartment on three sides, north, west and south, and a private rooftop terrace with a plunge pool sits above it. What separates it Being the penthouse it takes the roof to itself rather than sharing an amenity deck. For a one bedroom on this bay that is unusual, and it is what the two hundred thousand dollar gap to the two bedroom below buys back. Tankah Bay Tankah Bay sits north of Tulum between Soliman Bay and the ruins, a shallow protected bay with a cenote running into it. It is quieter than the Tulum beach road and about twenty minutes from the town. Furnished and lettable Sold fully furnished, so it can be let from the day it changes hands without a fit out budget on top of the purchase. Tankah is a working bay rather than a resort strip, with a cenote feeding into it, a handful of small hotels and a reef close enough to swim to. That suits some buyers and not others, and it is worth being clear about before viewing. Buying a resale This is an existing home rather than a developer unit, so there is no delivery date, no construction risk and no payment schedule to run alongside the build. What you view is what transfers, furniture included where the listing says so. The trade is that the price is the owner’s and can move in either direction, and that there is only one of it, so timing matters more than it does on a project with twenty of the same plan. Price Asking $349,900 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s and moves with them rather than with a developer price list. For the full photo set, the floor plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

It was built in 2020 and 2021, so it is a recent building rather than an older resale. What separates it The pool is the apartment’s own and it opens off the bedrooms rather than sitting on a shared deck. On a bay where most stock is either a large villa or a small condo, a two bedroom with private water is the gap in the middle. Tankah Bay Tankah Bay sits north of Tulum between Soliman Bay and the ruins, a shallow protected bay with a cenote running into it, quieter than the beach road and about twenty minutes from town. Finished property. Villa Natur is a three bedroom, two and a half bathroom villa in La Veleta, 164 square meters of construction across 223 square meters including the exterior, sold fully furnished and turnkey. The house Three bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms with floor to ceiling windows and large sliding glass doors through several rooms, so the living space opens to the garden rather than looking at it. Two private pools rather than one. A gas stove, private parking and fibre optic internet with wifi through the house. What is unusual about it There is no HOA, which is rare in Tulum and takes a recurring cost off the table entirely. The house runs on its own well rather than the municipal supply. Both of those matter more here than they would elsewhere, because HOA fees on Tulum condos have risen sharply and the town water supply is not always dependable. Turnkey Sold fully furnished and equipped, so it can be lived in or let from the day it changes hands. It is a jungle villa within walking distance of the town rather than a lot on the far edge of it. La Veleta La Veleta sits west of the Tulum town centre and is where the town’s own residents live rather than visit. Shops, bakeries, cafes and restaurants are within walking distance, the beach is about ten minutes by car, and prices sit well below the beach road for the same build quality. Price Asking $329,900 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s rather than a developer price list. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Tuunich is a two bedroom, two and a half bathroom home in La Veleta with a plunge pool set against a stone clad wall in its own courtyard. The house Two bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms over two floors, with a lit stone staircase running up through the middle of the plan. The ground floor is open, with a white stone kitchen island under a sculptural pendant, a dining area against a textured stone wall, and full height glazing and doors onto the courtyard. The courtyard The plunge pool sits in a private courtyard rather than on a roof or a shared deck, walled on both sides and planted, so it is usable at any hour without being overlooked. The house is built in the pale chukum and stone palette that reads as Tulum without the heavy jungle timber. At this price Under two hundred and fifty thousand dollars for a two bedroom house with its own pool and its own front door is the part worth noting. Most stock at this level in Tulum is a condo in a building with a shared pool and a monthly fee attached to it. La Veleta La Veleta sits west of the Tulum town centre and is where the town’s own residents live rather than visit. Shops, bakeries, cafes and restaurants are within walking distance, the beach is about ten minutes by car, and prices sit well below the beach road for the same build quality. Price Asking $249,900 USD. It is a resale, so the price is the owner’s rather than a developer price list. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Pre-construction. Costa Residences is six beachfront towers inside Corasol, sixty six apartments in all, designed by Cuaik Arquitectos and sitting on top of the largest beach club the developer has built. The apartment Three bedrooms and three bathrooms across a single level, taking half a floor. The plan opens onto four separate terraces rather than one, so the living room, the kitchen and the primary suite each reach outside independently. The primary suite has two private terraces of its own plus an outdoor shower, and the open air deck off the living room carries a jacuzzi. 2,486 square feet inside and 883 outside, 3,369 square feet in total. A chef’s kitchen with high end appliances, floor to ceiling glass through the living space, and the lift opening straight into the apartment. Corasol Corasol is a gated master planned community on the coast at Playa del Carmen, built around the Gran Coyote golf course and holding its own stretch of Caribbean shoreline. Residents reach the sand through the Costa Beach Club rather than a public access, and the community runs its own sports park, cenote park and organic orchards alongside the golf. The Costa Beach Club The first two levels of every tower are the beach club, which the developer measures at 452,084 square feet with 433 linear feet of beach. Three family pools and an adult pool, a spa, an indoor gym and a jungle gym, a kids club, a gourmet market, a game room and a run of restaurants and bars. Owners also have the Owners Club, which is separate again. What ownership carries Corasol membership is included, which opens the golf, the beach club and The Park. Maintenance runs at 50 pesos per square metre plus 850 US dollars a year against the membership. Apartments start on the third level so every one holds a sea view. One point worth being plain about: Costa is a long term rental building. Nightly letting is not permitted, which is the trade for how quiet it stays. The Village, Palm Villas and Punta Laguna inside Corasol all run vacation rental programmes if that is what you are after. Price From 36,608,000 pesos, about $2,153,000 US dollars at seventeen pesos to the dollar. The developer prices in pesos and the peso figure is the one that governs the contract. Payment runs 30/70, 50/50, 70/30 or 90/10, a unit is set aside with 100,000 pesos, and Tower 4 delivers in the last trimester of 2026. For the floor plan, the full price list and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Estate Home A is the five bedroom, six and a half bathroom house at Palm Villas, a run of thirty five villas by Sordo Madaleno set along the tenth and eleventh holes of the Gran Coyote golf course inside Corasol. The house Three floors. The main floor holds the chef’s kitchen, the dining room, the living room and a wide covered terrace with a long pool, which is where the house is really lived in. The second floor carries bedrooms with their own sitting areas, terraces and ensuite bathrooms. The top floor is a terrace of its own. 4,597 square feet inside and 1,839 outside, 6,436 square feet in total. The architecture is the cubic, stacked design Sordo Madaleno drew for the scheme, in timber, stone and pale render, with the jungle and the fairway on show through full height glass. Which lot Phase 1 has sold out. Eight lots remain in Phase 3, ranging from 6,361 to 9,536 square feet, and the price moves with the lot rather than the house. Tell us how much garden you want and we will show you what is left. Corasol Corasol is a gated master planned community on the coast at Playa del Carmen, built around the Gran Coyote golf course and holding its own stretch of Caribbean shoreline. Palm Villas sits on the fairways rather than the beach, and residents reach the sand through the community’s own access rather than a public one. How it is delivered The villas hand over fully equipped: carpentry, doors and windows, oven, stove, extractor, gas grill and dishwasher, with central air conditioning throughout. Delivery runs 13 to 15 months from the 30 per cent down payment and signed contract. Two furniture packages are offered if you want it finished as well as equipped. Running it Palm Villas is in the vacation rental programme, so the house can be let when you are not in it, and there is a year round management team on site. Maintenance is 17,400 pesos. Corasol membership is available to purchase rather than included, and that is what opens the golf and the beach club. Price From 35,750,000 pesos, about $2,103,000 US dollars at seventeen pesos to the dollar. The developer prices in pesos and the peso figure is the one that governs the contract. Payment runs 30/70, 50/50, 70/30 or 90/10, and a villa is set aside with 100,000 pesos. For the floor plans, the lot availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Pre-construction. La Escondida is forty six single family lots inside Corasol, laid along the third and fourth holes of the Gran Coyote golf course. These are the smaller lots, fourteen of them still available, from 4,197 to 5,306 square feet. The lots Each one backs onto the golf course, so the green view is protected by the course rather than by a covenant that could change. Every lot also carries a commodatum strip, which is additional land you have the use of on top of the titled area, running between about 580 and 2,700 square feet depending on the lot. Maintenance runs at 9,000 pesos on the 4,197 square foot lots and 12,700 pesos on the larger ones in this group. Corasol Corasol is a gated master planned community on the coast at Playa del Carmen, built around the Gran Coyote golf course and holding its own stretch of Caribbean shoreline. La Escondida is the one part of it where you buy the land and build the house yourself. What you may build Three levels plus a rooftop, with underground parking permitted. Floor area ratio is 200 per cent, site coverage 60 per cent. There is no obligation to start by any particular date, which is unusual: most Riviera Maya subdivisions attach a construction deadline to the deed. You can hold the lot and build when it suits you. What comes with it Full Corasol membership is included rather than optional, which opens the golf, the Costa Beach Club and The Park. Lots have direct access onto the golf course. Possession passes at 65 per cent paid, and the lots deliver in December 2026. Three ways to take it Hold the lot and let Corasol keep building around it. Build your own house with your own architect, inside the community design manual. Or have us manage the build for you: we work with architects and contractors here every week and can take a lot to a finished house without you flying in for every decision. Price 8,360,000 to 9,990,000 pesos, about $492,000 to $588,000 US dollars at seventeen pesos to the dollar. The developer prices in pesos and the peso figure is the one that governs the contract. 14 of the forty six lots in this group are still available and the price moves with the lot, so tell us the size you want and we will send the current schedule. For the lot map, the availability schedule and a site visit, get in touch.

desc.en: Finished property. A two bedroom, two bathroom apartment at The Village, inside the Gran Coyote golf course at Corasol, ready to move into now. The apartment Around 845 square feet inside with a terrace on top, 1,008 to 1,031 square feet in total depending on the unit. Open plan living, dining and kitchen finished in pale timber and stone, with full height glazing onto the terrace and the jungle or the fairway beyond. desc.en: Finished property. Twelve residential macro lots inside Corasol at Playa del Carmen, ranging from 5,867 to 52,848 square metres, sold to developers building within the master plan. The parcels The twelve are grouped under names the master plan already uses: Paseo Palmeras, Paseo Sirenas, Paseo Maraya, Tierra Coral and Villas La Joya. Approved density runs from 44 to 330 households depending on the parcel, all at ten storeys, with land use coefficients between 0.50 and 1.80 and site coverage of 0.40 to 0.50. Land rates run from 473 to 788 US dollars per square metre, and the larger the parcel the lower the rate, which is the usual shape but worth confirming against the specific lot. What you are buying into These sit inside a community whose amenities are already built and operating rather than promised. The golf course, the beach club and The Park exist, and the residential phases around them are selling. That removes the amenity build from the development budget and the absorption risk that usually comes with a first mover site. Corasol Corasol is a gated master planned community on the coast at Playa del Carmen, built around the Gran Coyote golf course, an eighteen hole championship course designed by Nick Price, and holding its own stretch of Caribbean shoreline with the Costa Beach Club on it. The Park, a cenote park and organic orchards sit inside the same gates. Several residential phases are complete and occupied, several more are under construction. A macro lot buyer is therefore not opening a market, but building into one that already has residents, a working golf course and a finished beach club. Price $2,464,249 to $30,519,697 US dollars across the 12 parcels. Unlike the residential product inside Corasol, the macro lots are quoted in dollars rather than pesos. Price follows the parcel, so the figure that matters is the one against the specific lot. Full parcel information, the urban plan and the current availability follow an introduction. Get in touch and we will arrange the conversation with the developer directly.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Kanta Villas is four villas in the jungle of Region 15, Tulum, built by Desarrolladora Veleta Studio as their fifth project in the area. Two have sold. The two that remain are the front villas, four bedrooms and five bathrooms each, sleeping ten. The villa Three storeys and a rooftop solarium. The ground and first floors carry the living space and the bedrooms, the second floor opens onto the solarium, and beneath it all there is a cave pool cut into the plot. The living room is sunken under a double height ceiling with a suspended hammock in it, and all four bedrooms have their own bathroom, so nobody in a party of ten is sharing. 2,690 square feet inside, 960 square feet of terrace and garden and 399 square feet of pools, 4,047 square feet of private villa in total. The deed runs to 5,147 square feet once the share of parking and common areas is counted. Three pools to one house Each villa has a zen pool at ground level, a skypool on the roof and a private cave pool below, which is the feature the architecture is really built around. Alongside them the four villas share a cenote style cave pool of their own, roughly 283 square metres of it, in the jungle buffer between the houses. The architecture Stone, lime render and arches, drawing on Xavier Corberó, with vines run over the parapets so the buildings read as though the jungle is taking them back. It is a Mediterranean vocabulary built in Mayan materials rather than the timber and thatch most of Tulum reaches for, and it is the reason these look like nothing else in Region 15. Region 15 Region 15 sits inland from the hotel zone with the jungle still around it, close enough to reach the beach road and the town centre quickly but far enough out that the plots are large and the nights are quiet. It is where most of Tulum’s newer villa product has gone. Price 705,000 US dollars at the presale price, against a list price of 738,500. A turnkey version, delivered furnished and ready to let, is 768,500. Two villas are available and they are identical, so the choice is which side of the plot rather than which house. For the floor plans, the finish schedule and a site visit, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Yutori Yutori takes its name from the Japanese ゆとり, which means spaciousness, room to breathe, the luxury of time. Twenty apartments across two towers in Bacalar, built around that idea rather than around a square metre count. There is daily wellness programming, yoga, Pilates and movement classes, an activities hub running kayaks, paddleboards, sailboats and private catamaran dinners on the lagoon, and a rooftop pool looking over the water. How it is finished The specification is unusually explicit for a scheme this size. Helvex matte black plumbing fixtures with solid brass cores, German Aluplast multi chambered uPVC window and sliding door systems with a ten year warranty, and tankless water heaters throughout. All of it chosen for a humid tropical climate rather than lifted from a catalogue. Buying it A unit is reserved with 100,000 pesos and the reservation holds for fifteen days. Payment runs on one of three schedules, 30/60/10, 50/40/10 or 70/20/10, and the heavier the deposit the larger the discount, up to five per cent. The figure below is the full list price before any of that, so it is the most you would pay. The developer prices in pesos and the peso figure governs the contract. Price From 6,822,900 pesos, about $401,000 US dollars at seventeen pesos to the dollar. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

It is the largest apartment in the building that is not a penthouse, and the garden is nearly three times the size of the ones on the two bedroom ground floor units. For a family who want the wellness programming and the lagoon activities but do not want to be four floors up to get them, this is the one. Pre-construction. A three bedroom, four bathroom apartment at Oceanna Residences in the Zona Diamante of Playa del Carmen, on one of the three upper floors. The apartment 161.88 square metres, or 168.86 in unit 207, which is 1,742 to 1,818 square feet. Three bedrooms with a walk in closet off the principal, a fourth room that works as a study or a staff room, four full bathrooms, living and dining, kitchen, laundry area, terrace and two parking spaces. Ceilings on these levels are 2.80 metres. Twenty one of them are available across the three upper floors and the layout is the same on all of them, so what moves the price is the floor and the position along it rather than anything about the apartment itself. This is the layout the developer lists as Type A. Oceanna Residences Forty six apartments over four levels on 7,762 square metres in the Zona Diamante of Playa del Carmen, where the Cancun to Tulum highway meets Playa Magna. Invertikal Developers are building it and Artigas Arquitectos designed it, and the governing idea is low density: ten Garden Houses on the ground floor and twelve apartments on each of the three levels above, on a plot large enough for several times that number. Delivery is approximately October 2026. How it is built Facades in white render and cantera conchuela stone. Inside, porcelain floors with a wood finish, parota joinery throughout, white quartz kitchen counters and travertine vanities. Kitchens arrive with a four burner hob, an integrated oven and an extractor hood, Kohler taps and shower fittings and a Helvex basin. Terraces are washed beige concrete with chukum walls. Every apartment is cross ventilated and the building faces north. Water and gas are metered per unit and maintenance runs at $2.00 USD per square metre per month. Price From $439,593 USD up to $483,582 USD depending on the level and the unit. The developer quotes in US dollars and the price includes both private parking spaces. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. A two bedroom ocean front residence at SHA Residences Costa Mujeres, the first SHA wellness property in the Americas, delivered fully furnished. The residence Two are available and they are the same money at $2,400,000, so the choice between them is about layout rather than budget. Residence 72 is 290 square metres, 3,122 square feet, and carries a service bedroom, one parking space and a storage room. Residence 93 is 256 square metres, 2,756 square feet, with one parking space and a storage room and no service bedroom, which puts the whole of its area into the living space. Both are full ocean front, both are laid out around the terrace, and the bedrooms are en suite with a dressing room off the master. The terraces at SHA are treated as rooms in their own right, with an outdoor kitchen, a fireplace and a pool on them. SHA Residences Costa Mujeres SHA is the wellness clinic in Alicante that has spent nearly twenty years treating heads of state, royal families and anyone who could get a room, and Costa Mujeres is where it opened its first property in the Americas. The site is 17.3 acres of untouched jungle north of Cancun facing Isla Mujeres, with a third of a mile of white sand, its own cenote, and the largest coral reef in the northern hemisphere a mile offshore. Cancun airport is twenty minutes away. Sordo Madaleno are the architects and AB Living Group of Spain is the developer. There are only 31 residences on the whole estate. How the residences are specified White marble, natural fibres, native woods and regional pottery. Every residence takes an integrated kitchen, high end bathrooms, a terrace with an outdoor kitchen, an outdoor fireplace and a pool on it, home automation tuned to circadian rhythms, air and water purification, a utility room, a pantry, a cellar and a private owners entrance into the building. The full furniture package is included, down to the cutlery and the linen, so the residence is usable from the day you take the keys. What ownership includes A full time SHA trained team runs the building and the wellness services come to the residence: doctors, therapists, trainers and healthy cooking chefs, with room service from the SHA restaurants. Owners join the SHA Privileged programme and can exchange into SHA Spain and the forthcoming SHA Emirates, and the developer runs a rental pool for anyone who wants the residence let while they are away. Price $2,400,000 USD, quoted by the developer in US dollars and including the full furniture package. For the floor plan, the full specification and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

The residence Residence 94, 330 square metres or 3,552 square feet across interior and terrace, with three bedrooms, two parking spaces and a storage room. It is the only three bedroom left on the release, and the one above it, Residence 90 at 346 square metres, is already reserved. The bedrooms are en suite and the master takes a dressing room with it. The living space opens the full width onto the terrace, which has an outdoor kitchen, an outdoor fireplace and a pool of its own, so a three bedroom here behaves more like a house on one level than an apartment. Full ocean front, with the reef in the middle distance. The bedrooms are en suite with a dressing room off the master. The terrace carries an outdoor kitchen, an outdoor fireplace and a pool, and the building steps back at each level so the top floor terrace is the deepest in the building. This is the last penthouse. Finished property. A two bedroom oceanfront residence on the seventh floor of The Residences at The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, and the least expensive way into the building. The residence Unit 705, 203 square metres inside with a 31 square metre terrace, 234 square metres in all, which is 2,519 square feet. Two bedrooms, a service bedroom, one parking space and a storage room. The developer lists it as Type 02. It is the only two bedroom left in the building. Eight were built across the tower and the other seven have gone, which is what happens to the entry price in a building where everything else starts near three million dollars. Seventh floor, full ocean orientation, and the same kitchen, bathrooms and service as the largest residence in the tower. The Residences at The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort Costa Mujeres sits north of Cancun, across the water from Isla Mujeres, twenty minutes from the airport and in front of the largest coral reef in the northern hemisphere. The residences occupy their own part of the resort with a separate owners entrance, and they carry the St. Regis service model with them: a butler, a doorman, valet parking around the clock, housekeeping and a concierge who books everything from a car to a dinner table. Sordo Madaleno designed the building, Maat Handasa the landscape, and AB Living Group is the developer. How the residences are specified An integrated kitchen with a stone worktop and appliances of the Sub Zero, Wolf or Smeg order, including a wine cooler and a dishwasher. Bathrooms in marble with porcelain fittings and a freestanding bath in the master. A separate laundry room, a pantry, a storage room, a wine cellar, an owners closet, large walk in wardrobes and a master bedroom with its own dressing room and en suite. Every residence has a service bedroom and parking. Price $2,365,033 USD, quoted by the developer in US dollars. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Pre-construction. The smallest and least expensive residence at EXISTENCE, a one bedroom on the ground floor of Tower B with its own garden and swimming pool. The residence 62.5 square metres, 673 square feet, on the ground floor. One bedroom, with the garden, the private pool and the zenith shower that every ground floor unit in the building carries. There is one of these left, unit B 13, and it is the entry price into the building by a clear margin: the next size up is $258,055 and the top floor residence is $624,000. For a buyer who wants the address, the reef and a private pool without stretching, this is the one. EXISTENCE Forty two residences across two towers and six levels on the western shore of Cozumel, with direct access to the sea and the Mesoamerican reef a few minutes offshore. The common areas are built as instruments for watching time, light and water rather than as a standard amenity deck: an observatory, a contemplation rooftop, a sky float pool, a jungle lobby and a water lobby. That is the reason to look at this building over the others on the island. Tsalach Real Estate is the developer, and delivery is scheduled for December 2027. What the ground floor gives you Every ground floor residence at EXISTENCE takes a garden, a private swimming pool and a zenith shower with a floating table under it. The pool is yours rather than shared, the garden screens it, and the living space opens onto both, so the whole of the outdoor space belongs to the residence rather than to the building. Price $234,375 USD, quoted by the developer in US dollars and subject to change without notice. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A three bedroom, three and a half bathroom penthouse at the top of the Barlovento tower at Yucalpetén Resort Marina, looking down over the marina, finished and ready to hand over. The penthouse Unit B 1101 on the eleventh floor. 143.76 square metres inside, a 26.13 square metre terrace and a private solarium of 62.03 square metres on the roof above, reached by an internal stair. 231.92 square metres of living space in all, which is 2,496 square feet. Three bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms, three parking bays and a storage locker. The developer lists it as the Type B2 penthouse. The view is the marina. The photograph at the top of this page was taken from the tower at the height of this floor, and the boats in it are the boats you would look at. Yucalpetén Resort Marina A master planned marina resort on the Gulf coast at Progreso, Yucatán, thirty five minutes north of Mérida and its international airport. SIMCA Desarrollos, which has delivered more than two thousand apartments across the Yucatán, is building four residential towers, twenty five beachfront villas, a private beach club on five hundred metres of sand, a marina with a yacht club and dry storage, and a 750 metre private pier. The sea in front of the beach club is a natural pool closed to motorised craft. Mérida is the safest large city in Mexico and Progreso is its beach, so this is the first project of its kind on this coast rather than the latest. Delivered Barlovento and Sotavento are the first two towers and they are finished, furnished show apartments included. Handover is immediate. The photographs on this page are of the real building, the real pool and the real views from the tower at height, not renders. Price and parking The developer prices in pesos and the peso figure is the one the contract runs on. The living area above is the apartment, its terrace and its solarium. The parking bays and the storage locker are titled with the apartment but are separate spaces and are not counted in it. Price $17,900,000 pesos, about $1,053,000 US dollars at seventeen pesos to the dollar. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

A four bedroom, four bathroom villa on an 800 square meter lot inside Tulum Country Club, with two pools, a private rooftop terrace and the club’s golf course, beach club and 24 hour security around it. MXN 33,000,000, about $1,941,176 USD. desc.en: Finished property. A furnished two level penthouse at Town Center in Aldea Zama, Tulum, offered for resale at $550,000 USD: 87 square meters inside, a 38 square meter private rooftop with its own pool, and a third bedroom that locks off with its own entrance. The penthouse Unit 318 is on the top floor of Tower 1. Inside, an open living and dining room with a wood clad kitchen along one wall, and three bedrooms. The third has its own entrance and a built in desk, so the home lives as two bedrooms plus a separate suite for guests, a tenant or remote work, or as three bedrooms with the door open. An internal stair leads to the rooftop, walled in stone for privacy, with a private pool, a custom bar with granite counters and a teak backsplash, a 36 inch gas grill, a fridge, ice maker and sink, turf with accent lighting and planting along the edges. 1,345 square feet in all. It is sold furnished and equipped, and the owner has gone further than most. Osmosis filtered water at the kitchen and on the roof and filtration in every shower, XPel tinted glazing, Sonos sound on every television plus ceiling speakers and a subwoofer in the living room, an ice maker and dishwasher, Ring cameras on every entrance with remote access, smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, Starlink internet with Eero extenders inside and out, custom blackout curtains, floor to ceiling cabinetry, designer wallpaper, a full height entry mirror, and a washer and dryer. Town Center, Aldea Zama Aldea Zama is the planned community on the road between Tulum town and the beach, and Town Center is one of its established residential blocks. Owners share a coworking space, a kids’ playroom, a cinema room, a games lounge, a fitness center and on site laundry. Price $550,000 USD, furnished. This is a resale of a completed and delivered unit, not a presale. Most of what is offered at this price in Tulum is still on plan. This one is built, furnished and ready, with a private pool on the roof. For the floor plan, the walkthrough video and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

A four bedroom house of 850 square metres on a 776 square metre lot in Isla Caimán, the residential island inside Puerto Cancún, looking over the golf course, with a pool, jacuzzi and outdoor bathroom, ready for immediate delivery. The house Three storeys over a basement. Upstairs, three bedrooms each with its own bathroom and a television room. On the ground floor a guest bedroom with bathroom, a second television room, an office, the fitted kitchen, living and dining rooms. The basement holds a service room, laundry, storage and the plant room. Outside, the pool, a jacuzzi and an outdoor bathroom. Finishes are full slabs of ivory marble, a sintered stone kitchen counter, American walnut joinery, laminated glazing and Porcelanosa and Helvex fittings. The neighbouring house, Caimán 211, is offered by the same owner and listed separately. Puerto Cancún Puerto Cancún is the gated marina and golf community at the northern end of the Hotel Zone, ten minutes from downtown Cancún and twenty from the airport. It is built around an 18 hole golf course and a private marina that opens straight onto the Caribbean, with a clubhouse, spa and gym on the water, a beach club, Marina Town Center for shopping and restaurants, and security around the clock at the gate and again inside the neighbourhoods. The canal front houses have their own docks and boat lifts, so a boat sits at the bottom of the garden. Price $3,000,000 USD. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

A colonial Mexican house of 700 square metres on a 1,160 square metre canal front lot in Puerto Altamira, inside Puerto Cancún, with its own dock, a pool terrace under a palapa and a triple height living room. The house Two storeys built around a circular plan that keeps the air moving, with a triple height living room under a thirteen metre ceiling and a wall of water lit from skylights by the entrance. Five bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, the main bedroom with his and hers dressing rooms; three of the bedrooms are upstairs and face the canal. A family room that works as a television room or office. Every floor is laid in oversized irregular marble slabs, the doors are antique and hand carved on both faces, and the ironwork, the great chandelier and the art are part of the sale. Central air conditioning, water softening, a hydro pump, film coated 6 mm glazing, Salam and Canadian hardwoods, and solar panels. The terrace is the reason to buy it: marble underfoot, a full size pool, a palapa with dining for a crowd, sunset over the canal, and services already run for a jacuzzi and pergola. The dock takes a boat on the canal that leads to the marina and the sea. Three dining rooms, inside, on the pool terrace and on the beach; two kitchens; three television rooms, two of them convertible to bedrooms; a beach lounge inside and out with its own bathroom; two offices; a gym with closet and bathroom; and a private cinema. A covered garage for seven large cars and space outside for six more. The water A pool with jacuzzi on the terrace and a second pool at beach level beside the beach lounge, a palapa with living and dining, steps into the sea and a resting net over the water. A 500 square metre federal zone concession, 400 square metres reclaimed from the sea and an extra 800 square metres of beach come with it. Aldea Kalan Aldea Kalan is 12.7 hectares of preserved jungle on the shore of the Bacalar lagoon, with 165 metres of lagoon front and its own dock, designed by V Taller and built by Elemental Creations for the team behind the neighbouring Aldea Mayab. The plan is a sequence of aldeas, each of four small round towers of ten apartments: four two bedroom garden homes on the ground floor, four one bedrooms on the first and two three bedroom penthouses on top. Aldea Hormiga sold out and Aldea Venado is the phase now selling. Residents share a large clubhouse with a pool, a restaurant and a juice bar, two smaller clubhouses with pools, pergolas and grills, two pádel courts, a gym and yoga area, a spa with massage cabins, steam, sauna, jacuzzi and cold plunge, the dock on the lagoon, a parking space per apartment, a gatehouse with security and administration and a private wastewater treatment plant. Delivery is scheduled for December 2028. Bacalar Bacalar is the lagoon of seven colours in the south of Quintana Roo, forty kilometres long and a pueblo mágico since 2006, two hours south of Tulum and forty minutes from Chetumal and its airport, and the last stretch of this coast where lagoon front land can still be bought at these prices. For the floor plans, the current availability and a call with the developer, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. A five bedroom house of 500 square metres on a 680 square metre lot in Retorno Akab Uno, inside Playacar Phase II, the gated golf community on the south side of Playa del Carmen, with a private pool, a covered terrace and a garden, parking for three cars and security at the gate around the clock. The house Two storeys behind a stone clad front and a walled courtyard. The living room sits under a timber ceiling and opens through walls of glass to the terrace and the pool, with a dining table for ten beside it and a kitchen fitted in pale cabinets with granite counters, a breakfast bar and a professional range. Four bedrooms plus a studio room, so five in all, with five and a half bathrooms, fitted closets throughout, a walk in dressing room and twin basins in the main suite, and one room set up with bunks for children. There is a study, a laundry and a service room, and every room has its own air conditioning. Floors are travertine inside and out. The house is sold unfurnished; the photographs show it as it is lived in today. Outside A covered terrace with a lounge and a dining table runs along the pool, which is lined in turquoise mosaic with a shallow ledge and steps, under palms and a sail shade, with a hedged garden path around the side of the house and a planted courtyard at the entrance. Playacar Phase II Playacar is the gated residential community at the southern end of Playa del Carmen, and Phase II is its larger, greener half, laid out around the Hard Rock golf course with security at the gates and patrols inside, ten minutes from Quinta Avenida and the ferry to Cozumel, five from the beach at Playacar Phase I and about forty five from Cancún airport. Retorno Akab Uno is one of the quiet cul de sacs off the main loop. Price $21,200,000 MXN, which the seller quotes at $1,284,000 USD. At 17 pesos to the dollar the figure is about $1,247,000 USD; the peso price is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. McCloud House, known as The Artist’s Mansion, is a furnished compound of concrete pavilions on the Tulum to Cobá road near Gran Cenote, with a 318 square metre main house, a 215 square metre atelier, a pool house, a rooftop the size of the house and a long pool set in a lawn, about 1,024 square metres of built area in all, reached by a paved road from the highway. The house The main house is a single storey of board formed concrete and glass: a double height living room with a kitchen island in black stone and a professional range, walls of glazing on both sides so the lawn is on one hand and the pool on the other, three bedrooms with four bathrooms, one of them a wet room in polished cement with a sunken bath and a glass wall to the garden, and a rooftop of 318 square metres above it all. A walled patio holds a single tree, and a stone courtyard behind the house has an outdoor dining table under the canopy. It is sold fully furnished. The atelier Across the lawn stands the atelier, 215 square metres of white, top lit studio with rolling racks and work tables, built for painting at scale and equally suited to a gallery, a yoga hall or a workshop. A 28 square metre pool house sits by the water, and there are further outbuildings and small rooms at the back of the site that the seller has not yet measured, so the built figure is a floor rather than a ceiling. The pool The pool is 146 square metres, a long rectangle of pale plaster running from the house across the lawn to a timber deck, lit at night, with black loungers on the grass and mature trees around the boundary. Location The property sits on the Cobá road at kilometre marker 050, a few minutes from Gran Cenote and about ten from Tulum town, on the side of Tulum where the land is still quiet and the plots are large. The beach road is fifteen minutes away and Tulum airport about thirty. Price $799,000 USD, fully furnished as photographed. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. A furnished two bedroom apartment of 110 square metres including its two terraces on the second floor of Itza II, a gated building with a shared pool and an elevator in Aldea Zama, Tulum, with a private jacuzzi on the terrace and the garden and tree line in front of it. Completed at the end of 2023 and sold with its furniture and appliances, so it is ready to live in or to let from the day it changes hands. The apartment An open living and dining room under a high ceiling with a kitchen in walnut cabinets and black granite, a breakfast bar for four, a dining table for six and sliding glass onto the main terrace. Two bedrooms, each with a full bathroom, built in wardrobes and air conditioning, the bathrooms finished in polished cement with carved stone basins, lit mirrors and walk in showers. Floors are travertine, the lighting is rattan and wicker, and the furniture is the set in the photographs, which stays. The terraces Two of them, under timber ceilings. The main terrace off the living room holds a sofa, loungers and the private jacuzzi, set in a stone surround with the jungle canopy at eye level; the second, off the bedroom side, is a quieter corner with a chair and the same view. Below, the residents share a pool that runs along the building through the planting, and a palapa in the garden. Itza II A low rise building of stone and white render with an elevator, controlled access and a shared pool, finished at the end of 2023 by an established developer and well kept since. Location Aldea Zama is the master planned neighbourhood between Tulum town and the beach road, with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, gyms, spas and services inside the community, the town a few minutes one way and the beach a few minutes the other. It is the most established address in Tulum and the one buyers ask for first, for their own use and for letting. Price $330,000 USD, fully furnished with appliances included. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A studio of 35.93 square metres on the second floor of Macondo 5ta Avenida Fase 2, a condo hotel on Fifth Avenue in Playa del Carmen, delivered turnkey in 2024 and run under the building’s own rental programme, so it can be used, let or both without an owner arranging anything. The studio Unit 214, one open room with luxury finishes, air conditioning and a full bathroom, handed over furnished and equipped and ready to receive guests. There is no assigned parking; the building has underground parking and the maintenance fee runs at 2.5 US dollars per square metre a month. The building Macondo is the project widely credited with starting the transformation of this stretch of Fifth Avenue, and the amenity deck is the reason people buy in it: two infinity pools on the roof, a padel court looking out to the Caribbean, a rooftop bar, sun decks, a fully equipped gym, a lobby staffed around the clock, a restaurant with room service and retail units at street level. The building is managed as a condo hotel, so the rental operation, the housekeeping and the guest handling are all in house. The location Fifth Avenue runs the length of Playa del Carmen and the northern end, where Macondo sits, is the fastest growing and best held part of it, a short walk from the beach, the restaurants and the shops, and about fifty minutes from Cancún airport. Playa del Carmen Playa del Carmen is the working heart of the Riviera Maya, an hour south of Cancún airport and a ferry ride from Cozumel, built around Quinta Avenida and a long white beach. It carries the deepest short term rental market on this coast and the widest year round population, which is why apartments here let steadily rather than seasonally. Price $238,160 USD, delivered turnkey and enrolled in the rental programme. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. A residential lot of 659.14 square metres, 19.2 by 52 metres, in Amares Riviera Maya, the gated community on the highway at Xpu Há between Playa del Carmen and Akumal. Manzana 10, Lote 3, ready to build on, with services run underground and concrete roads already in. The lot A regular rectangle deep enough for a house, a pool and a garden without crowding the boundaries. The community’s rules allow roughly 36 percent of the lot to be built on, so the rest stays as native jungle. That is the point of the place: lower density, more privacy between neighbours, and the feeling of living inside the forest rather than on a cleared plot. The community Amares is built around a clubhouse with reception, a lounge bar, an adults pool, a kids club with its own pool, coworking, event rooms and wide planted terraces, with six kilometres of jogging and cycling paths and a semi professional skate park. There is a separate sports centre with an athletics track, a football pitch, tennis and padel courts, a semi olympic pool and a full gym with changing rooms; a wellness centre with indoor and outdoor yoga rooms, massage rooms, water circuits and a second gym; and a gastronomic centre with two teaching kitchens and a farm to table garden the residents can plant. A four hectare forest reserve with an interpretation centre and a walking trail sits inside the gates, along with an auditorium, a cenote and controlled access with security posts. Xpu Há Xpu Há sits between Playa del Carmen and Akumal, twenty minutes south of Playa and forty five from Cancún airport, and is known for one of the calmest and widest beaches on the coast. The residential communities here are gated, low density and set back in the jungle, with beach clubs on the sand in front of them. Price $175,000 USD. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Two bedrooms and two full bathrooms finished in stone with walk in showers and framed mirrors, a laundry, a guest toilet and a service room. The rooms are finished and unfurnished, so the interiors are the buyer’s to decide. The building Volta is the building with the planted facade, balconies of trailing green running the full height of it, and water at the entrance. Inside there is a lobby, a pool and pool bar, a jacuzzi, a gym, a coworking room, a sky lounge with a fireplace and a rooftop with a long pool, sun beds and a shaded bar looking over the town to the sea, with a lift and security around the clock. Pets are allowed and the title is ready for immediate transfer. The location One block from Fifth Avenue puts the beach, the restaurants, the shops and the ferry within a few minutes on foot, and Cancún airport is about fifty minutes up the highway. desc.en: Finished property. A three bedroom apartment on the first floor of Alba, the Archea designed building in Puerto Cancún, with 176 square metres inside, a 20.2 square metre terrace and a 40.6 square metre roof garden of its own, 236.8 square metres in all. The apartment Three bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, and a guest toilet, so three and a half in all. An open living and dining room runs to the terrace behind full height glass, with a kitchen in pale timber and stone along one side, a laundry room and a service room with its own bathroom behind it. Floors are large format stone, the joinery is oak and the bathrooms are lit marble with walk in showers. Two parking spaces and a basement storage unit are included, and the private roof garden makes this the only first floor apartment in the building with outdoor space above as well as in front. Alba Alba is a building of thirty homes, twenty six apartments and four penthouses, designed by Archea Associati of Florence and built by a developer with twelve years of vertical projects in Cancún behind it. It is finished and photographed as it stands. Every apartment comes with two parking spaces, three for the penthouses, and a storage unit in the basement. The shared floors run from a lobby, pool and sun deck at garden level with a gym, business centre and entertainment room beside them, up to a sky jacuzzi on the fifth floor and, above that, a roof grill with a bar and dining under pergolas and a sky terrace for events, both looking over Puerto Cancún to the sea. Puerto Cancún Puerto Cancún is the gated marina and golf community where the Hotel Zone, the city and the Caribbean meet. Alba sits 150 metres from the marina, which is planned as the largest in Cancún with more than 450 berths and room for yachts to 200 feet, and 350 metres from the shopping centre with its 122 units, cinemas and restaurants. The Tom Weiskopf 18 hole par 72 golf course, the beach club with its pools and restaurant on the sand, and the sailing club are all within five minutes, and the airport is twenty. Pre-construction. Serviced residential lots of 180 to 545 square metres at Tierra Madre, the gated community of 403 lots cut into virgin jungle in the north of Playa del Carmen, for owners to build their own house among the trees. The lots These are the standard lots, the type the community is mostly made of and the least expensive way into it. Most run to 180 square metres, with wider and deeper plots scattered through the plan up to 545 square metres, so the choice is between a compact plot close to the amenities and a larger one on the outer streets. Every lot is sold serviced and ready to build on, to the community’s design guidelines, with the option of one of the developer’s four house models instead. Tierra Madre Tierra Madre is a gated community of 403 residential lots by Grupo Emerita on a tract of virgin jungle in the north of Playa del Carmen, laid out so that the houses sit among the trees rather than in place of them. It is sold as serviced land for owners to build their own house to the community’s design guidelines, and the developer also offers four house models for those who would rather buy the house and the lot together. The amenities are built and photographed. They fall into two halves. El Santuario is the clubhouse: a lobby bar, a spa with massage cabins, sauna, steam and jacuzzis, a gym, a semi olympic pool with showers and changing rooms, a cinema, an events hall, a playroom, an adults bar, a wine cellar, grills, a fire pit, padel and tennis courts, and a natural cavern called El Tuch fitted out as a lounge. La Jungla is the parkland around it: a yoga temple, an amphitheatre, a green labyrinth, a water mirror, sculptures, a pet park, a five a side football pitch, basketball and multi use courts, mini golf, a trampoline, an elastic net, a climbing frame, a calisthenics and exercise circuit, picnic areas and a children’s playground. Delivery of the lots is scheduled for December 2026. Price From $1,457,122 MXN, about $85,713 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar, on the developer’s shortest payment plan. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. Longer plans are priced higher and we will send the current schedule and the availability map on request. For the current availability map, the lot plans and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

The villa Two levels and a roof studio. The ground floor opens the full width of the house through glass to a private pool in a walled garden, with the living and dining room and a kitchen behind it, and the upper floor holds the bedrooms with a second pool and a pergola on the roof terrace. Finishes are polished cement, stone and pale timber, with trees left standing in the courtyards. The lock off has its own entrance, so an owner can live in one part and let the other. Availability and price Five are free across phases one, two and three, all of this type, four looking onto the amenities and one onto the central garden. Phases one, two and three are finished and handing over. Seremonia Habitat Seremonia is a community of villas in Region 15 built around the trees rather than in place of them, with concrete, stone and timber left largely unpainted and the jungle kept between the houses. Residents share a long pool and a circular jacuzzi in the gardens, a gym set among the trunks, a yoga area, a hammock area, a lounge terrace, a pizza oven, a kids area and a toddlers pool, a pet garden, tree lined ramblas, parking, a lobby, a beach club and security around the clock. Phases one, two and three are finished and handing over; phase four follows in August 2026. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

The towers stand around a curving pool in planted gardens, with a sun bed area, a barbecue zone, a reception, a laundry and a commercial unit at the entrance. Tulum Tulum has grown from a beach town into a working city with its own international airport, and the demand that keeps its rentals full now runs through the year rather than only in winter. The towers stand around a curving pool in planted gardens, with a sun bed area, a barbecue zone, a reception, a laundry and a commercial unit at the entrance. Tulum Tulum has grown from a beach town into a working city with its own international airport, and the demand that keeps its rentals full now runs through the year rather than only in winter. A development ten minutes from the sand, with the town's restaurants, supermarkets and schools closer still, sits where both markets overlap. The pool and the building The private pool sits in a walled garden at the apartment’s door, long enough to swim in and screened by planting. It is a resale, so the apartment is finished, furnished and available now rather than on a delivery schedule. Aldea Zamá Aldea Zamá is the master planned neighbourhood between Tulum town and the beach road, with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, gyms and services inside the community, the town a few minutes one way and the beach a few minutes the other. It is the most established address in Tulum and the first one buyers ask for. For the floor plan, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Residential lots of 1,000 square metres, twenty metres of frontage by fifty metres deep, at Ciudad Muyil, a new grid of streets being laid out at Muyil, twenty kilometres south of Tulum on the road to Felipe Carrillo Puerto. Almost every lot in the plan is the same size, with a handful of exceptions and corner plots. Where it is Muyil, also called Chunyaxché, is the last village before the Sian Ka’an Biosphere Reserve, and the development sits about two kilometres from the lagoons and the Muyil archaeological site and about one kilometre from the entrance to the reserve itself. Sian Ka’an is the largest protected area on this coast, a UNESCO World Heritage site of lagoons, mangrove and reef, and nothing can be built inside it, which fixes what this land will always look out on. Tulum, its beach road and its airport are twenty to thirty minutes north on the 307. What is there now, and what is coming This is raw land at the beginning of its life. The plan lays out the streets, the blocks and the green areas, and the developers are to install the roads, the lighting and the services; on their own timetable that work starts in two to three years, with houses and apartments following two or three years after that. Nothing else residential is being built this close to Muyil at the moment. The other projects around the village are tourism infrastructure for the lagoons and the ruins, which is parking, boat services, market space and schools rather than competing subdivisions. Who it is for It is a long term holding rather than a house to move into, bought at the stage before services arrive, and it is priced accordingly. Commercial lots of the same size are also available, and larger commercial parcels have not yet been released. Price From $500,000 MXN for a 1,000 square metre lot, about $29,412 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. Buy it and hold it, build on it yourself when the services arrive, or have us design and build the house for you when the time comes. For the plan, the available lot numbers and a drive down to see it, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A one bedroom apartment of 68.93 square metres at Oniric Tulum, 58.11 inside and a 10.82 square metre terrace with a plunge pool on it, in a finished boutique building in Region 8, the part of Tulum closest to the beach. The apartment One bedroom and one bathroom, an open living and dining room with a German kitchen along one wall, and full height glass onto the terrace and its plunge pool. Floors are travertine marble, walls are hand applied chukum and lime stucco, and the bathroom carries a carved stone basin and a walk in shower. It is delivered finished with the kitchen and appliances installed. Availability and price Three of this type are free: Gratitude 101 and Gratitude 201 at 68.93 square metres and Inspiration 201 at 69.11. Gratitude 101 and Inspiration 201 are $3,058,470 MXN, about $179,910 USD, reduced from $3,958,200; Gratitude 201 is $3,150,000 MXN. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. Maintenance runs at about $2,479 to $2,505 MXN a month. Oniric Tulum Oniric is twenty seven residences in six small towers built around a cenote the architects carved by hand, a circle of concrete latticework open to the sky with water at the bottom of it and the stairs winding down. Arkham Projects drew the building and World by Hand did the interiors, in chukum stucco, regional laja stone, travertine and Santo Tomás marble. It is finished and handing over now, with title clear from the first day. Residents have the cenote and its pool, rooftop terraces over the jungle canopy, a yoga and meditation deck, a massage studio, a steam room and ice bath, a speakeasy bar, a coworking and creative lounge, an air conditioned gym, a concierge, landscaped gardens, a lift and gated access, along with access to a set of partner beach clubs on the Tulum coast. Every apartment has a private terrace, an assigned parking space and its own plunge pool. Region 8 Region 8 is the part of Tulum closest to the beach, reached off Guardianes Maya Avenue with paved access through Avenida 65 and five hundred metres from Avenida Kukulkán, the road down to the sand. The beach is about five minutes away and the town centre about seven, with Tulum’s international airport and the Maya Train station both a short drive. For the floor plans, the current availability and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A residential lot of 465.13 square metres, 35 metres deep, inside NorteMérida Residencial Club, the gated community on the Mérida to Progreso highway at the entrance to Komchén, in the Zona Country north of the city. The plot is outlined in yellow on the aerial photographs, on the outer curve of one of the clusters with the equipped park across the road from it. The lot It is a serviced plot in a community that is already built and lived in: electricity runs underground, the streets carry public lighting, the avenues are planted and the junctions are laid out as landscaped roundabouts. Neighbouring plots are finished houses, so a buyer is building into a street that is already standing rather than onto a bare grid. It suits a house now or a holding to build on later. The community NorteMérida is low density, arranged as six private clusters, each with its own equipped park. The Casa Club carries a restaurant, a snack bar, a spa, a play area and a multipurpose room, and residents also have a swimming pool, a padel court, a gym, a sauna, a children’s play area and a playroom. The development is gated with security around the clock, is pet friendly, and is laid out for universal accessibility. Where it is The Zona Country sits on the road out of Mérida towards Progreso and the Gulf coast, about thirteen kilometres from the city at the Komchén turning. Mérida is consistently ranked the safest large city in Mexico, and its northern edge is where the golf clubs, the private schools, the hospitals and the newer shopping is concentrated. The beach at Progreso is about twenty five minutes further north. Price $2,232,624 MXN, which is $4,800 MXN per square metre across 465.13 square metres, about $131,331 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. desc.en: Finished property. A modern house of 450 square metres of construction on a 480 square metre lot at Caleta Yalku, inside the gated community of Puerto Aventuras, with a large pool, a covered outdoor kitchen and a lawn planted with palms. It is offered directly by the owner. The house Two levels around a double height living space, with a floating timber and steel stair rising through it and full height sliding glass along the garden side, so the living room, the dining area and the pool terrace read as one room when the doors are open. The kitchen runs along the back in white lacquer and walnut with a stone island and a breakfast bar, opening straight onto the living room. Floors are large format marble effect porcelain throughout, the bedrooms are upstairs, and the bathrooms are finished in stone with twin basins and a freestanding bath in the principal one, alongside a fitted dressing room. Outside The pool runs the width of the garden in dark tile, with a lawn and young palms beyond it and a covered terrace along one side holding an outdoor kitchen with a built in grill, a dining table for six and a lounge seating area under a timber and clay tile roof. How it is built The house is lifted 1.2 metres off the ground, which is what keeps humidity and mould out of the structure on this coast. Walls are double skinned with insulation between them, the windows are hurricane rated, there are two central air conditioning units rather than mini splits, solar panels are installed, and the water system carries a softener and an anti parasite treatment. Running costs The community fee is 12,800 pesos a year, billed as four payments of 3,200. Predial, the annual property tax to Playa del Carmen, is about 9,600 pesos. Water runs at about 1,100 pesos a month for a family of three, and electricity varies with consumption and with what the solar panels cover. Puerto Aventuras Puerto Aventuras is the gated marina town between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, with security around the clock and almost everything on foot: the beach is a nine minute walk, the golf club five, the restaurants, shops and grocery five, the school twelve and the clinic nine. The marina and yacht club, the beach club, the tennis academy, padel and pickleball, sailing, fishing and catamaran charters all sit inside the gates, which is why families tend to stay once they arrive. Price $980,000 USD, offered directly by the owner. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. Kasana is a marina estate on a corner plot in the canals of Puerto Aventuras, with two private docks, about two hundred degrees of water around it and a yacht sized berth at the bottom of the garden. Four principal bedroom suites, five and a half bathrooms, separate staff and service quarters, sold fully furnished and turnkey. The house Two levels of white volumes stepping down to the water, drawn so that almost every room ends in glass on the canal. The social floor is one open run of living room, dining room and kitchen, the kitchen in pale timber and stone with an island and a bar, opening across the whole elevation to the pool terrace. The four bedroom suites are upstairs, each with its own bathroom, its own glazed wall and its own view down the canal; the principal suite carries a dressing room and a bathroom with a freestanding bath and twin basins. Floors are large format stone throughout and the furniture, which is included, was chosen for the house. The water The infinity pool runs the full width of the plot with a jacuzzi beside it and the marina beyond, so the swimming edge and the water line read as one surface. Above, a rooftop terrace carries a second pool and a shaded lounge with the marina on three sides. The two docks give more than a hundred feet of combined berthing, on protected navigation canals with fast access to the open sea. Because the frontage is marina rather than beach, there is no public traffic in front of the house and none of the sargassum that lands on the open coast. Caleta beach is five minutes on foot, or a few minutes by boat or paddleboard. What comes with it A solar energy system, the full furniture and equipment package, and the staff quarters set apart from the main house. Puerto Aventuras Puerto Aventuras is the gated marina town between Playa del Carmen and Tulum: security around the clock, its own marina infrastructure, a golf course, a beach club, restaurants, shops and schools, and a settled international community of families and long term residents rather than a holiday strip. Price $5,350,000 USD, furnished and turnkey. Fuller information on the house follows genuine interest. For the full presentation and a private viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Finished property. A three bedroom house of 166 square metres on a 207 square metre lot on a quiet paved street a few minutes north of the Tulum town centre, with a private pool along the side of the house and jungle behind it. It is sold turnkey. The house Two levels behind a wall of black framed glass that runs the full height of the living room, so the pool and the trees are in the room. The ground floor is one open space: a deep sectional seating area, a dining table for eight and a kitchen in dark timber with a stone counter and a woven pendant over it, with a stair in black steel and timber rising against a rough stone wall. Three bedrooms upstairs, two full bathrooms and a guest toilet, finished in polished cement with carved stone basins and walk in showers, with macramé, woven pendants and pale linen throughout. The furniture is included. Outside The pool runs the length of the plot between the house and the boundary wall, with a hammock slung at one end, a lounger terrace at the other and mature jungle trees left standing around it. The plot backs onto jungle rather than a neighbour, which is what keeps the glass wall private. The value Three bedrooms with a private pool at this price is unusual in Tulum, and the house is finished and furnished rather than a shell, so there is nothing to spend before moving in or letting it. Tulum Tulum now has its own international airport and a year round population rather than a winter one, and the streets between the town centre and Aldea Zamá are where that settled market sits: paved, serviced and walkable, with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets and schools among the houses. Price $336,000 USD. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Three bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, the principal a double height room with a four poster bed and glazing on two sides, the bathrooms in timber and stone with walk in showers. A steel and concrete stair leads up to a roof terrace with a timber pergola, bean bags and a shaded lounge over the tree line. Outside The pool sits in a stone paved terrace with loungers along one side, planting on the boundary and an outdoor kitchen under cover. Tulum Tulum now has its own international airport and a year round population rather than a winter one, and the streets between the town centre and Aldea Zamá are where that settled market sits: paved, serviced and walkable, with restaurants, cafes, supermarkets and schools among the houses. Four bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, each bedroom with its own bathroom, carved timber screens and a ceiling fan, the principal with a headboard wall of slatted timber. Floors are large format stone throughout. The two pools The courtyard pool is the long one, set in white stone with the house on three sides and planting on the fourth. On the roof there is a second pool with a timber deck, a shaded lounge under a parasol and the Aldea Zamá tree line all around it. La Privada La Privada is the gated enclave inside Aldea Zamá with controlled access around the clock, a community pool and a padel court, and restaurants and daily services within walking distance. desc.en: Finished property. A corner lot of 2,500 square metres, fifty metres by fifty, in Región 8 of Tulum, two hundred metres from Avenida Kukulkán and fifty metres from the paved road, with direct access and electricity already at the plot. It is Manzana 676, Lote 003. The lot A perfect square on a corner, so it takes access and light from two streets, which is what makes it buildable as more than a single house. It carries TH2 density, the zoning that allows multi unit residential, and at 2,500 square metres it is large enough for a small condominium scheme, a set of villas or one large private compound. Services are in and the documentation is in order. Región 8 Región 8 is the part of Tulum closest to the beach road, reached off Avenida Kukulkán, which runs down to the hotel zone and the sand. It has been the fastest moving development zone in the town for several years, and this lot sits two hundred metres from that avenue on a paved approach. Price $9,800,000 MXN, which is $3,920 MXN per square metre across 2,500 square metres, about $576,471 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar.
