Finished property. Villa Vue Maya is a contemporary villa of 345 square metres in El Mirador, the jungle community on the ruins side of Tulum, laid out over three levels and a rooftop that looks straight out across the canopy to the ancient Mayan city and the green of El Jaguar National Park. Five bedrooms, five and a half bathrooms, two private swimming pools and a private sauna and steam room on the roof. The house The elevation is stone and warm rendered concrete, three storeys of it standing among young palms, with deep planted terraces cut into each floor so the greenery climbs the front of the building. Inside, the ground floor is the social level: an open kitchen in pale timber and stone with a long island, the dining and living space beyond it, and glazing that opens to the garden and to the ground floor pool. A sculptural staircase carries up through the house. The bedrooms are arranged across the upper levels, each with its own bathroom, and the fifth room can be taken as a bedroom or used as a multipurpose room for a home office, a cinema, a games room or a bar, which is how many owners of this layout use it. The rooftop The roof is the reason for the house. A second swimming pool sits at the front edge of it with nothing between the water and the jungle, a shaded pergola and an outdoor kitchen behind, and a private sauna and steam room set into the terrace. The view runs over unbroken canopy to the Mayan ruins and the national park. Solar panels on the roof carry a large part of the running load. The community El Mirador is built around a serpentine lagoon pool with a star shaped palapa over the bar, the lounge and the dining terrace, with a paddle tennis court beside it and an observatory tower that opens the same view of the ruins and the park to every resident. Access is controlled and the community is guarded around the clock. Everything sits inside jungle rather than on cleared ground, so the houses are screened from one another. The location The community is a short distance from the archaeological zone and El Jaguar Park, with the Tulum beach road, the hotel zone and the town centre all within a few minutes drive, and the new Tulum airport about half an hour away. It is a quiet address that suits a family home or a holiday house let out when the owners are away. Price $1,080,000 USD. Fuller information on the villa follows genuine interest. For the full presentation and a private viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Pre-construction. A two bedroom apartment of 146 square metres on the ground floor of the Kitanché tower at Aldea Mayab, a lagoon front development of eight small jungle towers in Bacalar, with its own terrace and private pool, for delivery in December 2027. The apartment Unit 101 in Kitanché, the sixth tower from the road and one of the closer ones to the water, and the whole of it sits at ground level so the living space runs straight out to the garden. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, a living and dining room, a fitted and equipped kitchen and a laundry area, with 117.60 square metres inside and a terrace of 28.80 square metres carrying a private swimming pool, 146.40 square metres in all. The plan keeps the social rooms and the bedrooms apart rather than running them off one corridor. The finish is the one in the showroom and the apartment is delivered equipped: polished cement floors, timber joinery, stone counters and full height glazing to the jungle. Worth knowing A ground floor plan with its own pool is the rarest thing in this project. Most of the pools here sit on the roofs of the penthouses, so this is one of the few apartments where you can swim without going upstairs, and the only one of the six units on the current availability list that does it. Price $390,000 USD at list. Aldea Mayab Aldea Mayab is eight small towers on eight hectares of jungle on the shore of the Bacalar lagoon, by B|Huber, each tower named for a native tree: Chaká, Chechén, Yaxché, Balché, Jabín, Kitanché, Pich and Chit, running from the highway down to the water, with more than seventy percent of the site kept as green area. The clubhouse has a restaurant and common areas, there are two pools with sun decks, pádel courts, a gym, a yoga area, a spa, a barbecue area, a fire pit, a private dock on the lagoon, security with controlled access and a private wastewater treatment plant. The first towers are built and lived in, the showroom apartment is furnished and can be walked through, and the remaining towers are scheduled for delivery in December 2027. Bacalar Bacalar is the lagoon of seven colours in the south of Quintana Roo, forty kilometres long and a pueblo mágico since 2006, two hours south of Tulum and forty minutes from Chetumal and its airport, and the last stretch of this coast where lagoon front land can still be bought at these prices. For the floor plans, the current availability and a call with the developer, get in touch and we will arrange it.

One bedroom and one bathroom, an open living and dining room, a fitted kitchen and a laundry area, with 73.60 square metres inside and 24.70 square metres of terrace, 98.30 square metres in all. Ceilings are 2.9 metres clear and glazing is 2.4 metres high, floors are polished concrete, walls are plaster and doors are natural wood, with mini split air conditioning throughout. The plan is a sequence of aldeas, each of four small round towers of ten apartments: four two bedroom garden homes on the ground floor, four one bedrooms on the first and two three bedroom penthouses on top. Aldea Hormiga sold out and Aldea Venado is the phase now selling. Residents share a clubhouse with a pool, a restaurant and a juice bar, two smaller clubhouses, two pádel courts, a gym, a spa, the dock on the lagoon and a gatehouse with security. desc.en: Finished property. A one bedroom apartment of about 46 square metres at Adora Tulum, a finished and furnished development on Avenida Kukulkán in Región 15, built around a natural cenote, at $130,000 USD with seller financing available. The apartment One bedroom and one bathroom across roughly 500 square feet, delivered furnished and ready to use. Timber beamed ceilings run through the living space, the bedroom opens through a full wall of glass onto its own timber terrace looking into the trees, and the kitchen is fitted along one wall with a breakfast counter and stools. Air conditioning, a wall mounted television and a woven hanging behind the bed came with the apartment. The terrace carries an outdoor bath and shower in stone against a screen of bamboo, which is the detail people remember about these units. The cenote The development is laid out around a natural cenote, open to the sky, with clear green water, a rock overhang at one end and timber walkways and a bridge around the rim. It is inside the property rather than a drive away, which is unusual at this price and the main reason to look at Adora rather than at the many similar sized apartments along this road. The building The front of the building is a deep round drum clad in fine timber screening above a wall of regional stone, set back behind heavy planting and palms. Behind it the apartments step down through the trees, so almost every terrace looks into greenery rather than at the road. Región 15 Región 15 sits on the inland side of Tulum along Avenida Kukulkán, the road that runs down towards the beach. Aldea Zama and its plaza are a little over a kilometre away, the town centre and the Avenida Cobá restaurants are a few minutes in the other direction, and the beach road is a short drive. It is one of the busiest parts of Tulum for new building, which is why an apartment at this price still has the town on its doorstep. Price $130,000 USD. The seller will consider financing part of the price, and the terms are open to discussion. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A three bedroom house of 186 square metres in Santa Fe, inside gated Playacar Phase II in Playa del Carmen, backing directly onto the golf course, sold furnished at $8,560,000 MXN. The house Two storeys, 186 square metres of living space within a structure of 221, on a plot that runs back to the fairway. Three bedrooms, one of them on the ground floor, each with its own full bathroom, and a further half bathroom for guests. Above them a loft opens off the landing, which the present owners use for yoga and which works equally as a study or a fourth sleeping room. There is a separate laundry and a service room with its own bathroom, an American kitchen open to the living and dining room, a covered terrace, a balcony, a garden and a yard. The house is sold furnished and is nineteen years old. Outside The back of the plot borders the golf course, so there are no neighbours behind and the view is across grass and trees. Parking is behind a private gate with an electric opener for two cars. The Reef hotel and its beach access are 200 metres away and the Avenida 10 entrance to Playacar is 800. Price $8,560,000 MXN, about $503,529 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. A two bedroom apartment of 92.7 square metres on the second floor at Santamar by TAO, on the point at Aventuras Akumal, looking out to the Caribbean and a short walk from a secluded beach, sold fully furnished at $349,000 USD. The apartment Unit B201, with 79.10 square metres inside and a terrace of 13.57, plus a separate storage locker of 2.4. Two bedrooms and two bathrooms, arranged so the two bedrooms sit along one side with their bathrooms back to back between them and the living space runs down the other, ending in glazing onto the terrace. The kitchen is fully equipped, with a gas range, a large fridge and a patterned tile splashback, opening to the dining table and a living room fitted with good timber furniture and a hanging chair. It is sold turnkey: the furniture, the kitchen equipment and the fittings all stay, so it can be lived in or let the week it changes hands. The view The terrace looks over the palms to the sea. That is what you are buying at this price point here, and it is worth saying plainly that the apartment is not on the sand: the beach is a short walk through the gardens, and the water is the reef protected kind that Akumal is known for. Santamar Santamar is 117 apartments in seven low buildings on the point at Punta Sur, laid out through landscaped gardens with private terraces, and every building has its own rooftop pool looking at the sea. There are ten pools across the site, a private beach club with its own pier, direct beach access, barbecue areas, a gym and a yoga area. A three year membership of the Tao Wellness Centre is included with the purchase. Akumal Akumal sits between Playa del Carmen and Tulum and is known for the reef close in and the calm water behind it, for the turtles in the bay and for being a good deal quieter than either town. Snorkelling starts off the rocks here. Lol Ha, Jungle Fish, La Buena Vida and the Yal Ku lagoon are all within a few minutes, and Tulum and Playa del Carmen are each about half an hour. Price $349,000 USD, furnished. The maintenance charge is $5,684 MXN a month. For the floor plan, the walkthrough video and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

features.feature: Ten swimming pools across the site

desc.en: Finished property. A one bedroom house of 60 square metres standing on 2,500 square metres of cleared jungle in Manuel Antonio Ay, a village about thirty minutes inland from the centre of Tulum, with its own swimming pool and running entirely off solar power. Built in May 2024 and held with título de propiedad. The house A single low volume finished in chukum, the polished lime and bark render that is the regional finish, with a flat roof and full height sliding glazing down the side that faces the pool. One bedroom and two bathrooms, an open living and dining space, and a kitchen fitted along one wall in timber and stone. The glazing means the main rooms look straight out at the water and the trees rather than at a wall, and the two bathrooms on a one bedroom plan is unusual and useful, because a guest never has to walk through the bedroom. It runs itself Electricity comes from solar panels with battery storage, and waste goes to a biodigester, so the house has no utility connection to lose and no bill to pay for either. On this side of Tulum that is not a luxury, it is what makes a plot like this liveable. The equipment is installed, commissioned and in use. The land The plot runs to 2,500 square metres in total, because the sale includes a further parcel beyond the fenced garden. It is cleared where it needs to be and left planted everywhere else, so the mature trees that shade the pool are the ones that were already there. The whole of it is walled and fenced. There is room on it for a second building, a workshop or simply for nobody to be able to build next to you. Manuel Antonio Ay A quiet village in the Tulum municipality, inland from the coast and off the tourist road. Raíces Balché and a few local shops are in the village, and there are cenotes within minutes, Aktun Bej among them. Tulum town is about half an hour by car. Ownership and price The property carries título de propiedad and is held in a Mexican company, which can be transferred with the sale if the buyer wants it. $3,400,000 MXN, about $200,000 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. For the title documents, the plot plan and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A one bedroom apartment of 71.97 square metres on the first floor at Buena Vida, a small garden project in La Veleta, Tulum, with a deep covered terrace looking into the trees and a shared pool in the garden below. $99,000 USD. The apartment Unit D5, one floor up. The plan gives 54.05 square metres under roof and a further 17.92 square metres of open terrace, 71.97 in all. One bedroom with a fitted closet, one bathroom, and an open room that takes the kitchen, the dining table and the living area in a single run, with sliding glazing along the garden side. The covered terrace sits off that room and off the bedroom, and at a quarter of the floor area it is a room in itself rather than a balcony: the photographs show it used as the dining room, with the jungle canopy at eye level. The project Buena Vida is a low rise scheme by the Tulum architect Roberto Carli, laid out so the apartments sit around a planted garden rather than a car park. The garden is mature, with grass, banana plants and palms, a gravel path running through it and a swimming pool with loungers at the end. Parking is within the project. Worth knowing At this price most of what trades in Tulum is a studio in a building that has not been started. This one is built, planted, finished and in use, in the part of town people actually live in, and it comes with a terrace larger than some of the studios it competes with. La Veleta La Veleta is the residential district west of the highway and the part of Tulum that has filled in with people rather than hotels. Quieter than Aldea Zamá, close enough to the centre to cycle, with restaurants, shops and studios opening along its streets. The beach road is a short drive. Price $99,000 USD. For the floor plan, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

features.feature: Sliding glazing to the garden side

desc.en: Finished property. A four bedroom house of 315.23 square metres on a 375 square metre plot in La Privada, Aldea Zama, designed and built by CoLab. Private pool, a rooftop with a jacuzzi and two grills, solar panels and rainwater harvesting, sold fully furnished and equipped at $850,000 USD, reduced from the earlier asking price. The house Open plan through the social floor, with the living room, the dining table and the kitchen running as one space behind a wall of glass that slides back to the pool terrace. Four bedrooms, each with its own full bathroom, so nobody shares. There is a separate laundry room and parking for one car. The finish is chukum and Mayan stone, white rendered walls with deep overhangs, timber joinery and polished floors, and the glazing is set so that every principal room ends in greenery rather than in a neighbour. Outside The pool runs the length of the house on the second level with a built in bench along its edge, so the water sits at the same height as the living room rather than below it. Above, the roof is given over to a palapa with a long timber table, hammocks, a gas grill and a charcoal grill, and a jacuzzi set into the deck looking out over the canopy. Lit at dusk it is the part of the house people remember. How it runs Solar panels, a cistern and a rainwater collection system. In a town where the supply is not always dependable that is the difference between a house you can leave and a house you cannot. Aldea Zama Aldea Zama is the planned residential area of Tulum between the town and the beach road, laid out with pavements, lighting and services rather than grown into the jungle, and it is where most of the good building of the last decade has gone. La Privada is one of the small developments within it. The beach is a few minutes by car and the centre of town a few minutes the other way. Price $850,000 USD, furnished and equipped. The seller has reduced the asking price. For the full photo set, the plans and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A four bedroom house of 575 square metres on an 851 square metre plot on the water in Lagos del Sol, Cancún, with its own pool, direct access to the lake and garaging for three cars. $20,900,000 MXN. The house Two levels of 575 square metres, laid out so the social floor runs the full width of the lake elevation behind glass: living room, dining room and an open kitchen with a stone island, all of it looking at the water. Four bedrooms, a multipurpose room that takes a study, a cinema or a fifth sleeping room, and a separate service room. Five bathrooms in all, with the main suite carrying a walk in dressing room the size of a bedroom and a bathroom with a sunken bath set against the glass. Outside The garden runs down to the lake and the pool sits between the two, so the swimming edge and the water line read as one surface from the terrace. There is a covered seating area beside it and direct access to the lake itself, which is the thing people buy here for. Garaging takes three cars. Price $20,900,000 MXN, about $1,229,412 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. Lagos del Sol Lagos del Sol is the lagoon community on the inland side of Cancún, built around a chain of man made lakes with the houses set along the water. Residents have security around the clock and a controlled entrance, a semi Olympic swimming pool, tennis and basketball courts, a gym, steam rooms and a restaurant. It is about twenty minutes from the hotel zone and twenty five from the airport, and it is where Cancún families live rather than where it holidays. For the fact sheet, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A four bedroom house of 467 square metres on a 635 square metre plot on the water in Lagos del Sol, Cancún, with two swimming pools, direct access to the lake and a solar array with battery storage. $31,000,000 MXN. The house Timber, stone and pale render, with the social floor opening along its whole length to the lake through sliding glass set in deep timber frames. Living room, dining room and kitchen run as one space; above them the bedrooms sit behind a double height stair hall lit from the roof. Four bedrooms and five bathrooms, with a separate service room. The detailing is quieter and warmer than most houses at this level here: lime plaster, timber ceilings, stone floors. Two pools One is an infinity pool on the lake elevation, set so the far edge disappears into the water beyond and the houses across the lagoon sit on the horizon. The second is a longer pool at the back among the trees, out of sight of the first, which is unusual and useful: one to swim in and one to sit by. How it runs Solar panels with battery storage, so the house carries its own load through a cut rather than only offsetting the bill. Price $31,000,000 MXN, about $1,823,529 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figure is the asking price and the dollar figure moves with the rate. Lagos del Sol Lagos del Sol is the lagoon community on the inland side of Cancún, built around a chain of man made lakes with the houses set along the water. Residents have security around the clock and a controlled entrance, a semi Olympic swimming pool, tennis and basketball courts, a gym, steam rooms and a restaurant. It is about twenty minutes from the hotel zone and twenty five from the airport, and it is where Cancún families live rather than where it holidays. For the fact sheet, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

Finished property. A three bedroom house of 526.13 square metres built across two lots totalling 645 square metres in Residencial Bambú, Playa del Carmen, with a pool, a garden laid out with a basketball court and a football pitch, parking for three cars and the whole house sold furnished and equipped. $19,000,000 MXN. The house Two storeys behind a white and charcoal elevation, built wide rather than tall because it sits on two plots instead of one. The social floor is one long open run of living room, dining room and kitchen, the kitchen in pale stone with a full height island and professional appliances, opening along its length to the covered terrace. Three bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms, with a separate service room, and a dressing room off the main suite fitted out as a room in its own right. It is sold fully furnished and equipped. The garden The second lot is what makes this house unusual. Rather than a strip of grass there is a proper garden with a swimming pool, a covered terrace for eating outside, and a lawn marked out with a basketball hoop at one end and a football goal at the other. In a market where most houses this size have a plunge pool and a path, that is the difference. Two lots or one The house and both lots together are $19,000,000 MXN, about $1,117,647 USD. The seller will also sell the house on a single lot at $15,000,000 MXN, about $882,353 USD, which keeps the building and releases the garden plot. The peso figures are the asking prices and the dollar figures move with the rate. Playa del Carmen Residencial Bambú is one of the established residential pockets of Playa del Carmen, inland from the beach and away from the tourist strip, the sort of street where people live year round. Fifth Avenue and the sea are a few minutes by car and Cancún airport about forty five. For the fact sheet, the full photo set and a viewing, get in touch and we will arrange it.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Lofts of 68.28 square metres at INNA, a beachfront building on the sand at Puerto Morelos, each with its own terrace and plunge pool, delivered turnkey and furnished. From $8,420,621 MXN. The loft One open room of 68.28 square metres holding the sleeping area, the living space, the kitchen and a breakfast bar, with one bathroom off it, planned for two people. The whole of one side opens to a terrace carrying a plunge pool of its own, which at this size of apartment is unusual: most things at this price on this coast share the water with the rest of the building. The lofts occupy the centre section between the two towers, from the third level up to the penthouse floor. Availability and price Five were free on the July 2026 list: units 306 at $8,420,621 MXN, 305 at $8,787,227, 506 at $8,837,361, 606 at $8,921,962 and PH 6 at $9,325,385. That is about $495,331 to $548,552 USD at 17 pesos to the dollar. The peso figures are the asking prices and the dollar figures move with the rate. INNA Beach Condos and Hotel INNA is a beachfront building on the sand at Puerto Morelos, arranged as two residential towers, Norte and Sur, with a run of lofts between them, and run alongside a hotel operation. Residents share a beach club on the sand, an infinity pool that reads as though it runs into the sea, a second pool at the foot of the building, a spa, a gym, a rooftop, restaurants, a bar and a coworking room. Apartments are delivered turnkey, equipped and furnished, and there is a hotel managed rental programme for owners who want the unit let when they are not using it. Puerto Morelos Puerto Morelos is the fishing village between Cancún and Playa del Carmen, with the reef a few hundred metres offshore and a national marine park protecting it. It is about twenty minutes from Cancún airport, which is closer than anywhere else on this coast worth living in, and it has stayed a village: a square, a handful of restaurants, boats on the beach. For the floor plans, the current availability and the payment schedules, get in touch and we will send them over.

desc.en: Pre-construction. Two bedroom ocean front apartments of 124 to 132 square metres at INNA, a beachfront building on the sand at Puerto Morelos, each with two terraces, a plunge pool and a lock off system, delivered turnkey and furnished. From $16,360,678 MXN. The apartment Two bedrooms and two bathrooms planned for eight people, with the living room, the dining table and the kitchen running as one space between them and the sea in front. There are two terraces, the main one carrying a plunge pool. The apartments run from the second level to the penthouse floor in both the north and south towers. The lock off Each apartment is built on a lock off system, so the second bedroom and its bathroom close off behind their own door and can be used or let independently of the rest. That is the plan to look at if you want to use part of the apartment and let the rest, or let the two halves separately through the hotel programme. desc.en: Pre-construction. Three bedroom ocean front apartments of 221.70 square metres on the top floor and the penthouse level at INNA, a beachfront building on the sand at Puerto Morelos, each with three terraces, a plunge pool and a lock off system, delivered turnkey and furnished. From $29,280,269 MXN. The apartment Three bedrooms and three bathrooms across 221.70 square metres, planned for twelve people, with the living room, the dining table, a breakfast bar and the kitchen in one long run down the middle and a bedroom suite at either end. Three terraces, the central one carrying a plunge pool and the sea straight ahead. These are the largest apartments in the building short of the penthouses, and they sit on the seventh level and the penthouse floor of both towers, so nothing is built above or in front of them. The lock off Built on a lock off system, so one bedroom suite closes off behind its own entrance and can be used or let separately from the rest of the apartment.
